sgyu sprepasko ra nga ———
/sdus0 77/lnga46thu'utsha nga08 4 phyi 0715776smo bod kyi dgon sde khag gcig gi ngo spyod mdon bsdus/blo bzang chos 'byor gyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

gling gzhi/〈bod kyi dgon sde khag gcig gi ngo sprod mdor bsdus 〉zhes pa'i deb chung 'di nyid/ spyi lo 1968lo nas 'go btsugs te bod kyi sa gnas yul gru ji snyed cig tu ngal ba khyad bsad kyis ched bskyod byas te lo ngo stong phrag phyin pa'igana' shul dgon sde dang mkhar rdzong khag gi dngos yod lo rgyus yig cha/rgan po'i ngag lam bcas la dpyad zhib/ lhag par bod kyi chos 'byung lo rgyus dpe rgyun ches dkon pa'i bris ma dang par ma bcas khungs gtugs kyi lo rgyus la gzhi bcol nas bsdu sgrig zhu khul dang / de sngon spyi lo 196/lo'i nang krungago'i lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i sa bkra'i dpe deb par skrun las don thad mnyam zhugs kyis myong tshor/ de bzhin spyi lo 19〈〈lor rang nyid krung dbyang mi rigs slob chen nas las spos kyis bod ljongs slob chen du sdod skabs bod ljongs dmangs srid thing nas gtso 'gan bzhes pa'i bod ljongs kyi sa ming 'khod pa'i sa bkra'i dpe deb cig 'bri rgyu'i las 'gan gnang ba ltar bod kyi sa ming gi lo rgyus 'khod pa'i sa bkra'i dpe deb cig dpe skrun byed thub pa byung ba dang chabs cig da res kyi dpe deb 'di nyid kyi rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu'i las ka yang rim bzhin mnyam du grub/ de rjes rang nyid lus gzhi gcong ba dang nad mnar gyis rkyen lo ngo bcu phrag tsam deb 'di nyid dpe skrun ma thub par de mur lus/ 'on kyang da res mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi dbu khrid mchog nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis rgyab skyor gnang ste/ slar yang deb chung 'di nyid dpe skrun byed rgyu'i go skabs byung bar gus pas spyang

dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang sbrags deb chung 'di nyid kyis bod kyi rig dngos zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gzhon skyes tsho dang / bod kyi yul skor spro 'cham gyi las don 'phel rgyas gong 'phel gang legs yong ched phan thogs phran bu yong re snyam pa'i rnam dkar ke la shas kun nas blangs te gzigs 'bul zhus pa lags na ma dag pa dang nor 'dzol ci mchis zur gnas dpyod ldan rnam pas dgongs 'char lhag rtsol yod pa zhu/bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i dge che'i ming 'dzin pa blo bzang chos 'byor nas/2006lo'i zla 12par bris/

dkar chagagling gzhi/ ( 1 )lha sa khul gyi dgon khag ( 1 )chu shur rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (8 )snye mo rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (14)stag rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (16)stod lung bde chen rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (24)'dam gzhung rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (30)mal gro gung dkar rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (31)lhun grub rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (40)gzhis rtse khul gyi dgon khag (48)sa skya rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (55)skyid grong rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (60)khang dmar rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (62)rgyal rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (63)gro mo rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (68)ngam ring rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (70)gnya' nang rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (71)ding ri rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (72)rnam gling rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (76)

pa snam rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (81)sna dkar rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (84)bzhad mthong smon rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (87)rin spungs rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (92)gting skyes rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (96)dga' rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (98)lha rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (99)pu rang rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (106)rtsa mda' rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (108)ru thog rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (111)gong dkar rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (112)rgya tsha rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (116)gra nang rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (119)chu gsum rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (125)sne gdong rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (128)'phyongs rgyas rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (136)mtsho sna rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (140)mtsho smad rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (142)zangs ri rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (144)lhun rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (150)lho brag rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (155)kong po rgya mda' rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (161)nying khri rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (165)sna rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (168)

spo bo rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (172)sman gling rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (176)rdza yul rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (177)nag chu rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (179)'bri ru rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (180)lha ri 'go rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (182)sog rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (183)chab mdo rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (186)go 'jo rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (193)'jo mda' rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (194)steng chen rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (200)dpa' shod rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (203)dpal 'bar rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (206)brag g.yab rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (210)smar khams rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (212)mdzo sgang rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (216)ri bo che rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (218)lho rong rdzong khul gyi dgon khag (219)3

lha sa khul gyi dgon khagapha bong kha byang chub shing gi nags khrod/lo rgyus thog chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po gnas 'dir bzhugs shing sgrub pa mdzad pa'i pho brang ma ru zhes pa de yin par grags/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras dge bshes brag dkar bas dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/dus phyis sa lug nas me glang (spyi lo 1619da 1627)bar du pha bong kha pa 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub pha bong khar bzhugs skabs pha bong kha'i dkar chag bcoms par mdzad/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po yang pha bong khar 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub mdun thengs 'ga' zhig phebs te chos 'brel gsan pa sogs mdzad pa bskyangs/tshal gung bang dgon pa/de ni tshal pa bka' rgyud kyi bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pas rab byung gsum pa'i shing yos te spyi lo 1175lor tshal gung thang dgon pa (lha sa'i shar rgyud nye bar yod/) phyag btab rjes de nas slar yang me lug ste spyi lo 1187lor gung thang dgon pa phyag btab pas da lta tshal gung thang du grags/lo rgyus thog gi tshal pa bka' brgyud pa'i gdan sa dang po dang de nas tshal pa khri skor gyi sgrig gzhi yang 'dir byung ba yin/ dus phyis sa stag ste spyi lo 1698lor gung thang dang dbus gling gnyis la dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya bzhi bcu skor yod par grags/ 1

rnal rgyal grwa tshang /rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa mtsho sngon phyogs mtsho khar phebs nye'i skabs kyi shing khyi nas me glang (1574da 1577)bar du btsugs pa'i grwa tshang zhig yin/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i sku dus su rtse pho brang du gnas spo gnang ste rnam rgyal grwa tshang zhes su grags shing dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor zhig gi tshad gzhi yod pa red/gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling /lcags rta spyi lo 1690lor sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos skrun gnang pa'i gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling la dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bcu tham pa'i grangs 'bor gtan 'bebs gnang 'dug dgon pa de ni lha sa'i nub rgyud 'bras spungs dgon pa'i nye 'dabs gnas chung zhes par yod pa yin/chu bzang ri khrod/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i yum bu khrid rgyal mo'i ched du bzhengs pa'i tshes bcu lha khang dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bsam pa lhun grub ma'i zhing bkod kyi ldebs bris yod pa dang / de nas dus phyis ri khrod 'dir bstan rgyas gling de mo ba'i bla brang / dga' ldan khri byang bla brang / gzhung pa lha btsun bla brang / rwa sgreng rtse nya bla brang sogs kyi bzhugs gnas bla brang 'ga' zhig yod/ (yig cha'i dpyad gzhung dga' ldan chos 'byung /)chu bzang ri khrod ni lha sa byang rgyud nyang bran shang khongs su yod/2

garma dgon gsar thub bstan chos 'khor/spyi lo 1502chu phag lor lha sa'i shar rgyud du rin spungs pa don yod rdo rjes phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing dus phyis se ra smad grwa tshang gi gzhis ka che gras son khal drug brgya skor yod pa de gzhis ka che gras zhig tu gyur kyang da lta'i skabs su kurma kun bzang zhes 'bod kyin 'dugaskar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang /bod kyi btsan po khri lde srong btsan sad na legs kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang de ni lha sa'i skyid chu'i lho rgyud ra ma sgang gru kha dang cung nye bar yod/rme ru grwa tshang /chos rgyal khri ral pa can gyis lha sa'i shar rgyud du rme ru zhes pa'i lha khang zhig gsar skrun gnang par grags shing dus phyis me ru grwa tshang la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya dgu bcu skor yod/ dus phyis kyi dga' ldan khri zur sde drug mkhyen rab dbang phyug ni shing byi 1864lor yongs 'dzin gyi go gnas yod mus thog bod kyi srid skyong rgyal po'i khrir phebs rjes lha sar bzhugs yul rme ru grwa tshang la gnang ba yin 'dug cing gang ltar me ru grwa tshang ni sde drug bla brang gi bzhugs yul du gnang bar grags/bzhi sde grwa tshang /thog ma'i char spyi lo 1210lor sku 'das pa'i tshal pa khri dpon dga' bde bzang pos ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang gi nye 'gram du dge slong bzhi /'i

grangs bcad kyi grwa tshang zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dang de nas shing byi spyi lo 1754lor bzhi sde grwa tshang lha sa lcang gseb shar du spos te 'du khang dang grwa shag bcas rgyas bskrun mdzad lugs rgyal ba bdun pa'i rnam thar smad cha'i khongs 'khod pa dang de nas ra sgreng khri chen brtan pa rab rgyas kyi sku dus nas nye dus bar ra sgreng bla brang gi bzhugs yul lha sa bzhi sde grwa tshang du gnang ba yin/ thog ma'i skabs kyi ra mo che'i mchod 'bul ba dge slong bzhi sde tsho bzhugs pa'i sa yul de ni da lta tshe dpag lha khang zhes pa'i lha khang 'di tsam la 'khel gyin 'dugachos khri lho lcogs stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu re bdun zer/lha sa'i shar rgyud tshal gung thang gi nye 'gram tsam la 'khel pa'i chos khri lho lcog ni dus phyis rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi chos gsan myong ba'i zur chen chos dbyings rang grol rgyun ring tsam 'dir bzhugs pa yin/brag lha klu sgragasrong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo ru yong bzas bzhengs pa'i lha khang 'di la brag lha 'bur du brkos pa'i shākya thub pa/ byams pa/ srong btsan gyi sku 'dra bcas brjid nyams che ba'i bzo rtsal gyi khyad chos ldan pa zhig yod pa yin/de ni grong khyer lha sa'i nub rgyud lcags po ri'i ri khug tu yod/lcags ri be+eḍūr+ya 'gro phan ngo mtshar rig byed gling /4 rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me byi spyi lo 1696lor sde srid sangs rgyas rgya

mtshosagasar 'dzugs gnang ba'i gso rig sman pa grwa tshang dang me byi de nas rtsis pa'i lo brgya phrag gnyis dang nyi shur slebs nye'i skabs su lha sa bstan rgyas gling dang 'dabs 'brel ba'i lha sa sman rtsis khang ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i me zlozlog spyi lo 1916lor rgyal dbang bcu gsum pas gsar 'dzugs gnang ba ra kha bragalha sa'i byang rgyud dog sde shang gi khongs su yod pa'i ra kha brag gi sgrub sde 'khod pa snga shos ni sa skya'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sku 'da' kha'i shing yos spyi lo 1275lo'i gong tsam du bla ma dam pa kha brag tu bzhugs myong ba dang de nas spyi lo 1408lo la rje tsong kha pa chen po ra kha brag tu bzhugs skabs su gong ma yung lo'i gser yig pa 'ga' zhig la mjal 'phrad gnang ba dang bod kyi dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo thengs dang po de ni dga' ldan dgon dang ra kha brag gnyis la byung ba dper na lcags byi 1420lor byams chen chos rjes gtso 'gan bzhes te ra kha brag tu lnga mchod chen mo'i mchod sprin rgyas par phul ba yin/dge 'phel dbu rtse/deb ther dmar po rtsom pa po tshal pa khri dpon kun dga' rdo rjes phyag btab pa'i 'bras spungs dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i ri rtser ri bo dge 'phel zhes pa'i sgrub sde 'di ni rgyal dbang lnga pa nas dus phyis nye dus bar gyi rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon 'ga' zhig gnas 'dir yun thung tsam re bzhugs pa'ang byung 'dug (yig cha'i dpyad khungs bod kyi deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs spyi lo 1957lor par gzhi dang po'i lcags par shog grangs

145nas btus )tshal pa khri dpon kun dga' rdo rje ni (1209 1264)bar bzhugs shing de nyid kyis rab byung drug pa'i chu yos spyi lo 1262lor deb ther dmar po zhes pa'i lo rgyus kyi dpe deb 'di bcoms grub pa yin no/tshe chog gling dgon pa/rgyal dbang sku phreng brgyad pa'i yongs 'dzin dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sku tshe'i mjug spyi lo 1789lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la lo shas bzhugs rjes yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan sku 'das pa yin zhing 'di nyid kyi rnam thar pod gcig rgyal dbang brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshos bcoms pa zhig yod pa yin/kun bde gling /rta tshag rje drung sku phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i mgon pos rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu byi spyi lo 1792lor phyag btab pa'i brtan bzhugs chos 'khor gling ngam yongs grags su dbus gtsang kun bde gling zhes pa'i bla brang dang / grwa tshang / shag skor rgya che ba bcas gsar bskrun gnang ba yin/ rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon po ni spo bo rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud ha cang nye ba'i mda' zhing dgon pa'i nye skor mal jo zhes par sku 'khrungs shing lcags phag spyi lo 1791lo nas shing glang spyi lo 1805bar khri lo bco lnga dang shing glang nas slar yang lcags rta spyi lo 1805da 1810bar khri lo drug bcas khyon bsdoms lo nyi shu rtsa gcig ring bod kyi srid skyong gi khri 'khur bzhes myong ba yi//

bstan rgyas gling gsang sngags dga' tshal/bstan rgyas gling rgyal thog dang po kong po de mo sprul sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho me glang da me bya (spyi lo 1757da 1777)bar bod kyi srid skyong gi mdzad 'khur bzhes skabs lcags 'brug spyi lo 1760tsam la lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs su bstan rgyas gling gsang sngags dga' tshal zhes pa'i 'dus sde bla brang dang bcas pa gsar bskrun gnang ba nas dus phyis spyi lo 1899bar du nyams nyes ci yang ma byung ba'i dar rgyas phyin pa'i dus skabs shig yin/ lcags 'brug spyi lo 1761lor pe cin du bskrun pa'i rgya bod shar sbyar gyi bstan rgyas gling zhes pa'i mtshan byang 'khod pa zhig lha sar 'byor lugs 'khod pa zhig 'dug7

chu shur rdzong khul gyi dgon khagachu shur gsang sngags byang chub gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1651lor gsar tu btsugs pa'i rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bcu skor yod/ gsang sngags byang chub gling ni chu shur rdzong gi rlangs 'khor gzhung lam byang khar yod pa yin/shug gseb dgon pa/phag gru'i slob ma gyer sgom pa tshul khrims seng gis rab byung gsum pa'i lcags glang spyi lo 1181lor phyag btab pa'i shug gseb bka' rgyud kyi gdan sa dang po yin/ shug gseb dgon ni chu shur rdzong tshal sna shang khongs dang tshal sna shang nas rtsis pa'i byang shar phyogs spyi le brgyad tsam gyi sar gnas yod cing dgon pa 'di'i rgyab ri ni brag ri mtho la gzar zhing shug nags kyi nags tshal 'khrigs pa/ dben la nyams dga' pa'i mdzes ljongs dang mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre 5162tsam gyi mngon par mtho zhing brjid chags pa zhig yod pa dang da lta btsun ma brgya skor tsam yod pa yin/'u shang lha khang /bod kyi chos rgyal ral pa can gyis bzhengs pa'i 'u shang rdo dpal dpe meX dge 'phel gyi lha khang zhes pa'i shul mal rgya che ba zhig ni da lta'i chu shur

rdzong tshal sna shang khongs tshal sna shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye 'gram spyi le gnyis tsam gyi sar yod cing dus phyis su dge 'dun chos 'phel yang 'u shang lha khang du zhib 'jug gnang bar phebs myong ba dang ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su logs re la gzhu 'dom drug brgya tsam yod lugs si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dugagangs ri thod dkar/rnying ma'i bla ma klong chen rab 'byams pas dgung lo so gnyis bzhes pa'i spyi lo 1240lo la gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong 'od zer sprin gyi skyed mos tshal du phebs te gangs ri thod dkar gyi dgon pa phyag btab pa yin/gangs ri thod dkar zhes pa'i go don ni ri rtser dbyar kha yang gangs mi zhu ba zhig yod lugs thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'grel bshad gnang yod pa /sdo sa/ ༵/gon pa de ni chu shur rdzong snye bu shug gseb dgon dang ha cang nye bar thar pa gling /lcags stag spyi lo 1650lor gsar tu btab pa'i chu shur thar ba gling la shing khyi 1694lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun skor yod pa'i rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni chu shur rdzong chu phu shang thar pa gling grong tshor yod/nam mkha' lding /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub gnas brag phug brgyad kyi nang rlon

rdzong tshal sna shang khongs tshal sna shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye 'gram spyi le gnyis tsam gyi sar yod cing dus phyis su dge 'dun chos 'phel yang 'u shang lha khang du zhib 'jug gnang bar phebs myong ba dang ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su logs re la gzhu 'dom drug brgya tsam yod lugs si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dugagangs ri thod dkar/rnying ma'i bla ma klong chen rab 'byams pas dgung lo so gnyis bzhes pa'i spyi lo 1240lo la gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong 'od zer sprin gyi skyed mos tshal du phebs te gangs ri thod dkar gyi dgon pa phyag btab pa yin/gangs ri thod dkar zhes pa'i go don ni ri rtser dbyar kha yang gangs mi zhu ba zhig yod lugs thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'grel bshad gnang yod pa /sdo sa/ ༵/gon pa de ni chu shur rdzong snye bu shug gseb dgon dang ha cang nye bar thar pa gling /lcags stag spyi lo 1650lor gsar tu btab pa'i chu shur thar ba gling la shing khyi 1694lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun skor yod pa'i rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni chu shur rdzong chu phu shang thar pa gling grong tshor yod/nam mkha' lding /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub gnas brag phug brgyad kyi nang rlon

dben gnas nam mkha' lding ni brag ri g.yang gzar can ri rtser 'jogs rjes slebs pa yin pas chu shur rdzong chu shur zam chen gyi byang khar yod/ 'di ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig tu gsal/'or gtsug lha khang /spyilo 1054lor jo bo rje a ti sha snye thang du sku 'das rjes jo bo rje'i slob ma zhang ston byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis 'or gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par grags shing 'or ni da lta'i snye thang 'or ma grong du yod pa yin/ jo po rje ni rgya gar dang nye ba'i bhang ga la'i rgyal po'i bur 'khrungs shing / 1042chu rta nas lo bcu gnyis tsam bod du bzhugs/ zhib phra bka' gdams chos 'byung nang gsal 'khod byung 'dug /(chu shur rdzong snye thang shang kāswāhā // bu/ sgang grong tsho )lcags stag zhib gzhung du bkod pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1820lor nor bu sgang ni dgon pa zhig yin pa dang nor bu sgang gi gru kha ni lha sa skyid chu'i gru kha zhig 'khel pa yin/rmog lcog dgon pa/rmog lcog dgon pa ni shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ 'di ni klong rdol bla ma'i gsung 'bum nas bton pa yin zhing snye thang rmog lcog hā/sna / ༵ tsho/ rdzong snye thang shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud spyi le gnyis tsam gyi 10

snye thang bkra shis sgang dgon pa/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bla ma snye thang grags pa seng ge'i chos khri sogs yod pa'i bkra shes sgang ni dus phyis mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal nas slar yang dge 'dun gyi sde gsar 'dzugs gnang ba bcas sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin zhing snye thang grags pa seng gis rab byung bzhi pa'i chu stag spyi lo 1242lor gsar bsgrigs mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis kyi phyag dpe zhig yod pa yin 'dug cing snye thang bkra shis sgang ni chu shur rdzong snye thang shang khongs bkra shes sgang grong tsho snye thang shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud spyi le gnyis tsam gyi sar gnas yod pa yin lags so/ /snye thang chos rdzong /bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sku tshe'i mjug tsam la phyag btab pa'i snye thang chos rdzong ni dus phyis mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal nas zhig gsos dang sbrags gtsang dgon du bsgyur ba bcas sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin zhing rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos sbyor 'jags gnang ba'i snye thang chos rdzong la sa zhing son khal drug brgya'i thon khungs yod pa'i gzhis ka yang snye thang gi nye 'dabs su yod pa red/ da lta chos rdzong gi shul tsam las dgon gnas kyi rnam pa ni ci yang mi 'dug go / snye thang chos rdzong ni chu shur rdzong snye thang shang gi khongs su gnas yod/yol rin chen gling /yol rin chen gling dang yol ri gong zhes pa de gnyis ni chu shur rdordo bye

nub shang khongs yol ri gong zhes pa'i sa khul du yod/ yig cha'i dpyad khongs be+e ser dang rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i rnam thar nas btus pa yin/ ciklong rdol rin chen chos gling /'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis phyag btab pa'i klong rdol ri khrod ni chu shur rdzong snye thang shang khongs snye thang shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su spyi le lnga tsam yod pa'i klong rin chos gling ni dus phyis kyi klong rdol ngag dbang blo bzang (1719 1794)bar bzhugs pa'i klong rdol ngag dbang blo bzang ni klong rdol du lo dgu dang rin chen chos gling du lo brgyad bcas lo nyi shu rtsa grangs zhig ri khrod kho nar bzhugs te sgom sgrub mdzad pa dang / klong rdol dang rin gling gnyis ni klong rdol dgon pa gong 'og gi dbye gzhi tsam yin no/ / snye bang lha chen mo/gnyan mkhar nag gi klu dung skyong gi gnas yin par grags pa'i ri zur du brag la brkos pa'i shākya thub pa'i rdo sku chen mo zhig la da lta snye thang lha chen mo zhes pa 'di ni spyi lo 1822chu rta lor rgyal ba sku phreng bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i rnam thar khongs su gnyan mkhar nag gi brag gdong bstan pa'i bdag po'i sku brnyan la snyan shal phul tshul 'khod pa 'di tsam las dpyad khungs ma byung zhing gnyan mkhar nag ni kurma sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje'i sku dus nas 'khod pa re zung tsam mthong rgyu 'dug snye thang lha chen mo ni chu shur rdzong snye thang shang khongs su yod/12

chos 'khor yang rtse dgon/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi spyi lo 1648lor gsar du btsugs pa'i dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse dgon par dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 169/lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya drug cu re gsum skor yod/dgon pa de ni chu shur rdzong bye nub shang khongs yol rin chen gling gi nye phyogs tsam la 'khel ba yin/ 13

snye mo rdzong khul gyi dgon khagatsha mig gi gnas gzhi/klu mes kyi mkhan po rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab pa'i bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras tsha mig ni snye mo rdzong gzhu smad shang khongs gzhu smad nas rtsis pa'i byang shar ngos spyi le gsum yod pa'i tsha mig grong tshor gnas yod/gzhu kun ra dgon/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga skor yod/ gzhu kun ra dgon ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras yin pa'i da lta kun ra dgon zhes su grags pa'i snye mo rdzong gzhu smad shang khongs kun ra grong tshor yod pa yin/gzhu'i dge 'dun sgang /kha che paṇa chen gyis tshogs pa sde bzhi'i gras gzhu'i dge 'dun sgang ni snye mo rdzong snye mo shang khongs snye mo shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud spyi le gcig tsam gyi sar yod cing gzhu zhes pa'i go don ni snye mo gzhu chu'i 'bab rgyud la 'khel bas de ltar grags/(yig cha'i dpyad khungs mkhas pa'i dga' ston smad cha shog1 sbyangs 50nas btus/)

gzhu rabacus gling /snye mo thob rgyal byed tshal la phyi dgon lag gras yin pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs zhe dgu skor yod/ lo rgyus thog gtsang smad gzhung dang snye mo rdzong zer pa'i snye mo rdzong gzhu chu'i rgyud kyi sa khul de'i rgyud la yod pa yin/gzhu byang gling /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma bka' bzhi pas phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu skor yod/ gzhu ni snye mo rdzong gzhu chu'i nye rgyud gzhu stod smad gnyis kyi sa khul 'di tsam la yod pa yin/thon rgyal byed tshal/ thon pa mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mchos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 169/lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu skor yod/thon pa mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho ni 'bras spungs dgon pa'i gdan rabs dgu pa dang gdan rabs bcu pa ni rgyal ba sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho yin/ thon rgyal byed tshal ni snye mo rdzong thon shang khongs su gnas yod cing lo rgyus thog thon gyi skor 'khod pa snga shos su mthong ba'i thon lug ra kha ni mi la ras pa dbus bzhud skabs su phebs lam 'khel ba yin/15

stag rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khagabade chen gsang sngags mkhar/chos grwa chen mo bde chen gsang sngags mkhar ni brag dkar nang so rin chen lhun pos sbyin bdag zhus te rab byung drug pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1419lor rje tsong kha pa chen pos sa 'dul dang rab gnas gnang zhing dgon ming yang rje tsong kha pa chen pos gnang ba yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1689lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod/ bde chen gsang sngags mkhar ni stag rtse rdzong bde chen shang khongs bde chen rtse'i mkhar shul gyi 'gram du gnas yod/ la mo byang chub lcogabodakyi srung ma che ba bzhi'i gras su brtsi ba'i la mo byang chub lcog ni me stagasbyi lo 1666lo tsam la la mo chos skyong gi sku khog dbang 'dus rgyal pos gsar bskrun gnang bar mngon zhing dus phyis spyi lo (1747rtse1750)bar du mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi bu 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi bzhengs pa'i gser zangs kyi rgya phebs nyi ma'i gzi byin la 'gran pa zhig yod pa yin/ la mo byang chub lcog ni stag rtse rdzong la mo shang khongs la mo zhes pa'i sa khul du yod pa yin/yer pa ba rang /16bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras yer pa ba rang ni stag rtse rdzong

stag rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khagabade chen gsang sngags mkhar/chos grwa chen mo bde chen gsang sngags mkhar ni brag dkar nang so rin chen lhun pos sbyin bdag zhus te rab byung drug pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1419lor rje tsong kha pa chen pos sa 'dul dang rab gnas gnang zhing dgon ming yang rje tsong kha pa chen pos gnang ba yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1689lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod/ bde chen gsang sngags mkhar ni stag rtse rdzong bde chen shang khongs bde chen rtse'i mkhar shul gyi 'gram du gnas yod/ la mo byang chub lcogabodakyi srung ma che ba bzhi'i gras su brtsi ba'i la mo byang chub lcog ni me stagasbyi lo 1666lo tsam la la mo chos skyong gi sku khog dbang 'dus rgyal pos gsar bskrun gnang bar mngon zhing dus phyis spyi lo (1747rtse1750)bar du mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyi bu 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi bzhengs pa'i gser zangs kyi rgya phebs nyi ma'i gzi byin la 'gran pa zhig yod pa yin/ la mo byang chub lcog ni stag rtse rdzong la mo shang khongs la mo zhes pa'i sa khul du yod pa yin/yer pa ba rang /16bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras yer pa ba rang ni stag rtse rdzong

'brom stod shang khongs lha sa'i shar rgyud spyi le bcu tsam gyi sar yod pa yin/ba lam nub chos rdzong / sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma nyi shu skor yod pa'i ba lam nub chos rdzong ni lo rgyus thog ra lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam thar khongs su sku tshe'i smad du gsang sngags chos rdzong zhes par bzhugs shing sku gdung ril po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yang ldan sa gnas su yod skabs me sprel spyi lo 1416lor sku gdung ril po gzhung ko nang gdan 'dren zhus te 'bras srungs sngags pa grwa tshang gi 'jigs byed kyi nang rten du bzhugs lugs 'khod yod/ ba lam nub dang ldan gnyis sa cha 'brel la khad pa zhig snang ngo / / ba lam nub chos rdzong ni stag rtse rdzong bde chen shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/lhas phu dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen pos tshad ma rnam 'grel gsungs pa'i gnas gzhi'i dgon pa'i gras shig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ lhas phu dgon ni dga' ldan dgon pa'i nub rgyud kyi lhas phu'i sa yul 'di ni rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i 'brog sde ru ba thar thor yod pa'i lhas glang lung dgon/ lhas brag dgon/ lhas phu dgon gsar bcas lhas ra dang 'brel pa'i dgon khag gsum tsam yod pa yin/ba lam chos 'khor/snye phu shug gseb pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma nyi shu rtsa lnga skor/ ba lam shar/ ba lam nub/ ba lam chos rdzong ba/lha da

'brom stod shang khongs lha sa'i shar rgyud spyi le bcu tsam gyi sar yod pa yin/ba lam nub chos rdzong / sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma nyi shu skor yod pa'i ba lam nub chos rdzong ni lo rgyus thog ra lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam thar khongs su sku tshe'i smad du gsang sngags chos rdzong zhes par bzhugs shing sku gdung ril po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yang ldan sa gnas su yod skabs me sprel spyi lo 1416lor sku gdung ril po gzhung ko nang gdan 'dren zhus te 'bras srungs sngags pa grwa tshang gi 'jigs byed kyi nang rten du bzhugs lugs 'khod yod/ ba lam nub dang ldan gnyis sa cha 'brel la khad pa zhig snang ngo / / ba lam nub chos rdzong ni stag rtse rdzong bde chen shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/lhas phu dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen pos tshad ma rnam 'grel gsungs pa'i gnas gzhi'i dgon pa'i gras shig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ lhas phu dgon ni dga' ldan dgon pa'i nub rgyud kyi lhas phu'i sa yul 'di ni rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i 'brog sde ru ba thar thor yod pa'i lhas glang lung dgon/ lhas brag dgon/ lhas phu dgon gsar bcas lhas ra dang 'brel pa'i dgon khag gsum tsam yod pa yin/ba lam chos 'khor/snye phu shug gseb pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma nyi shu rtsa lnga skor/ ba lam shar/ ba lam nub/ ba lam chos rdzong ba/lha da

lta'i stag rtse rdzong bde chen shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/ snye phu shug gseb ༵ /nga du yod med skor dpe deb 'di'i snye phu'i khongs su gsal ba zhig bris lhas brag dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes sangs rgyas dbon zhes bya bas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu skor yod/ lhas brag dgon ni stag rtse rdzong mthar rgyas shang khongs brag dgon grong tshor yod/bkra shis ljongs/skyid shod sde pa (stag rtse sde pa )dang paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan gnyis mchod yon du 'brel skabs phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga bzhi skor yod/ bkra shes ljongs ni stag rtse rdzong brag dkar zhol grong tsho'i byang ngos ri 'dabs su gnas yod cing de sngon kun bde gling bla brang gi dgon lag gras zhig yin/btsun mo tshal dgon pa/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob 'dul 'dzin chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab pa yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe dgu skor yod/ btsun mo tshal zhes pa'i go don ni srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo rnams bzhugs sa'i gnas yin par grags shing da lta/ spyag rtse rdzong la mo shang khongs la mo byang chub lcog nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i

phyogs mtshams btsun mo tshal grong tshor yod/cha phu brag gseb/klu mes kyi mkhan po shākya dbang phyug ces pas phyag btab par grags/sa stag spyi lo 169〈lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ lhas bu brag gseb ni dga' ldan dgon pa'i shar rgyud ri ldebs su yod/ cha gzhis ka dang ha cang nye bar yod do/ / gsang phu'i cha pa chos kyi seng ge yang 'di nas yin pa bka' gdams chos 'byung khongs su rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab yangs lo 1079gong tsam la 'di phyogs su phebs skabs phru gu zhig la byin rlabs mdzad pa'i dpyad khungs shig mthong rgyu 'dugage re dgon gsar/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma ge re bka' bcu ba kun dga' bzang pos phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so bzhi skor/ ge re dgon gsar ni stag rtse rdzong 'brom stod shang ge re grong tshor yod/bod kyi lo rgyus thog srong btsan sgam po rgya ma'i yul 'di tsam nas lha sa'i phyogs su mar phebs skabs ge re'i 'phrang lam brgyud nas phebs lam 'khel bas brag la brkos pa'i lha sku 'ga' zhig kyang yod lugs bshad srol 'dug /la mo cher gseb/klu mes chen pos phyag btab cing de nas bka' gdams kyi dge bshes po to bas bskyangs pa'i gnas zhig yin/ de ni stag rtse rdzong la mo shang 1kā mo

phyogs mtshams btsun mo tshal grong tshor yod/cha phu brag gseb/klu mes kyi mkhan po shākya dbang phyug ces pas phyag btab par grags/sa stag spyi lo 169〈lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ lhas bu brag gseb ni dga' ldan dgon pa'i shar rgyud ri ldebs su yod/ cha gzhis ka dang ha cang nye bar yod do/ / gsang phu'i cha pa chos kyi seng ge yang 'di nas yin pa bka' gdams chos 'byung khongs su rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab yangs lo 1079gong tsam la 'di phyogs su phebs skabs phru gu zhig la byin rlabs mdzad pa'i dpyad khungs shig mthong rgyu 'dugage re dgon gsar/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma ge re bka' bcu ba kun dga' bzang pos phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so bzhi skor/ ge re dgon gsar ni stag rtse rdzong 'brom stod shang ge re grong tshor yod/bod kyi lo rgyus thog srong btsan sgam po rgya ma'i yul 'di tsam nas lha sa'i phyogs su mar phebs skabs ge re'i 'phrang lam brgyud nas phebs lam 'khel bas brag la brkos pa'i lha sku 'ga' zhig kyang yod lugs bshad srol 'dug /la mo cher gseb/klu mes chen pos phyag btab cing de nas bka' gdams kyi dge bshes po to bas bskyangs pa'i gnas zhig yin/ de ni stag rtse rdzong la mo shang 1kā mo

byang chub lcog nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye 'gram gyi ri khug tu yod/chos lung dgon/ stag rtse rdzong bsam 'grub gling shang chos lung gzhis ma'i nye skor du yod cing chos lung ni zhol pa las khungs khongs gtogs kyi chos lung gzhis sdod dang lha sa nas le dbar lnga bcu tsam gyi sar gnas yod lugs 'khod 'dug /zhogs phu 'od gsal dgon/rin chen seng ges phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga skor yod/ 'od gsal dgon ni stag rtse rdzong zhogs shang khongs su yod/dge 'dun sgang /lha dge 'dun sgang pas phyag btab cing dge 'dun zhal grangs ji yod 'khod pa byung mi 'dug cing spyi lo 110me khyi yas mas zhig la rgyas sar sgang pa'i sde 'khrugs byung bar bshad pa'i skor rwa lo tsa ba'i rnam thar khongs su 'khod pa'i dge 'dun sgang ni da lta'i stag rtse rdzong gtsang thog shang khongs dge 'dun sgang grong tsho dang dge 'dun sgang gi yul mi rnams mar tsam spos te da lta dge 'dun 'og ces pa 'di byung ba yin/20

phag mo chos sde/sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis sa khul dang sa gzhi byin rlabs gnang ste dgon pa phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bco lnga skor yod/ phag mo chos sde ni stag rtse rdzong thang dkar shang phag mo zhol grong tsho'i sa khul 'di tsam la 'khel ba yin/lo dgon pa/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyis rab byung dang po'i chu bya spyi lo 1092lor phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga gsum skor yod/ lo dgon pa ṭī /ga rtse rdzong thang dkar shang khongs phag mo zhol grong tsho'i nye skor du yod pa brag dbar dgon/dga' ldan khri rabs nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa mkhas grub bstan dar bas rgyun ring bskyangs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing mkhas grub bstan dar ba ni spyi lo 1565lor dga' ldan srid khrir phebs pa yin/ brag dkar dgon ni stag rtse rdzong chums mda' shang gi lung pa'i phur 'khel ba yin/nyi rings chos sde/sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa da/ /ra

yod/ nyi sdings chos sde ni stag rtse rdzong chums mda' shang khongs lha sa'i skyid chu'ibyang khar gnas yod cing byang sems bde mo thang pa blo gros rgyal mtshan yang chums grong gsar du sku 'khrungs pa yin stabs dgon pa 'di dang sa cha 'brel mtshungs su yod pa zhig yin/bde mo thang /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob byang sems bde mo thang pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bcu drug skor yod/ byang sems bde mo thang ni (spyi lo 1292da 1470)bar bzhugs/ byang sems bde mo thang pa'i sprul sku rim par byung ba la lo sems dpa' rin po che zhes stag rtse rdzong gi thang kur shang khongs lo mdar lo sems dpa' rin po che'i bla brang yang der yod/ bde mo thang dkar ṭā/shā ༵ / stag rtse rdzong chums mda' shang khongs lha sa'i skyid chu'i byang khar lho brag 'bum pa/lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor ba spyi lo (1226da 1409) bar bzhugs/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i bla ma lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung bzhugs par grags pa'i lho brag 'bum pa ni dga' ldan dgon pa'i shar rgyud stag rtse rdzong gtsang thog shang ra sha khug ces pa'i grong tshor ngo mtshar che ba'i mchod rten brjid nyams can zhig mjal rgyu yod pa yin/22

lta phyug dgon/tshal gung thang gi gdan rabs gras su yod pa'i lta phyug mkhar pas lta phyug dgon pa phyag btab cing lta phyug ni da lta'i stag rtse rdzong bde chen shang khongs lta phyug grong tshor byung ba yin/ lta phyug dgon ni twa si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi bka' chems khongs su lta phyug dgon zhes 'khod cing deng skabs dgon tshugs ma zhig par yod bzhin pa'i skabs yin/stag rtse rin chen sgang /da lta'i stag rtse rdzong zhogs shang stag rtse rin chen sgang gi grong tsho 'dir byung ba'i lo rgyus thog gi rin chen sgang dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams zhogs mdar sngon du spos lugs gsungs pa'i thog ma'i yul de yin zhing stag rtse ni sde pa stag rtse ba'i mkhar shul yang 'dir yod cing dga' ldan dgon pa'i ri rtse nas zur tsam mthong gi 'duga'abrom stod gnyan mgon phugaspyi lo 1176lor mnga' bdag rtse sde'i chos 'khor du byon myong ba'i gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi sgrub phug 'dir mgon po'i sku zhig mjal rgyu yod pa dang / 'brom stod ni stag rtse rdzong 'brom stod shang gi sa yul dang stag rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lha sa skyid chu'i byang khar yod cing stag rtse rdzong dang 'brom stod gnyis kha sprod tsam la 'khel ba yin/ dus phyis mi dmangs kung hri zer ba'i thon skyed kyi sgrig gzhi'i tshod blta thengs dang po ni 'brom stod du gnyer ba yin/ 23

stod lung bde chen rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagasang phu dgon pa/rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab kyis rab byung dang po'i chu glang spyi lo 1072lor phyag btab pa'i lha sa'i nye rgyud kyi mtshan nyid slob gnyer byed pa'i grwa sa snga shos yin/ gsang phu dgon pa la nang gses gling stod dang gling smad gnyis las gling stod khongs su sbe ser/ nyi ma thang / rnam rgyal gser khang / khu spe ba sogs dang / gling smad khongs su sgyes gsar ba dang / skyes rnying pa/ ra ba stod dang / ra ba smad/ dwags po grwa tshang bcas las grub pa yin/ de dag gi gnas yul sa ming ngo sprod byung ba gsham gsal ltar sbe ser (stod lung bde chen rdzong gsang mda' shang khongs sbe ser grong tsho )nyi ma thang dgon pa (gsang mda' shang khongs nyi ma thang grong tsho )rnam rgyal gser khang (gsang mda' shang khongs rnam rgyal gser khang grong tsho )khu spe ba (chu shur rdzong chos 'khor yang rtse dgon dang nye bar yod )skyes gsar dang sgyes rnying gnyis ka (stod lung bde chen rdzong )ra ba smad dgon pa (gong dkar rdzong gi gshongs shang khongs )ra ba smad dgon pa (chu shur rdzong snye thang shang khongs )dwags po grwa tshang (gong dkar rdzong rnam rab ces pa'i sa yul du yod )gsang phu dgon pa ni stod lung bde chen rdzong gsang mda' shang khongs dang stod lung bde chen rdzong gsang mda' shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su spyi le bcu gcig tsam yod pa yin/24

stod lung bde chen rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagasang phu dgon pa/rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab kyis rab byung dang po'i chu glang spyi lo 1072lor phyag btab pa'i lha sa'i nye rgyud kyi mtshan nyid slob gnyer byed pa'i grwa sa snga shos yin/ gsang phu dgon pa la nang gses gling stod dang gling smad gnyis las gling stod khongs su sbe ser/ nyi ma thang / rnam rgyal gser khang / khu spe ba sogs dang / gling smad khongs su sgyes gsar ba dang / skyes rnying pa/ ra ba stod dang / ra ba smad/ dwags po grwa tshang bcas las grub pa yin/ de dag gi gnas yul sa ming ngo sprod byung ba gsham gsal ltar sbe ser (stod lung bde chen rdzong gsang mda' shang khongs sbe ser grong tsho )nyi ma thang dgon pa (gsang mda' shang khongs nyi ma thang grong tsho )rnam rgyal gser khang (gsang mda' shang khongs rnam rgyal gser khang grong tsho )khu spe ba (chu shur rdzong chos 'khor yang rtse dgon dang nye bar yod )skyes gsar dang sgyes rnying gnyis ka (stod lung bde chen rdzong )ra ba smad dgon pa (gong dkar rdzong gi gshongs shang khongs )ra ba smad dgon pa (chu shur rdzong snye thang shang khongs )dwags po grwa tshang (gong dkar rdzong rnam rab ces pa'i sa yul du yod )gsang phu dgon pa ni stod lung bde chen rdzong gsang mda' shang khongs dang stod lung bde chen rdzong gsang mda' shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su spyi le bcu gcig tsam yod pa yin/24

skyor mo lung dgon pa/'dul 'dzin chen po thag ma ba'i bu chen sbal ti dgra bcom pas rab byung gsum pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1169lor phyag btab pa yin cing dga' ldan dgon pa phyag btab pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1409lo las/ lo sum brgyas snga ba yin/ de nas dus phyis rje tsong kha pa chen pos kyang 'dul ba'i bshad lam 'ga' zhig skyor mo lung dgon par slob gnyer gnang ba dang / sa phag spyi lo 1419lo'i ston mtshams su tsong kha pa chen po yang skyor mo lung dgon par thengs gcig phebs rjes ring min dga' ldan dgon du sku gshegs/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor skyor mo lung dgon par dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya dang sum cu so gnyis skor yod (grwa tshang khag gsum )'dul 'dzin thag ma ni stod lung mda'i thag ma lha khang gi nye skor la sku 'khrungs par mngon zhing thag ma 'bum pa zhes par sku gdung gi nang rten 'ga' zhig bzhugs par grags/sbal ti dgra bcom pa ni la dwags kyi sa phyogs sbal ti zhes par sku 'khrungs pa mngon zhing (spyi lo 1129da 1215)bar bzhugs/ skyor mo lung dgon pa spya /da lung bde chen rdzong sbyar rags shang khongs gzhong pa lha chu dang nye bar rmangs bkra shis chos sdings/rje sher 'byung ba'i slob ma ngag dbang bzang pos phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 169/lor btsun ma bzhi bcu zhe dgu skor/ rmangs bkra shes sdings ni stod lung bde chen rdzong dmar shang khongs dang / dmar zhes pa'i sa yul 'di ni bu ston chos 'byung khongs su lung pa dmar shakya mu ni/ bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung / 'jad pa gtsang rab gsal bcas mdo smad du byon te de nas ༷/la

ba'i bstan pa mdo smad nas slar gsos pa gsungs pa'i bo dong ni sa skya rdzong bo dong bkra shis sgang gi sa phyogs dang / 'jad rta nag ces da lta'i bzhad mthong smon rdzong rta nag phu mda'i phyogs nas byung ba yin/spar phu dgon/phagagru rdo rje rgyal po'i slob ma spar phu ba blo gros seng ges phyag btab/sa stag lor spar phu dgon par dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga lnga skor//sdo phu dgon pa ni stod lung bde chen rdzong dgu rum shang spar phu grong tshor mtshur phu dgon pa/kurma sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pas rab byung gsum pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1189lor phyag btab pa nas kurma bka' brgyud kyi mtha' ma'i gdan sa dbus su gtan 'khel ba yin/ mtshur phu dgon pa'i kurma zhwa nag sprul sku ni da lta'i sku phreng bcu bdun pa o rgyan rdo rje'i bar du sku phreng bcu bdun gyi skabs su slebs pa'o/ / gdan sa dang po kum po gnas nang (smar khams rdzong khongs )gdan sa gnyis pa kurma dgon (chab mdo rdzong khongs )gdan sa gsum pa mtshur phu dgon (stod lung bde chen rdzong snang mkhar shang khongs )snang mkhar nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le bdun tsam yod/mcho smad dgon/klu mes chen pos phyag btab cing ska ba shwakya dbang phyug gis rgyas par mardokā/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu re drug skor

yod/ mtsho smad dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong dmar shang khongs/ ska ba shākya dbang phyug ni jo bo rje a ti sha'i slob ma yin pa dang shing bya spyi lo 1045lor jo bo gdan 'dren zhu nye'i skabs kyi dbus kyi ston pa bcu gnyis kyi mtshan khongs su gsal ba yin/ra tshag dgon/bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi gras zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ ra tshag dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong yab mda' shang khongs dang / ra tshag ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog nas bshad na chu lug spyi lo 742lor bod kyi btsan po mes ag tshoms ra tshag tu bzhugs shing me sprel lo spyi lo 746lor ra tshag zhes par pho brang bskrun lugs bshad pa yin/ khungs zhig tun tong gi yig rigs khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod pa ra tshag gi nye 'gram 'di nas rdo ring che chung 'ga' zhig la yi ge ches mi gsal ba zhig ni mthong rgyu yod pa yin no/ /sdings ka dgon/yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1798lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga gnyis skor/ sdings py-i /gon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong chu bzang shang khongs sdings ka grong tshor nyan chu bzang dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes nyan phu bas phyag btab/ sa stag 2lha lo

yod/ mtsho smad dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong dmar shang khongs/ ska ba shākya dbang phyug ni jo bo rje a ti sha'i slob ma yin pa dang shing bya spyi lo 1045lor jo bo gdan 'dren zhu nye'i skabs kyi dbus kyi ston pa bcu gnyis kyi mtshan khongs su gsal ba yin/ra tshag dgon/bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi gras zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ ra tshag dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong yab mda' shang khongs dang / ra tshag ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog nas bshad na chu lug spyi lo 742lor bod kyi btsan po mes ag tshoms ra tshag tu bzhugs shing me sprel lo spyi lo 746lor ra tshag zhes par pho brang bskrun lugs bshad pa yin/ khungs zhig tun tong gi yig rigs khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod pa ra tshag gi nye 'gram 'di nas rdo ring che chung 'ga' zhig la yi ge ches mi gsal ba zhig ni mthong rgyu yod pa yin no/ /sdings ka dgon/yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1798lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga gnyis skor/ sdings py-i /gon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong chu bzang shang khongs sdings ka grong tshor nyan chu bzang dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes nyan phu bas phyag btab/ sa stag 2lha lo

1698lor btsun ma nyi shu rtsa gnyis skor/ nyan chu bzang dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong nyan zhes pa'i grong tshor yod/lam pa dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes chen po rin chen snying pos phyag btab/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor/ rin chen snying po ni dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes skabs jo bo rje a ti sha mnga' ris su phebs par bshad pa'i spyi lo 1022lor sku 'khrungs dgung lo gya lnga bzhugs/me sprel sbyi lo 1116lor sku goshegs/ lam pa dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong lam shang khongs su gnas yod/chu bzang dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob sher 'byung blo gros kyis phyag btab/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bdun cu skor yod/chu bzang dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong chu bzang shang khongs su gnas yod/cher gseb dgon/gsang phu'i bla ma yon tan tshul khrims kyis phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma bdun cu skor yod/ lnga pa chen po'i sku dus kyi lam pa dge bshes bsod nams grags pa yang tsher gseb tu bzhugs pa ni lnga pa chen po'i rnam thar khongs su 'khod pa dang deb dmar gsar ma'i rtsom pa po yang byin/ spyad lung tsher gseb ni stod lung bde chen rdzong lam pa shang dang cung ༷bye cad/

dga' gdong dgon pa/rje tsong kha pa chen po dang bla ma dbu ma ba gnyis gnas 'dir bzhugs myong ba ni rje'i rnam thar khongs su 'khod yod/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ dga' ba gdong dgon ni stod lung bde chen rdzong lha sa ar 'dam bzo grwa'i byang rgyab kyi sar yod cing bod kyi srung ma bzhi'i gras dga' gdong chos rje'i sku khog yang dga' gdong dgon du yod pa yin/ bod kyi srung ma bzhi zhes pa ni la mo tshangs pa dang gcigabasam yas chos skyong dang gnyis/ gnas chung chos skyong dang gsum/ khra 'brug chos skyong bcas bzhi yin pa ni lcang skya'i rnam thar las gsal/29

'dam gzhung rdzong khul gyi dgon khagayangs pa can dgon pa/bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa chos kyi grags pas rab byung brgyad pa'i chu phag spyi lo 1502lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di ni spyi lo 1792tsam la gzhung bzhes byas te kun bde gling bla brang nas 'dzin skyong byed lam byung ba dang / de'i rgyab ljongs ni zhwa dmar sku phreng bcu pa bskal bzang bde legs theg mchog 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug gis gor ṣa dang nang 'brel byas te gor dmag gis sa sprel spyi lo 17ra/lor bkra shis lhun po gtor bshig byas pa'i don rkyen tshabs chen zhig byung ba yin/ yangs ༵ sdu/ dgon pa ni 'dam gzhung rdzong grong rdal yangs pa can zer ba der yod gnam rtsed lding /dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang tsam la bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes ar chen po byang chub ye shes kyis bzung ba'i gnas gzhi gnam rtsed lding ni dus phyis su lcags sprul spyi lo 1409lor rje tsong kha pa chen po dang / lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang / rje btsun red mda' ba bcas chos rje rnam pa gsum gnam rtsed ldong du ar chen po byang chub ye shes kyi gtsug lag khang du phebs te dbyar zhal bzhes dang / dge 'dun drug brgya tsam la 'dul pa'i skor sogs chos mang du gsungs pa'i sa yul 'di tsam la 'khel pas da lta 'dasdu gzhung rdzong grong rdal yangs pa can gyi sa khongs su gtogs yod/

mal gro gung dkar rdzong khul gyi dgon khagargya ma rin chen sgang /bka' gdams kyi dge bshes dgyer sgom pa chen pos rab byung gnyis pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1119lor phyag btab/ dgon pa de ni rgya khyon che zhing lo rgyus zhib phra zhig rgya ma khu dpon gyi rnam thar khongs su 'khod yod/ rgya ma rin chen sgang ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong rgya ma shang rin chen sgang grong tshor gnas yod cang / lo rgyus thog gi rgya ma khri dpon gyi rgya ma khri khang zhes pa'i shul mal du da lta khri khang grong tsho zhes pa 'di yin/snon gyi dum bu ri ni/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes zla ba rgyan mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/hār+sha ༵ ḍi ṭ+wāṃ namal gro gung dkar rdzong rgya ma shang khongs rgya ma'i lung pa'i mdar 'bri gung mthil dgon pa/'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa dang po 'bri gung mthil dgon pa ni 'jig rten mgon pos rab byung gsum pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1179lor phyag btab pa yin/ de ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong ri mdo sgang shang khongs ri mdo sgang nas rtsis pa'i shar rgyud nye 'gram spyi le gcig tsam gyi sar gnapa sbyad/

'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po ni dge 'jo mda' rdzong ldan chos 'khor dgon nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos ha cang nye ba'i 'bri chu'i 'gram rgyud kyi tsong ngu zhes pa'i grong tsho 'dir 'khrungs pa yin/ /dbye bo dgon gsar/'jam dbyangs shākya rin chen pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu skor yod/ mal gro gung dkar rdzong gad la hor shang gi sa khongs nye 'khor zhig la 'khel gyin 'dug gad la hor ni snga dus 'bri gung dgon pa'i gzhis ka che gras dang dus phyis bstan rgyas gling /sna zhor 'dzin gnang myong pa'i rjes gzhis gnas chung kha'i gras su brtsi ba bya yul mang ra dgon/dbus stod bya yul mang dgon ni bka' gdams kyi dge bshes bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od kyis rab byung gnyis pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 1112lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ bya yul mang ra dgon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong nyi ma lcang ra shang khongs nyi ma lcang ra nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su spyi le bzhi tsam yod pa'i mang ra grong tshor yod cing nye dus rgya'i dpe deb la lar bya yul dgon ni lho kha lhun rtse rdzong bya yul la ngos 'dzin pa de ni dbus stod bya yul mang ra zhes 'gag rtsa'i rang bzhin de ni spyan du ma gzigs pa yin 'dug32

lha lung skyid spro dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po mal gro lha lung dgon du bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus rje'i rnam thar khongs su gsal zhing bod sa gnas kyi dpon rigs khyim tshang gras lha lung zur lce'i gzhis ga'i 'gram du 'khel bas mal gro gung dkar rdzong bya ra mdo shang lha lung grong tshor yod pa yin/khri ltag dgon/'bri gung spyan snga chos kyi rgyal pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so bdun skor yod/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po ni rje tsong kha pa chen po dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 1272lor 'bri gung du phebs te chos 'brel gsan myong ba'i dbus khul gyi bla ma thengs dang po ni 'bri gung spyan snga zhu ba de yin zhing de nas lo sum cu so drug tsam song rjes 'bri gung gi sa khongs su dga' ldan dgon phyag btab pa yin lags/ khri ltag dgon ni mal grong gung dkar rdzong rtsa zhol shang khri ltag grong tshor byung ba yin/33

lha lung skyid spro dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po mal gro lha lung dgon du bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus rje'i rnam thar khongs su gsal zhing bod sa gnas kyi dpon rigs khyim tshang gras lha lung zur lce'i gzhis ga'i 'gram du 'khel bas mal gro gung dkar rdzong bya ra mdo shang lha lung grong tshor yod pa yin/khri ltag dgon/'bri gung spyan snga chos kyi rgyal pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so bdun skor yod/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po ni rje tsong kha pa chen po dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 1272lor 'bri gung du phebs te chos 'brel gsan myong ba'i dbus khul gyi bla ma thengs dang po ni 'bri gung spyan snga zhu ba de yin zhing de nas lo sum cu so drug tsam song rjes 'bri gung gi sa khongs su dga' ldan dgon phyag btab pa yin lags/ khri ltag dgon ni mal grong gung dkar rdzong rtsa zhol shang khri ltag grong tshor byung ba yin/33

zhogs gur sngon dgon/zhogs gur sngon ni dpal chen sga los phyag btab cing dga' ldan khri thog nyi shu rtsa lnga pa rgyal khang rtse pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshos stag rtse rin chen sgang gi grwa rnying shul lus de dag zhogs gur sngon du spos te dgon pa slar gso mdzad/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu go gcig skor yod/ zhogs gur sngon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong thang skya shang khongs da lta grwa tshang zhes pa'i grong tsho 'dir byung ba yin/thang skya dgon/bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras klu mes chen pos zhig gsos gnang myong ba'i dgon pa zhig dang dus phyis thang skya dgon par sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ thang skya ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong thang skya shang khongs su yod/ nyi sdings chos sde phyag 'debs pa po sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis thang skya'i mchod khang gsar ma dang / lha sa'i skyid chu la thang skya'i lcags zam gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dus da lta'i bar bod spyod byed bzhin pa'i skabs yin/smyug dum dgon pa/bka' gdams pa dge bshes smyug dum pas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ mal gro gung dkar rdzong nyi ma lcang ra shang khongs nyi ma lcang ra nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams su spyi le bcu dgu tsam yod pa'i smyug rum nang zhes pa'i /nga tsho zhig yod pa dang sa ming 'di rigs ni lo rgyus thog byung zin pa

zhig yin stabs shul 'dzin byed dgos pa zhig yin/ smyug rum pa ni rab byung gnyis pa'i sa yos spyi lo 1099lor sku 'das pa yin/ zhwa lha khang /chos rgyal mnga' bdag khri ral gyi sku dus su nyang ting 'dzin bzang pos bzhengs pa'i dbu ru zhwa lha khang dang / zhwa lha khang gi nye 'gram du bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig yod pa yin/ zhwa lha khang ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong nyi ma lcang ra shang khongs nyi ma lcang ra nas rtsis lho rgyud nye 'gram spyi le gnyis tsam gyi sar gnas yod pa yin/gam gam dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes khrom gzher ba rin chen seng gis rab byung gnyis pa'i me sbrul spyi lo 1127lor phyag btab pa'i kum dgon ni da lta'i mal gro gung dkar rdzong thang skya shang khongs bang skya nas rtsis pa'i byang shar mtshams spyi le bzhi tsam yod pa'i kum kum grong tshor yod pa yin/klung shod 'ba' tshag chos sde/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma rgyal mtshan grags bzang pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ de ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong klung shod shang du yod pa dang klung shod ni lha sa skyid chu'i stod rgyud klung shod gtsang po'i nye rgyud du yod/35

klung shod dpal 'bar dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma bsod nams rin chen gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ klung shod ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong klung shod nang du yod/klung shod spyil bu dgon/gnyal smad kyi se khun pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe bzhi skor yod/deb ther chos 'byung la lar bka' gdams kyi dge bshes se spyil zhes pa de ni se khun pa dang spyil bu ba gnyis bsdus te bris pa zhig yin/ klung shod ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong klung shod nang du yod cing 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas phod mdo'i sa yul nas stag lung sangs rgyas yar byon gdan 'dren zhu bar btang bas sangs rgyas yar byon tshogs su byon na nga 'ong mi byon na nged klung shod du 'gro ba yin gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas yar byon bla g.yel thang la byon/ mjal 'phrad gnang ba dang skabs 'di'i klung shod ni phod mdo nas lha sa bar gyi lam tshugs dum bu zhig 'khel ba'i don yin/ska tshal lha khang /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang gras dbu ru ska tshal lha khang ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong bya ra mdo shang khongs ska tshal grong tshor yod cing / da lam bu ston chos 'byung khongs su ka la sa mgo can gyi ska tshaX spyas gsal pa ltar bris pa yin zhing dus phyis 'bri gung ba'i mnga' 'og tu

lo brgya phrag bzhi lnga tsam 'bri gung nas bdag gnyer gnang ba yin/'od sna chos sde/chos rje mgon po ye shes kyis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa drug skor yod/ 'od sna chos sde ni klung shod 'od sna'i lcags zam gyi nye 'gram du yod cing da lta'i mal gro gung dkar rdzong klung shod chu rgyud du yod pa dang klung shod ni lha sa'i skyid chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu'i dum bu zhig 'khel ba yin/rin chen gling /byang sems dge 'dun rin chen gyis rab byung bdun pa'i me sprel spyi lo 1416lor phyag btab pa yin stabs chos sde chen po 'bras spungs dang dus mnyam yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bdun cu don drug skor yod/ rin chen gling ni lo rgyus thog khams bod kyi 'grul lam dang da lta'i khron bod gzhung lam 'khel pa'i sa yul yin/ rin chen gling dgon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong rin chen gling shang sa khul du yod/klung shod byams pa gling /drung tshul bkras pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor/ klung shod ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong rtsa zhol /rdo //sna dang lha sa skyid chu'i stod rgyud kyi chu bo la klung shod gtsang po zer 37

rgyal bzang dgon/dus phyis spyi lo 15〈〈gong tsam la 'bras srungs dga' ldan pho brang gi bla brang gi dgon lag gras yin/ de ni mal grong gung dkar rdzong rgyal bzang shang gi sa yul du yod cing de sngon lo rgyus thog khams bod gzhung lam dang nye dus kyi khron bod gzhung lam gnyis ka rgyal bzang rgyud nas gzhung lam 'khel gyin 'dug /mkhar skya dgon/phag gru'i gong ma tshes gnyis rin po che ngag gi dbang po'i sku dus su phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu gya gnyis skor yod/ tshes gnyis rin po che ngag gi dbang po ni (spyi lo 1429 1490)bar bzhugs pa'i phag gru'i srid rabs brgyad pa yin/ mkhar skya dgon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong bkra shis sgang shang mkhar skya grong tshor yod cing de sngon lo rgyus thog lha sa nas chos 'khor rgyal du 'gro ba'i lam yang 'khel ba yin/spang sa dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho spang sa dgon du bzhugs shing sku gdung rin po che yang spang sa dgon du yod pa yin/spang sa dgon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong bkra shes sgang shang khongs spang sa grong tshor yod/ yig cha'i 'byung khungs spyi lo 1498lor btsams pa'i spyan snga choX /byung bris ma zhig la gzhi byas te bris pa yin/ spyan snga ni phag gru spyan snga

rin po che bsod nams rgyan mtshan la ngos 'dzin dgos pa yin/cha dkar dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma lha gzigs grags pa rgya mtshos phyag btab/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis skor/ cha )/kā/gon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong bya ra mdo shang khongs cha dkar grong chos 'khor sgang /stag phu go skyi dpal ldan don grub kyis chos 'khor dar rgyas su mdzad/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu skor yod/ chos 'khor hā/ ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong bya ra mdo shang khongs chos 'khor sgang grong tshor ru thog dgon pa/tshalagung thang bla ma zhang gi slob ma rtogs ldan bde ba gzhon nus phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun skor yod/ ru thog dgon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong ru thog shang khongs dang de sngon gyi khams bod gzhung lam dang da lta'i khron bod gnyis ka ru thog dgon par 'khel pa yin zhing ru thog ni 'brog sde shas che ba'i 'brog pa'i ru sde cung mang ba'i sa khul zhig yin/39

lhun grub rdzong khul gyi dgon khagarwa sgreng dgon pa/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rab byung dang po'i me bya spyi lo 1057lor phyag btab pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa snga shos gras shig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya sum cu so gnyis skor yod/ rwa sgreng dgon pa ni 'phan po lhun sgrub rdzong thang 'go shang khongs su yod cing thang 'go zhes pa'i go don ni rwa sgreng dgon pa'i pha bong thang zhes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas gzhi yin par grags pa'i thang de'i bsdus ming du chags pa thang 'go zhes pa'i khongs su 'khel ba yin/ nang don gyi 'grel bshad shin tu rgyas pa zhig ni ka thog si tu'i dbus gtsang gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/rgyal lha khang /'brom ston gyi bla ma sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis rab byung dang po'i gong gi drug cu skor de'i chu byi spyi lo 1022lor phyag btab pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa snga shos gras shig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod/ rgyal lha khang ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong lha khang shang khongs lha khang zhes pa'i grong tshor yod cing dus phyis dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gnas der zhib 'jug mdzad pa'i 'bras bu'i nang do/ sduga' zhig dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom deb dang po'i khongs su

lhun grub rdzong khul gyi dgon khagarwa sgreng dgon pa/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rab byung dang po'i me bya spyi lo 1057lor phyag btab pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa snga shos gras shig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya sum cu so gnyis skor yod/ rwa sgreng dgon pa ni 'phan po lhun sgrub rdzong thang 'go shang khongs su yod cing thang 'go zhes pa'i go don ni rwa sgreng dgon pa'i pha bong thang zhes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas gzhi yin par grags pa'i thang de'i bsdus ming du chags pa thang 'go zhes pa'i khongs su 'khel ba yin/ nang don gyi 'grel bshad shin tu rgyas pa zhig ni ka thog si tu'i dbus gtsang gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/rgyal lha khang /'brom ston gyi bla ma sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis rab byung dang po'i gong gi drug cu skor de'i chu byi spyi lo 1022lor phyag btab pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa snga shos gras shig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod/ rgyal lha khang ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong lha khang shang khongs lha khang zhes pa'i grong tshor yod cing dus phyis dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gnas der zhib 'jug mdzad pa'i 'bras bu'i nang do/ sduga' zhig dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom deb dang po'i khongs su

'khod yod/stag lung dgon pa/stag lung bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dang po byang stag lung dgon ni phag gru'i slob ma stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal gyis rab byung gsum pa'i lcags byi spyi lo 1180lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dge 'dun gyi 'du tshogs mang ba'i dus skabs su dge 'dun zhal grangs sum stong tsam 'dus par grags shing zhib phra'i lo rgyus stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis spyi lo 160khas bya lor bcoms pa'i stag lung chos 'byung zhes pa da lta par bskrun zin pa zhig yod pa yin/ stag lung dgon ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong stag lung shang khongs su yod pa yin/po to dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes po to bas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma bzhi bcu skor yod/ po to dgon / ༵༵na po lhun grub rdzong grub rgyal shang khongs po to zhes pa'i sa khul du yod glo ba stod dgon pa/nang rten byams pa spun gsum sogs yod/ glo ba stod dgon pa ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong tshong 'dus shang khongs tshong 'dus nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs spyi le drug tsam gyi sar gnas/41

spos dkar dgon/'phan po lhun grub rdzong dga' ldan chos 'khor shang khongs dang dga' /nā /sa 'khor nas rtsis pa'i byang phyogs kyi mtshams su spyi le gsum tsam yod gsal khang dgon/lha gsal khang pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bcu bdun skor yod/ci gsal khang ni snga dus sa cha'isras mkhar dang sras khang nang pa sogs 'bri srol yod pa dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin/ gsal khang dgon ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong dpal 'byor gling shang khongs gsal khang grong tshor yod pa yin/'od 'jo dgon/bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes stabs ka pa chen pos 'od 'jo khra phu stabs ka bcas dgon pa khag gsum phyag btab pa nas slob ma'i dus su 'od 'jo longs spyod kyi sgang / khra phu chos kyi sgang / stabs ka grwa sa'i sgang zhes dar rgyas che ba byung par grags shing 'od 'jo ni lhun grub rdzong stag lung shang khongs stag lung mdar 'khel ba dang / khra phu ni lhun grub rdzong khongs dang / stabs ka ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs su yod pa yin/ (yig cha'i khungs tshal pa'i deb ther dmar po )stabs ka pa chen po ni spyi lo 1974shing rta lor sku 'das pa yin/42

sho ma ra'i gtsug lag khang /byang stag lung dgon pa'i gdan sa dang po stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal gyis sho ma ra'i gtsug lag khang du bsnyen rdzogs dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes pa'i gnas gzhi zhig yin/ de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong dbu ru lung shang khongs sho ma ra'i grong tshor yod/ stag lung thang pa chen pos lcags byi spyi lo 1180lor byang stag lung dgon pa phyag btab pa yin/ (yig cha'i khungs stag lung chos 'byung lcags par shog grangs 217nas drangs pa yin/)'bab rom dgon/'bab rol pa dar ma dbang phyug gis rab byung gsum pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1152lor phyag btab pa'i 'bab rom bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dang po yin/ 'bab rom dgon ni grong khyer lha sa'i khongs lhun grub rdzong gi thang 'go shang gi 'bab rom mtsho dang 'bab rom la'i nye 'dabs su yod cing thang 'go shang gi sa yul 'dir rwa sgrong dgon pa yod cing rwa sgreng dgon dang ha cang nye bar yod pa yin/ 'bab rom pa dar ma dbang phyug ni (spyi lo 1127da 1179)bar dgung lo bdun cu don gsum bzhugs/lan pa spyil bu/bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras lan pa spyil bu ni lhun grub rdzong ra shang lan pa grong tshor yod pa yin/ 43

khra phu dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes stabs ka chen pos khra phu dgon/ 'od 'jo dgon/ stabs ka dgon bcas dgon pa gsum phyag btab/ de nas slob ma'i dus su dar rgyas su phyin te khra phu chos kyi dgon/ 'od 'jo longs spyod kyi sgang / stabs ka grwa ba'i sgang zhes rgya khyab tu grags so/ / khra phu dgon ni lhun grub rdzong yung ba shang khra phu grong tsho dang / 'od 'jo dgon ni lhun grub rdzong stag lung shang stag lung mda' 'khel/ stabs ka dgon ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs su yod pa yin/'jog pa dgon/shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mkhas grub khyung po rnam 'byor gyis phyag btab pa'i shang pa bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni lhun grub rdzong grub rgyal shang khongs grub rgyal shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su spyi le brgyad tsam yod/nyan po dgon/lhun grub rdzong bye ma shang khongs nyan chu'i rgyud kyi nyan po grong tshor yod/glang thang dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge gshes glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ges rab byung gnyis pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1092lor phyag btab/ de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong grub rgyal shang khongs glang thang grong tshor yod/44

na leṇ+ḍa dgon pa/(chos lugs skya pa )shar rgyal mo rong pa rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan gyis 'phan po'i sa yul du na lan+d+ra'i dgon pa phyag btab pa yin zhing da lta'i 'phan po lhun grub rdzong bye ma shang khongs bco brgyad ces pa'i grong tsho'i sa yul 'dir 'khel ba dang / bco brgyad ni na lan+d+ra'i dgon pa'i bco brgyad bla brang byung ba'i shul mal yin/ dus phyis kyi byung ba 'ga' zhig ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig la gzigs par zhu/ na lan+d+ra'i dgon pa phyag btab par dus rabs thad rab byung bdun pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1425lo yin pa dang rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan (spyi lo 1267da 1449)bar bzhugs/mkhar thog dgon pa/spyi lo 1105shing bya lor bka' gdams kyi dge bshes po to ba yang mkhar thog dgon du rgyun ring tsam bzhugs tshul bka' gdams chos 'byung sogs su 'khod pa'i mkhar thog dgon ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong gi ngar nang shang khongs ngar nang shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud spyi le gsum tsam yod cing lo rgyus thog gna' dus kyi mkhar rdzong dang 'brel ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ ngar zhes pa'i go don ni klung shod gtsang po'i nye rgyud 'di la bdag tu ma bzung sdu/ /can gzan mang po ngar sgra sgrog pa'i sa yul 'dir yang ming de ltar du gro sa dgon/'dul 'dzin chen po thag ma ba'i bu chen rnal 'byor seng gis phyag btab pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon rnying zhig yin/ dus phyis sa phag4 k+to lo

1419lor rje tsong kha pa chen pos rje dge 'dun grub pa gro sa dgon du 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs la slob gnyer mdzad par gtong gnang mdzad pa dang / de nas grong sa dgon du 'dul gzhung la slob gnyer mdzad bzhin pa'i skabs su rje tsong kha pa sku 'das lugs gsan pa bcas dge 'dun grub pa'i rnam thar khongs su 'khod yod/ gro sa dgon ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong khongs su yod cing nye dus kyi dpe deb la laragro sa dgon la gro pa dgon zhes bris pa de ni dag cha'i dpyad khungs med pa zhig yin/'brom steng /nyan po shākya rin chen pas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig se ra theg chen gling gi thog ma'i grwa tshang stod pa dang smad pa gnyis dang rgya (rgya rigs kyi grwa btsun )'brom steng bcas bzhi byung ba'i 'brom steng ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong khongs su yod cing nyan po ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong gi nyan chu'i rgyud du 'khel pa'i grong tsho zhig gi ming yin/rin chen brag dgon pa/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga dgu skor yod pa yin/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i sku dus su 'phan po'i phyogs 'di stag lung dgon pa'i mnga' khongs yin zhing skabs der 'phan po phyogs su dge lugs pa'i dgon pa byung ba'i gras snga shos zhig yin/ rin chen brag ni lhun grub rdzong 'phan po stod phyogs kyi rin chen brag grong tshor yod cing de sngon lo /sdu thog rwa sgreng nas lha sa bar gyi gzhung lam gyi lam tshugs zhig 'khel ba

yin/khro mo brag gi mgon khang / spyi lo 1076lor me 'brug chos 'khor zhes mnga' bdag rtse ldes sbyin bdag zhus pa'i chos 'khor du byon myong pa'i gnyan lo tsā ba gnas gzhi dang sgrub gnas khyad mtshar zhig yod pa yin/ de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong bye ma shang dang nye bar yod cing 'di'i 'byung rabs mdor bsdus zhig khro mo brag gi slong yig zhig la gzhi byas te bris pa yin/

yin/khro mo brag gi mgon khang / spyi lo 1076lor me 'brug chos 'khor zhes mnga' bdag rtse ldes sbyin bdag zhus pa'i chos 'khor du byon myong pa'i gnyan lo tsā ba gnas gzhi dang sgrub gnas khyad mtshar zhig yod pa yin/ de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong bye ma shang dang nye bar yod cing 'di'i 'byung rabs mdor bsdus zhig khro mo brag gi slong yig zhig la gzhi byas te bris pa yin/

gzhis rtse khul gyi dgon khagazhwa lu dgon pa/bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras lce btsun gyis chu yos spyi lo 1002lor phyag btab lugs kyi lo khams cung gsal ba zhig ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod cing dus phyis sa lug spyi lo 1919lor zhwa lu dgon par dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor bzhugs lugs kyi skor ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/ zhwa lu dgon pa ni gzhis ka rtse'i mnga' khongs rgya mtsho gzhung shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams spyi le dgu tsam gyi sa'i cha zhwa lu grong tshor yod/zhwa lu ri sbyagazhwa lu ri sbug tu jo bo a ti sha'i sgrub chu dwangs la zhim pa dang khor yug gi sa yul skyid la spro nyams 'phel pa'i dben gnas kyi ri khrod zhig yin zhing dus phyis su bu ston rin chen grub (spyi lo 1291—1264)bar gnas der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs shing rgyun ring bzhugs pa yin/ zhwa lu dgon pa dang zhwa ༵ trī /ga gnyis ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i rgya mtsho gzhung shang khongs su yod snar bang dgon pa/48bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes gtum gnyen gyis rab byung gsum pa'i

chu bya spyi lo 1152lor phyag btab pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis snar thang dpar gzhi'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gnyis ka yang snar thang dgon du yod pa 'di ni dbus gtsang khul du byung pa'i bka' bstan 'gyur gyi par gzhi snga shos su byung ba de yin/ snar thang dgon ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs chu mig shang gi khongs dang / lo rgyus thog me byi spyi lo 1276lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas dbus gtsang gi dge 'dun khri phrag bdun tsam la chos 'khor bskor pa'i chu mig chos 'khor chen mo yang chu mig shang gi sa yul 'di la byung ba yin no/ /bkra shis lhan po/rgyal ba sku phreng dang po rje dge 'dun grub pa'i dpal gyis rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos spyi lo 1447lor phyag btab cing mdo sngags grwa tshang khag bzhi la spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis stong lnga brgya skor yod/rje dge 'dun grub pa ni sa skya rdzong srad shang khongs gur me zhes pa'i 'brog pa'i ru sde'i khrod du sku 'khrungs shing gur ni sa skya'i srung ma gur mgon dang /gur mgon la mchod me'i thebs rtsa'i dmigs sgor ru khag zhig byung ba yin zhes rgan rabs kyi ngag rgyun zhig 'dug bkra shes lhun po ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i nye 'gram du yod pa yin/gangs can chos 'phel dgon/bkra shes lhun po'i khri thog gnyis pa paṇa chen bzang po bkra shes kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ gangs can chos 'phel dgon ni bkra shes lhun po'i nub rgyud stag la zhes pa'i la chung zhig dang nye ba'i da lta'i sa sdi /nga

brag mjug shang khongs gangs can grong tshor yod pa yin/zur gsang sngags gling /de sngon bod kyi lo rgyus rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi so zur gnubs gsum zhes grags pa'i nang gses gnyis pa zur lugs kyi dgon pa zur gsang sngags gling ni da lta'i gzhis ka rtse'i rgya mtsho gzhung shang khongs rgya mtsho nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos sbyi le lnga tsam yod pa'i da lta gsang sngags gling zhes 'bod pa'i grong tsho 'dir byung ba yin zhing gnubs ni rin spungs rdzong gnubs khu lung zhes pa'i sa yul de rang la yin pa ngos 'dzin dgos/gdong dkar ri bo mdangs can dgon/rgyal ba sku phreng dang po rje dge 'dun grub pa'i bka' ltar gdong dkar ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu go bzhi skor yod/ gdong dkar ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse gdong dkar shang gi sa khul du yod/'ug pa gling /snga 'gyur rnying ma'i gdan sa chen po zur 'ug pa lung ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs spen gzhung shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud spyi le lnga tsam gyi sar zhug pa gling grong tshor byung ba yin zhing yig cha'i dpyad khungs ni 〈'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i gsung rtsom gces sgrig 〉ces pa'i lcags par shog grangs 216nas btus/50

bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas ga: /zlo lha/na gyi ba se thang dang bye gling sogs byung ba yin/ bye gling ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i lhan shang bye gling grong tsho dang bye gling du mkhas grub chos rje rgyun thung tsam bzhugs pa yin 'dugangor dgon pa/sa skya'i chos lugs kyi ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos spyi lo 1429sa bya lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis spyi lo 1924shing khyi lor bod kyi mkhas dbang chen po dge 'dun chos 'phel zhib 'jug gnang bar phebs skabs dgon 'dir rgya dpe pod che chung bzhi bcu tsam gzigs tshul dang dgon pa 'di ni khams pa shin tu mang ba'i stobs kyis kun mkhyen go ram pa'i zhal shugs de yang da dung cung zad gson pa ltar yod ces gsungs pa yin/ ngor dgon pa ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i chu mig shang nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos ha cang nye bar yod pa yin/gtsang 'gram lha khang /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang gras gtsang 'gram lha khang ni da lta'i grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs lcags thang shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams spyi le bcu gcig tsam yod pa'i lha khang grong tsho zhes pa 'di yin zhing gtsang 'gram ni yar lung gtsang po'i 'gram rgyud du 'khel ba'i don yin/51

bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas ga: /zlo lha/na gyi ba se thang dang bye gling sogs byung ba yin/ bye gling ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i lhan shang bye gling grong tsho dang bye gling du mkhas grub chos rje rgyun thung tsam bzhugs pa yin 'dugangor dgon pa/sa skya'i chos lugs kyi ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos spyi lo 1429sa bya lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis spyi lo 1924shing khyi lor bod kyi mkhas dbang chen po dge 'dun chos 'phel zhib 'jug gnang bar phebs skabs dgon 'dir rgya dpe pod che chung bzhi bcu tsam gzigs tshul dang dgon pa 'di ni khams pa shin tu mang ba'i stobs kyis kun mkhyen go ram pa'i zhal shugs de yang da dung cung zad gson pa ltar yod ces gsungs pa yin/ ngor dgon pa ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i chu mig shang nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos ha cang nye bar yod pa yin/gtsang 'gram lha khang /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang gras gtsang 'gram lha khang ni da lta'i grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs lcags thang shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams spyi le bcu gcig tsam yod pa'i lha khang grong tsho zhes pa 'di yin zhing gtsang 'gram ni yar lung gtsang po'i 'gram rgyud du 'khel ba'i don yin/51

gser mdog can dgon pa/(thub bstan gser mdog can dgon pa )sa skya'i bla ma paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyis rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1469lor phyag btab pa'i sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa cung che gras zhig yin/ gser mdog can ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs spen gzhung shang gi sa yul du yod cing nang rten ji yod skor ka thog si tu'i gnas yig tsam las de min gyi dpyad khungs ches dkon pa zhig 'dugasnar thang dgon pa'i gdan gā rdo zlog/ pa seng ge skyabs zhes pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/rgyal dbang sku phreng dang po rje dge 'dun grub pas byang chen gyi gnas gzhi 'dir me 'brug spyi lo 1426lor theg chen pho brang zhes pa'i gzim khang gsar du bskrun zhing rgyun ring tsam bzhugs de nas lo ngo bcu gcig song rjes rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos spyi lo 1447lor chos sde chen po bkra shing lhun po phyag btab pa yin no/ / byang chen ni snar thang dgon pa'i nye logs zhig la 'khel ba yin/rgyal chen rtse chos sde/rin spungs pa'i bdag mo dpon ba bu 'dren bdag mos phyag btab par grags shing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don gsum skor yod/ rgyal chen rtse ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs ri gnāshā shang rgyal chen grong tshor yod/

ba so chos sde/dga' ldan khri rabs drug pa ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan (spyi lo 1404da 1472)bar rgyun ring bzhugs pa'i lhan ba so chos sde ni lhan gser sgrub pa mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten ba so chos sder grags/ ba so chos sder sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi skye sprul rim byon la ba so rje drung / rta tshag rje drung / kun bde gling rta tshag ho thog thu bcas dus rabs 'dra min re la mtshan zur cung mi 'dra ba gsum byung ba yin no/ / ba so chos sde ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs lhan shang ba so grong tshor yod/ /dben sa dgon/(dben sa chos kyi pho brang yang zer )mkhas grub rje'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams phyogs kyis glang pos phyag btab pa'i dben sa snyan brgyud kyi gnas dben dgon ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i lcags thang shang khongs lcags thang shang nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le brgyad tsam yod pa'i lha khud ces pa'i grong tshor yod pa ni dper na be+e ser lcags par shog grangs 221par lha khud kyi dben sa chos sde zhes pa'i be+e ser lcags par ma 'di'i sa khongs su lha khud la lha skud ces dang dben sa la dben rtsa zhes lcags par thog nor 'khrul byung 'dug dben sa dgon ni dben sa pa blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas/ paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa'i bar bkra shis lhun po'i dgon lag che gras su brtsi ba yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dben sa dgon pa'i dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod/ 53
