phung po ri bo che bdud dpung zil gnon gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug spyi lo 1679lor gsar tu btsugs pa phung po ri bo che bdud dpung zil gnon gling ni rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi grwa tshang zhig yin/ de ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i sa khongs lcags thang shang khongs lcags thang shang nas rtsis pa'i shar phyogs spyi le brgyad tsam yod pa'i ri bo che grong tshor yod/g.yang chos sde/g.yang pa chos rje grags pa bsam 'grub pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ g.yang zhes pa'i sa yul 'di ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i khongs su yod cing lo rgyus thog g.yang pa chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar zhig yod pa yin no/ /pan nor bu dpal chen/rnying ma'i bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gis bzhengs pa'i lha khang dang / sa skya'idagon pa che gras thub bstan gser mdog can yang 'dir yod pa de ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i khongs pan gzhung shang zhes pa'i sa yul du yod/54

sa skya rdzong khul gyi dgon khag sa skya dgon pa/sa skya'i bla ma 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos rab byung dang po'i chu glang spyi lo 1072lor phyag btab pa'i sa skya'i chos lugs kyi gnas sa dang po de yin/sa skya'i lha khang chen mo/bodakyi lo rgyus thog skad grags che ba'i sa skya'i lha khang chen mo ni sa skya dgon pa'i phyag btab nas mi lo brgya phrag gcig dang dgu bcu go grangs zhig song rjes rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang spyi lo 1265lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bka' ltar sa skya'i dpon chen shākya bzang pos bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi yul mi bskul slong byas te thog mar 'dzugs bskrun byed rgyu'i 'go tshugs te lo ngo drug dang de nas dpon chen kun dga' bzang pa'i sku dus su ar las las rgyun lo ngo drug tsam bcas lo bcu gnyis tsam gyi ring la gsar bskrun gnang ba yin/ sa skya'i lha khang chen mo ni chu shur rdzong tshal pa nang shang khongs gyi re lha pa'i lha khang la dpe byas te bzhengs pa ni dpyad khungs mdor bsdus zhig yod pa yin/khro phu dgon pa/rab byung gsum pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1171lor phyag btab pa'i khro phu bka' brgyud kyi gnas sa dang po de yin zhing de nas rab byung bzhi ༵༵ chu

sbrel spyi lo 1212lor khro phu lo tsā bas khro phu'i byams chen gyi gser sku chen po dbus gtsang nang snga shos kyi byams chen bzhengs shing kha che paṇa chen gyis rab gnas gnang ba dang / nang rten zhib phra 'khod pa ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig rang las gzhan cher med/ khro phu dgon pa ni sa skya rdzong dge sdings shang khongs dge sdings nas rtsis pa'i shar rgyud thad kur spyi le bzhi tsam gyi sar khro mda' dang khro phu gnyis las khro phur yod pa yin/khro phu byams chen/rab byung gsum pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1171lor 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa'i slob ma rin chen mgon gyis khro phu dgon pa phyag btab te gnas gzhi bzung ba de nas khro phu bka' brgyud byung 'go tshugs pa yin/ khro phu dgon pa'i nang rten gyi rten gtso khro phu byams chen ni khro phu'i lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal ( 1172—1225) gyis rab byung bzhi pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1212lor gser zangs kyi byams chen mtho tshad mi'i gzhu 'dom nyi shu dang khru brgya bcu tsam yod pa zhig bzhengs shing kha che paṇa chen shākya shris rab gnas gnangaba'i rten bshad cung zhib tsam 'khod pa zhig ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig tu gsal/ kha che paṇa chen ni spyi lo 1204da 1214bar du dbus gtsang khul du bzhugs pa yin/kha'u brag rdzong /sa skya'i srung ma dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa gnas 'dir thim par grags pa'i mgon khang zhig gi ming yin/ khu'i skyid lha sa nas yin yar 'brog khri dpon ag len gyi thog ma'i mi khungs 'di nas mched lugs lnga pa chen po'i raX /ma yod pa dang po'i khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod pa yin/ kha'u ni sa skya

rdzong gi shar lho'i mtshams kha'u chu tshan gyi nye rgyud du 'khel ba yin/ /dge rings/ shab chu'i rgyud kyi dge sdings chos kyi pho brang zhes sa skya'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhugs gnas 'ga' zhig yod pa yin/ dge sdings ni sa skya rdzong dge sdings shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/sa skya'i gdan sa gong 'og gnyis/gdan sa gong ma ni 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos rab byung dang po'i chu glangasbyi lo 1072lor sa skya'i gtsug lag khang phyag btab pas da lta'i sa skya rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod pa dang / gdan sa 'og ma ni dus phyis dus mchod bla brang gi bla ma rtse gdong zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bkra shis kyis rtse gdong chos sde srid gsum rnam rgyal btab pa nas gdan sa gong 'og gnyis su gyur cing dus phyis chu lug spyi lo 1702bar bu yar rgyas che ba byung bzhin pa'i skabs rgyal po lha bzang gis rtse gdong dgon par dmag drangs te gtor ba nas nyams dmas su 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs/ rtse gdong dgon ni rnam gling rdzong shang chu'i mdor rtse gdong shang gi sa yul du 'khel ba yin/chos 'khor lhun po/sa skya'i bla ma gzhung brgya pa dngos grub dpal ba'i gdan sa yin pa dang sa lug spyi lo 1919lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ chos 'khor lhun po ni sa skya rdzong khongs nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs ha cang nye ba'i sar yod/ (ka thog si tu'i gnas yig nas btus pa yin)57

rog tsho chos sde bsam 'grub dgon/rog tsho chos mdzad kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so drug skor yod/ rog tsho zhes pa ṭī sna skya rdzong bkra shes sgang shang khongs kyi rog tsho zhes pa'i grong tshor yod pa srad nor bu chos 'phel/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1645lor gsar tu btsugs pa'i srad nor bu chos 'phel sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu skor yod/ srad ni sa skya rdzong srad shang gi sa yul du yod/seng ge rtse chos sde/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma rje shes rab seng gis dge lugs su bsgyur ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga gsum skor yod/ seng ge rtse ni sa skya rdzong shab chu'i nye rgyud 'khel pa'i sa skya rdzong gzhung ma shang khongs seng ge rtse grong tshor yod cing seng hā / ni lo rgyus thog sde pa seng ge rtse pa'i mkhar rdzong byung myong ba'i sa yul de dzin po rtse chos n+de/lha rtse rdzong gi sa khongs bo dong e 'brog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phyaX zlotab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs

brgya dang dgu bcu go drug skor yod/ lhun po rtse chos sde ni sa skya rdzong shab chu'i rgyud kyi shab stod kyi sa'i char 'khel ba yin/ shel dkar chos lung /brel grong pa snam gsal bas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma bzhi bcu zhe brgyad skor yod/shel dkar ni sa skya rdzong sle'u shang khongs shel dkar grong tsho dang mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gro shod bar du dpung bskul la phyin skabs shel dkar gyi sa yul 'di ni lam 'khel gyi grong tsho zhig yod pa de yin/59

skyid grong rdzong khul gyi dgon khagabrag dkararta so/rje btsun mi la ras pa'i sgrub phug zhig yin pa dang brag dkar rta so'i dkar gong phug ni rdo dkar gong las grub pa dang de byings kyi brag ni nag zho gcig las grub tshul gyi gnas bshad mdor bsdus shig dga' bzhi pa'i rgyun brjod lcags par shog grangs 51〈par gsal 'khod byung 'dug cing brag dkar rta so ni skyid grong rdzong dga' shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud spyi le nyi shu rtsa drug tsam yod/ mi la ras pa'i 'khrungs yul ni da lta'i skyid grong rdzong gung thang shang gi sa yul 'di tsam la 'khel ba yin/ brag dkar rta so ni stag lung thang pa'i slob ma rtogs ldan rna ral bas grwa pa bdun cu tsam skyong tshul skor stag lung chos 'byung khongs su 'khod pa yang yod pa yin/rdzong dga' dga' ldan yun po/khriram rgyal ldes phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ rdzong dga' dga' ldan lhun po ni skyid grong rdzong gi rdzong dga' shang gi sa yul du yod pa yin/me tog mdangs can/66skyid grong rdzong grong brdal skyid grong nas rtsis pa'i nub byang ngos spyi le lnga

tsam gyi 'gyangs thag yod cing me tog mdangs can ni de sngon lo rgyus thog gi dgon pa zhig yin/ skyid grong gi sa yul 'di ni dbyar dgun me tog khra 'chil bzhad pa'i mdzes ljongs gras shig yin/skyid grong bsam gtan gling /skyid grong rdzong gung thang shang khongs de sngon gyi skyid grong rdzong rnying pa'i sa yul skyid grong shang pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam gyi 'gyangs thag yod/ dus phyis dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan yang skyid grong bsam gtan gling du bzhugs te dgung lo zhe bzhir bsam gtan gling nyams gso gnang / dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan ni (spyi lo 1712)nas chu glang bar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig bzhugs/ )mang yul byams sprin lha khang /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i mang yul byams sprin ni gzhis ka rtse sakhul skyid grong rje grong gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/ mang yul ni seng ge kha 'bab kyi nub rgyud zangs dkar sog ngos 'dzin dgos pa ni 〈lho rong chos 'byung 〉shog grangs 724la gzigs par zhu/61

tsam gyi 'gyangs thag yod cing me tog mdangs can ni de sngon lo rgyus thog gi dgon pa zhig yin/ skyid grong gi sa yul 'di ni dbyar dgun me tog khra 'chil bzhad pa'i mdzes ljongs gras shig yin/skyid grong bsam gtan gling /skyid grong rdzong gung thang shang khongs de sngon gyi skyid grong rdzong rnying pa'i sa yul skyid grong shang pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam gyi 'gyangs thag yod/ dus phyis dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan yang skyid grong bsam gtan gling du bzhugs te dgung lo zhe bzhir bsam gtan gling nyams gso gnang / dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan ni (spyi lo 1712)nas chu glang bar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig bzhugs/ )mang yul byams sprin lha khang /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i mang yul byams sprin ni gzhis ka rtse sakhul skyid grong rje grong gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/ mang yul ni seng ge kha 'bab kyi nub rgyud zangs dkar sog ngos 'dzin dgos pa ni 〈lho rong chos 'byung 〉shog grangs 724la gzigs par zhu/61

khang dmar rdzong khul gyi dgon khagaganas rnying dgon pa/khri srong lde btsan dang blon po 'gos kyi bla ma rgya 'jam dpal gsang bas phyag btab cing gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus su tsong kha pa chen pos gnas rnying du mdzad/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen yang gnas rnying nye skor du sku 'khrungs shing sku na chung ngu'i dus der rten rgyal tshab chos rje dgung na ches smin pa'i skabs su mkhas grub rje dang mnyam du thengs mang byon/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor gnas rnying grwa tshang khag bzhi la dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang gnas rnying dgon ni gzhis ka rtse sa khul khang dmar rdzong gi gnas rnying shang khongs su yod pa/rlangs pa gser gling /brag dkar rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 169〈lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi cu zhe drug skor yod/ rlangs pa gser gling ni khang dmar rdzong sa phug sgang shang khongs yod pa dang gro mo nas khang dmar bar du gzhung lam rgyud kyi dgon pa zhig 'khel gyin 'dugargyang ru gser ldings dgon/gzhon nu 'od kyis phyag btab/ khang dmar rdzong rgyang ru shang zhes pa'i sa yul 'di ni 'brog sde shas rgyang ru/ nying ru/ gam ru bcas 'brog pa'i ru khaX spra ru zhes bris na dngos don dang mthun/

rgyal rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khag rgyal rtse dpal 'khor bde chen/rgyal rtse bdag po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags (spyi lo 2289da 1442)dang mkhas grub chos rje rnam gnyis mchod yon du 'brel skabs sa khyi spyi lo 1418lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig dang dgon pa 'di la dge lugs kyi grwa tshang bdun yod pa gsham gsal ltar yin/1 rgyang ro lha khang la dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor/skor/ 2 nor bu dga' ldan par dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don drug 2 legs grub par dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu skor/4 gser khang dgon par dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor/ga zhi gnas grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor/6 grang mo che par dge 'dun zhal grangs ba dang bzhi bcu skor/7 bde 'byor grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor/de min pa'i sa lugs kyi grwa tshang bzhi/ zhwa lu pa gcig dus 'khor ba bzhi/ sa dge thun mong ba'i gser khang pa bcas khyon bsdoms grwa tshang bcu bdun la dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong yas mas zhig ni rgyun du bzhugs pa yin/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor bde chen ni rgyal rtse rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod pa yin/ 63

ra lung dgon/'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang spyi lo 1192lor phyag btab pa'i 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dang / de'i nang gses stod 'brug gi gdan sa che shos gras shig yin/ sa lung dgon ni rgyal rtse rdzong lung dmar shang khongs lung dmar zhes pa'i sa yul 'di'i shar rgyud nye 'gram la 'khel ba yin zhing nang don zhib phra 'khod pa zhig ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig 'di kha gsal shos su snang ngo /skyi mkhar lha khang /spyi lo 1148lo la klong thang sgrol ma lha khang la dpe byas te bzhengs pa'i lha khang zhig yin/ de ni rgyal rtse rdzong dkyil mkhar shang khongs su yod cing r+sha/ ༵ /byung khungs kyi sa bon mdor bsdus shig deb sngon khongs su 'khod pa smon gro lha khang dang smon gro paṇa'ita'i skor/rgyal rtse rdzong mkhar kha stod smad gnyis las mkhar stod shang nas rtsis pa'i nub ngos spyi le lnga tsam yod pa'i smon gro lha khang ni gna' dus kyi lha khang grags pa can zhig yin pa dang dus phyis spyi lo 1924lor bod kyi mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis smon gro lha khang nas thar pa lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe nyang stod smon gro'i lha khang nas rnyed pa de ni bu ston gyis bsgyur ba'i rgya dpe de ka rang la gzhi byas te bsgyur lugs gsungs pa dang / dus phyis kyi rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos kyang smon gro paṇa ḍi ta tshe dbang don grub la snyan ngags gzhung don 'ga' zhig dogs gcod gnang myong ba dang lhag par smon

gro paṇa ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i mdun nas snyan ngag sogs rig gnas khag la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad rjes snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel yang bcoms gnang pa yin/theg mchog gling /'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos rnying ma'i chos lugs su bsgyur ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ theg chen gling ni rgyal rtse rdzong 'brong rtse shang khongs theg mchog gling grong tshor byung ba yin zhing rgyal rtse rdzong mkhar kha lung pa'i smad rgyud tsam la 'khel ba yin/(yig cha'i 'byung khungs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i gsung rtsom gces sgrig )ces pa nas btus pa yin/rgya brag dgon/ra lung sgo bzhi dang nye ba'i rgya brag dgon ni dge lugs pa'i dgon pa chung ngu zhig yin lugs ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod pa dang da lta yul skad la rgya bra la rgyab brag ces 'bod kyin 'dug rgya bra dgon ni rgyal rtse rdzong lung dmar shang khongs sgo bzhi grong tsho'i rgyab ngos su yod/bu ston gyi rnam thar khongs su 'khod par/1 rgya brag ka ba'i 'phrang / 2 kha to wa'i 'phrang (kha to la'i nye rgyud)/2 glang ro gad pa 'phrang / 4 se mig byis pa 'phrang / 5 khur po che khyi'i 'phrang / 6 skyel khud jag pa'i 'phrang sogs lam 'phrang 'ga' zhig brgyud de dbus phyogs su phebs dus phebs lam 'khel ba yin/ /65

'brong rtse chos sde thar pa gling /mkhas grub chos rje'i slob ma 'brong rtse lha sras rin chen rgya mtshos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe gnyis skor yod/ 'brong rtse ni rgyal rtse bdag po'i sku thog gong ma zhig gi skabs rtsigs pa'i mkhar rdzong gi ming yin pa dang 'brogartse lha btsun dge 'dun bkra shes ni chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs brgyad pa yin zhing spyi lo 1546lor khrir phebs te sa glang spyi lo 1552lor chab mdo byams pa gling gi thub chen gyi gser sku bzhengs pa sogs mdzad pa bcas 'di'i rnam thar nyung bsdus shig 'jam bzhad 'jigs byed chos 'byung khongs nas btus pa yin/ 'brong rtse ni rgyal rtse rdzong 'brong rtse shang gi sa yul du yod pa yin/theg mchog gling /rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa theg mchog gling ni rgyal rtse rdzong 'brong rtse shang khongs 'brong rtse shang nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le gsum tsam gyi sar da lta theg mchog gling zhes 'bod pa'i grong tsho 'dir byung ba yin/rtse chen chos sde/chos rje sangs rgyas bkra shis kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/ rtse chen ni rgyal rtse rdzong gi byang ngos rtse chen shang khongs su yod pa yin/66

ri khrod dga' ldan/rgyal rtse bdag po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu gya brgyad skor yod/ri khrod dga' ldan ni rgyal rtse rdzong gi byang rgyab ri sked tsam la shul mal tsam zhig mthong rgyu yod pa zhig 'dug

gro mo rdzong khul gyi dgon khagabaka' brgyud dgon pa/gro mo rdzong gro mo shang khongs gro mo smad shang nas rtsis pa'i nub byang ngos spyi le gnyis tsam yod pa'i gro mo bka' brgyud dgon pa ni shangs 'ba' ra brag dkar dgon lag yin tshul skor paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes kyi gdung rten dkar chag khongs su gsal 'khod byung 'dug cing 'ba' ra brag dkar dgon gyi skor gnas tshul mdor bsdus shig ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa dang / bka' brgyud dgon ni lo drug brgya yas mas shig gi lo rgyus yod pa yin/gro stod dung dkar dgon/paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyi slob ma dge slong bde bar gshegs pa grags pas phyag btab lugs kyi yig cha zhig mthong rgyu 'dug cing gro mo'i sa yul dge lugs pa'i dgon pa phyi shos byung ba zhig yin/ dung dkar dgon ni gro mo rdzong gro stod shang khongs gro zhig stod shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye 'gram spyi le gsum tsam yod pa yin/kham bu dgon sbyagaspyi lo 1780lo'i gong du kham bu dgon sbug ni gzhis ka rtse sa khul gro mo rdzoX /ma bu stod dang smad gnyis las snga ma kham bu stod kham bu shang gi sa

khongs su yod pa dang kham bu stod ni gro mo rdzong gi gnas yul shar gsing ma nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos phyogs spyi le bco brgyad tsam yod/ (yig cha'i 'byung khungs paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa'i gdung rten dkar chag) kham bu stag lung dgon/gro mo rdzong kham bu stod kham bu chu tshan gyi nye rgyud du yod/ (yig cha'i )sna) khongs paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes kyi gdung rten dkar phyog ri bsam 'grub gling /gro mo rdzong grong brdal phag ri'i khongs phag ri nas rtsis pa'i lho nub ngos spyi le gcig tsam yod pa'i bsam 'grub chos gling ni thang stong rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i bsam 'grub lha khang zhes pa de yin dpyad khungs mdor bsdus shig zhus skya'i gdung rabs rin chen bang mdzod 〉kyi kha skong shog grangs 279nas drangs pa yin/phag ri dgon pa gong /gro mo rdzong grong brdal phag ri nas rtsis pa'i nub byang ngos spyi le bzhi tsam yod pa'i dgon pa gong ni dus phyis chu khyi spyi lo 1912lor rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po rgya gar ka sbug nas bod du phyir phebs gnang skabs phag ri dgon pa gong du bdun phrag gcig bzhugs yul gnang ba yin/69

ngam ring rdzong khul gyi dgon khagangam ring chos sde/rab byung bzhi pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1225lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge lugs kyi grwa khag bcu la dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga brgya bzhi bcu skor yod/ ngam ring chos sde ni ngam ring rdzong gi nye 'gram ngam ring zhol grong tsho'i shar rgyud ri ldebs su yod pa yin/ze dkar chos sde/gangs can chos 'phel dgon pa'i mkhan thog gnyis pa ldan 'od zer gyi slob ma byams pa bstan 'phel gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don gcig skor yod/ ze dkar chos sde ni ngam ring rdzong gi ldog gzhung chu rgyud kyi ldog gzhung gi nye phyogs tsam la yod par sems/ldog gsang sngags mkhar/mkhas grub chos rje'i slob ma mda' ba chos ldan rab 'byor gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs —sum cu so gnyis skor yod/ ldog ces pa'i sa yul 'di ni ngam ring rdzong ldog gzhung gtsang po'i nye rgyud zhig la 'khel ba yin/70

gnya' nang rdzong khul gyi dgon khagaganya' nang dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1675lor gsar du btsugs pa'i dgon pa 'di la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu skor yod/ de ni gzhis ka rtse sa khul gnya' nang rdzong tshong 'dus shang dang ha cang nye bar yod pa yin/ man khab dpal ldings dgon/rgyal dbang sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i slob ma sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe gcig skor yod/ sman khab ni gnya' nang rdzong gi byang rgyud sman phu shang gi sa yul 'di la sman khab stod dang sman khab smad ces pa'i sa yul 'dir sman khab stod pa'i bka' blon sman stod pa'i gzhis khungasayang 'dir yod pa dang de sngon dbus khul nas skyid grong bar du 'gro lam 'khel pa yin/las shing sgrol ma lha khang /gnya' nang rdzong tshong 'dus shang khongs 'gram 'gag sgo'i nye rgyud la 'khel ba yin/ las shing ni las kyi gshin rje'i sgo nas cho ga zhig mdzad lugs mi la'i rnam thar khongs su 'khod 'dug / 71

ding ri rdzong khul gyi dgon khagaglang 'khor dgon pa/bod du zhi byed kyi grub mtha'i srol gtod pa po rgya gar gyi grub thob pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa glang 'khor dgon pa ni gzhis ka rtse sa khul ding ri rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho nub ha cang nye bar yod cing bod du lan lnga byon pa'i dang po ni jo mo glang ma'i nye rgyud kyi brin thang las sgo dang / thengs bzhi pa'i skabs mtsho sna rdzong gi nye rgyud thad kur yod pa'i sha sdug stag sgo brgyud de gnyal du phebs lugs skor deb sngon khongs su 'khod pa de la 'grel bshad kha snon phran bu byas te bris pa yin/rdza rang phu dgon pa/pad+ma bka' thang las rong phu'i rdza la zla gcig bzhugs lugs kyi dpyad khungs zhig yod pa dang / de min gsung gi nying khu mar gnas mchog rong phu'i rdza la zla bdun bsdad/ pad+ma ngas kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob lugs kyi rdza rong phu dgon pa ni jo mo glang ma nas rtsis pa'i nub byang nye 'gram du yod pa'i 'dzam gling thog ches mtho shos kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1922lor rdzo rong phu'i dgon pa'i bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nor bus brtsams pa'i rdza rong phu dgon pa'i gnas yig mdor bsdus shig la gzhi byas te bris pa yin/ dgon pa 'di ni rnying ma'i chodi sgrigs kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa dang bod ljongs kyi sa khra'i khongs su dgon

ding ri rdzong khul gyi dgon khagaglang 'khor dgon pa/bod du zhi byed kyi grub mtha'i srol gtod pa po rgya gar gyi grub thob pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa glang 'khor dgon pa ni gzhis ka rtse sa khul ding ri rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho nub ha cang nye bar yod cing bod du lan lnga byon pa'i dang po ni jo mo glang ma'i nye rgyud kyi brin thang las sgo dang / thengs bzhi pa'i skabs mtsho sna rdzong gi nye rgyud thad kur yod pa'i sha sdug stag sgo brgyud de gnyal du phebs lugs skor deb sngon khongs su 'khod pa de la 'grel bshad kha snon phran bu byas te bris pa yin/rdza rang phu dgon pa/pad+ma bka' thang las rong phu'i rdza la zla gcig bzhugs lugs kyi dpyad khungs zhig yod pa dang / de min gsung gi nying khu mar gnas mchog rong phu'i rdza la zla bdun bsdad/ pad+ma ngas kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob lugs kyi rdza rong phu dgon pa ni jo mo glang ma nas rtsis pa'i nub byang nye 'gram du yod pa'i 'dzam gling thog ches mtho shos kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1922lor rdzo rong phu'i dgon pa'i bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nor bus brtsams pa'i rdza rong phu dgon pa'i gnas yig mdor bsdus shig la gzhi byas te bris pa yin/ dgon pa 'di ni rnying ma'i chodi sgrigs kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa dang bod ljongs kyi sa khra'i khongs su dgon

pa'i gnas stangs gsal 'khod byung yod pa yin/bong shod ri bo che/thog mar shangs pa bka' brgyud dang de nas shel dkar chos sde'i bla ma legs pa don grub kyis dge lugs su bsgyur ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ bong shod ri bo che ni ding ri rdzong gi bum chu zhes bris pa'i chu ming de ni bong shod kyi chu zhes 'bri dgos pa'i sa yul de phyogs yin zhing / bong chu ni brin thang las sgo brgyud nas bal yul du 'bab pa'i chu bo zhig yin/ bong chu zhes 'bri srol byung ba ni 〈lho rong chos 'byung 〉lcags par shog grangs 101la gsal ba'i mi la ras pa'i spur thal phyed ka g.yas ru gtsang po dang / phyed ka bong chur dor ba'i skor 'khod yod pa yin/chu dpar sgrub sde/mi la ras pa sku 'das pa'i gnas la phyi gangs ri'i nye 'dabs kyi chu dpar sgrub sde ni dus phyis spyi lo 1681lor sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i chu dpar dga' ldan 'gro phan gling la dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe gcig skor yod/ chu dpar zhes pa'i go don ni gtsang smyonablo bzang rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar khongs su bdud rtsi 'o ma'i chu bo dang /dngos grub kyi chu gnyis 'dres pa'i mdor chu dpar 'khel tshul gsal bshad gnang ba zhig yod pa yin/ 'di ni deng ri rdzong 'gram 'gag sgo'i shar rgyud nye 'gram jo mo bkra shes tshe ring ma'i gangs ri'i nub 'gram du yod/73

shel dkar chos sde/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1645lor gsar tu btsugs pa'i shel dkar chos sde ni sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ de ni ding ri rdzong gi grong brdal shel dkar yul du yod cing shel dkar sa yul ni de sngon lo rgyus thog gi la stod shel dkar mi 'gyur rdo rje rdzong zhes pa de ni mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis lcags byi spyi lo 1720lor bka' 'gyur gyi par gzhi dang po (dbus gtsang khul )shel dkar dgon du par shing brko rgyu'i las 'go tshugs te de nas par shing yongs rdzogs snar thang dgon du yod pa la rten nas snar thang par ma'i bka' 'gyur byung ba yin/gram mcho rab brtan chos lung /sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma sum cu so bzhi skor yod/ gram mtsho ni ding ri rdzong gram mtsho shang gi sa yul 'di yin/rtsib ri'i bsam gtan gling /gnas chen rgyal gyi shī yang zer ba'i rtsib ri'i bsam gtan gling ni pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ mi la ras pa/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa sogs gnas 'dir bzhugs myong lugs zhabs dkar bla ma'i rang rnam khongs su 'khod cing dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom khongs su 'di ltar 'khod pa zhig 'dug sa skya nas lho ngos rma bya brgyud nas grang po'i yul du slebs yul de'i chu 'gram byang ngodi snyi grub thob gcer bu ba rnams kyi rgyal sa chen po la stod rgyal gyi shī bya ba de

rnam gling rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagazhong gzhong dgon pa/shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis rab byung gnyis pa'i chu stag spyi lo 1121lor phyag btab te de nas shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung ba yin/ 'di ni rnam gling rdzong grong brdal rnam gling khongs dang grong brdal rnam gling nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su spyi le lnga tsam yod/shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya spyi lo 169/lor phyag btab pa'i gling bcu gsum gras shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya bzhi bcu zhe lnga skor yod/dga' ldan chos 'khor ni gzhis ka rtse sa khul snam gling rdzong grong brdal rnam gling gi khongs su yod/ rnam gling ni rnam rgyal gling zhes pa'i rdzong ming de yin bzhin bsdus te 'bri srol rgyun chags pa zhig byung snang ngo /byang tshal gyi rlung gzhon/srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i byang tshal gyi rlung gzhon ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su shangs rnam gling rdzong gi 'u yug gling dkar gyi sa yul 'a/ sdu ngos 'dzin gnang ba de ni byang 'u yug gling dkar rdzong byang phyogs kyi

se kha bsrung phyir brtsigs pa'i rdzong zhig yin stabs byang gi sa phyogs nges can zhig yin pa de nas ra 'phrod pa yin/ / thob la dga' ldan rab sa gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1645lor phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grang brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ thob rgyal ni rnam gling rdzong thob rgyal shang gi sa yul du yod cing thob rgyal lha ri sgang ni rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs gzhis yin/shangs spor thogachos rje rin chen pas phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu skor yod/ shangs ni shang chu kārdo 'bab kyi 'gram rgyud rnam gling rdzong lha bu shang gi spor thog grong tshor shangs mdo ri bo dge 'phel/shangs pa kun mkhyen gyis phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ shangs mdo ni shangs chu dang yar lung gtsang po gnyis 'dres mtshams dang nye ba'i rnam glingardzong rtse gdong shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/ shangs mdo ri bo dge 'phel du rje dge 'dun grub pa yang zla 'khor gcig tsam sku mtshams la bzhugs/ bkra shes lhun po'i dgon pa 'debs pa'i mtshan ma 'galha /ga

byung bar grags/shangs grwa tshang chen mo/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma mkhyen rab grags bzang pas phyag btab cing dus phyis chu rta spyi lo 1642lor kur lugs kyi dgon pa gsung rab gling 'dir spos pa'i skor gsal bshad gnang ba zhig be+e ser khongs su 'khod 'dug shangs ni rnam gling rdzong shangs chu'i 'gram rgyud du yod pa yin /ba shel dgon/chos rje rin chen pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so gsum skor yod/ ba shel ni rnam gling rdzong gi dgon pa zhig yin/rtse gdong dgon pa/sa skya'i gdan sa 'og ma rtse gdong chos sde ni rtse gdong zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bkra shis kyis spyi lo 1489lor phyag btab pa'i dpyad khungs shig yod cing gdan sa gong nas gdan sa 'og tu kha gyes pa nas bzung gdan sa gong 'og gi dbye ba yod pa yin/ rtse gdong ni rnam gling rdzong shangs chu'i mdor rtse gdong shang khongs rtse gdong zhes par yod pa yin/ra la g.yung drung gling /bon po'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ rnam gling rdzong stag gru kha'i nye rgyud ri khug zhig tu yod pa yin/78

shangs mda' dpal chen lha khang /dpal chen gyi sku 'dra rnying nyams che ba dang / sa lug spyi lo 1919lor btsun ma lnga bcu skor yod lugs ka thog si tu'i gnas yig nas drangs pa yin/shangs mda' ni shangs chu'i mdor 'khel ba'i rnam gling rdzong e ma sgang shang gi nye rgyud du yod pa yin/yol dkar dgon/zhang tshal pa g.yu brag pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu skor yod/ yol dkar dgon ni rnam gling rdzong khongs su yod cing g.yu brag ces pa'i go don ni lha sa shar rgyud stag rtse rdzong gi g.yu rtse brag na bla ma zhang gi sgrub gnas zhig byung bas yin/'u yug gosasngon lha khang /ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang gras byang phyogs tshangs pa rlung gnon gyi lha khang la ngos 'dzin gnang ba dang / lha khang 'dir rnam snang gi sku thog so phyed gnyis tsam mjal rgyu yod lugs yang 'khod pa dang skabs 'di'i byang phyogs zhes pa de ni sa phyogs yul babs chags stangs thog nas bshad na dper na dus phyis phag gru'isrid dbang gi dus skabs su brtsig pa'i 'u yug gling dkar rdzong ni byang phyogs kyi so kha bsrung ched brtsigs par bshad pa yin no/ / 'u yug ni rnam gling rdzong 'u yug brag dkar dgon nye rgyud la 'khel ba yin/79

'ba' ra brag dkar dgon/'brug pa bka' brgyud la nang gses stod 'brug dang smad 'brug gnyis las stod 'brug bstan pa'i mnga' bdag shangs 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi brag dkar dgon ni rnam gling rdzong rtse gdong shang khongs rtse gdong nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye 'gram sbyi le gsum tsam yod pa'i brag dkar grong tshor yod cing / gro mo bka' brgyud dgon pa ni 'ba' ra brag dkar dgon pa'i dgon lag gras yin/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ni (spyi lo 1210da 1291)bar bzhugs shing 'ba' ra brag dkar dgon pa'i nang rten ji yod ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa yin/zab phu lung /rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi gter gnas gras shangs zab phu lung ni rnam gling rdzong lha phu shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud spyi le bcu gcig tsam yod cing rten bshad zhib phra ka thog si tu'i gnas yig sogs 'ga' zhig yod/

pa snam rdzong khul gyi dgon khag thar pa dgon byang chub gling /dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos shing byi spyi lo 1204lor phyag btab cing kha che paṇa chen gyis dgon ming gong bzhin gnang ba yin/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyi bla ma thar ba lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub du ma byon pa'i dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi skor yod/ thar pa dgon ni pa snam rdzong pa snam skyid gshongs grong tsho dang nye bar yod pa yin/spos khang chogs pa/spos khang tshogs pa ni thog ma'i skabs su rin spungs rdzong gi sa khongs su yodapa'i gtsang chos lung tshogs pa zhes pa de ni dus phyis gnas 'dir mar spos pa yin lugs skor dge 'dun chos 'phel nas gsal bshad gnang ba dang / shing stag spyi lo 1854lor mar spos zin pa ni bsam yas dkar chag khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/ spos khang tshogs pa ni pa snam rdzong nor bu khyung rtse'i mkhar shul gyi shar rgyud nye bar yod/bsam gling dgon/rngog ston kun dga' rdo rjes phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bcu gnyis skor yod/ bsam gling hā/na

pa snam rdzong khul gyi dgon khag thar pa dgon byang chub gling /dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos shing byi spyi lo 1204lor phyag btab cing kha che paṇa chen gyis dgon ming gong bzhin gnang ba yin/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyi bla ma thar ba lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub du ma byon pa'i dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi skor yod/ thar pa dgon ni pa snam rdzong pa snam skyid gshongs grong tsho dang nye bar yod pa yin/spos khang chogs pa/spos khang tshogs pa ni thog ma'i skabs su rin spungs rdzong gi sa khongs su yodapa'i gtsang chos lung tshogs pa zhes pa de ni dus phyis gnas 'dir mar spos pa yin lugs skor dge 'dun chos 'phel nas gsal bshad gnang ba dang / shing stag spyi lo 1854lor mar spos zin pa ni bsam yas dkar chag khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/ spos khang tshogs pa ni pa snam rdzong nor bu khyung rtse'i mkhar shul gyi shar rgyud nye bar yod/bsam gling dgon/rngog ston kun dga' rdo rjes phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bcu gnyis skor yod/ bsam gling hā/na

ni pa snam rdzong chu nub shang khongs bsam gling grong tshor yod cing bsam gling gzhis ka ni bod sa gnas kyi dpon rigs khyim tshang zhig gi ga'is ka yang 'dir yod/ rngog ston kun dga' rdo rje ni mar pa lo tsā ba'i slob ma yin/bsam ldings dpon/gzhon nu don grub pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga bzhi skor yod/ dgon pa 'di ni dang po bka' gdams pa dang de nas zhwa lu pa'i lugs/ shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi shangs lugs/ jo nang lugs/ de nas dge lugs su bsgyur pa bcasagrub mtha' snga rting lnga tsam 'gyur ba byung pa'i dpe mtshon pa zhig byung 'dug bsam sdings dgon ni pa snam rdzong mag shang khongs bsam sding grong tshor yod/rin chen sgang /khyung po don grub rin chen gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma bzhi bcu skor yod/ rin chen sgang ni pa snam rdzong gdong shang rin chen sgang grong tshor yod/dbang ldan chos 'khor bde chen/rgyal rtse chos rgyal gyi sku thog gong ma'i dus skabs su dbang ldan chos 'khor rtse'i dgon pa'i sa yul 'di la dus phyis spyi lo 1780lor gong du byung zin pa'i dbang ldan chos 'khor bde chen dgon/ pa snam rdzong dbang ldan shadī spra sa yul du yod/ (yig cha'i dpyad khungs paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa

dpal ldan ye shes kyi gdung rten dkar chag nas drangs pa yin/)pa snam dga' ldan dar sa gling / me khyi spyi lo 1646lor gsar du btsugs pa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu so bzhi skor yod/ de ni pa snam rdzong khongs su yod pa yin/

dpal ldan ye shes kyi gdung rten dkar chag nas drangs pa yin/)pa snam dga' ldan dar sa gling / me khyi spyi lo 1646lor gsar du btsugs pa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu so bzhi skor yod/ de ni pa snam rdzong khongs su yod pa yin/

sna dkar rtse sdong khul gyi dgon khagayar 'brog bsam sdings dgon pa/bodong chos lugs kyi bla ma bo dong 'jigs med grags pa'i sku dus su phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing nang rten ji yod zhib phra 'khod pa ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod yod/ yar 'brog bsam sdings ni rdo rje phag mo'i sku rim byung nas dgon pa 'dzin skyong gnang ba yin/ bsam sdings dgon ni sna dkar rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud thad kur spyi le bdun tsam yod pa dang dus phyis nye dus rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa yang gza' 'khor gsum tsam bzhugs shing snga rting thengs gnyis phebs myong ba ni rnam thar khongs su 'khod 'dug go/ bo dong 'jigs med grags pas bcoms pa'i rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi rnam thar par bskrun zin pa zhig yod/stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor/yar 'brog sde srid mi thog gcig gi sku dus su rab byung bcu pa'i nang bskrun lugs skor du ku la'i kha skong khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dug cing stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor ni stag lung grwa tshang rtse zhes ri 'bur zhig gi stong du yod pa'i par ris shin tu legs pa zhig ni bdud 'joms kyi rnying ma'i chos 'byung khongs su bcug pa zhig 'dug de ni sna dkar rtse rdzong stag lung shang khongasdu su yod pa yin/

sna dkar rtse sdong khul gyi dgon khagayar 'brog bsam sdings dgon pa/bodong chos lugs kyi bla ma bo dong 'jigs med grags pa'i sku dus su phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing nang rten ji yod zhib phra 'khod pa ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod yod/ yar 'brog bsam sdings ni rdo rje phag mo'i sku rim byung nas dgon pa 'dzin skyong gnang ba yin/ bsam sdings dgon ni sna dkar rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud thad kur spyi le bdun tsam yod pa dang dus phyis nye dus rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa yang gza' 'khor gsum tsam bzhugs shing snga rting thengs gnyis phebs myong ba ni rnam thar khongs su 'khod 'dug go/ bo dong 'jigs med grags pas bcoms pa'i rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi rnam thar par bskrun zin pa zhig yod/stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor/yar 'brog sde srid mi thog gcig gi sku dus su rab byung bcu pa'i nang bskrun lugs skor du ku la'i kha skong khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dug cing stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor ni stag lung grwa tshang rtse zhes ri 'bur zhig gi stong du yod pa'i par ris shin tu legs pa zhig ni bdud 'joms kyi rnying ma'i chos 'byung khongs su bcug pa zhig 'dug de ni sna dkar rtse rdzong stag lung shang khongasdu su yod pa yin/

stag lung rtse shod gnyis/stag lung grwa tshang zhol ni sa skya'i bla ma stag tshang lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i 'du khang ka ba nyi shu dang bka' 'gyur cha gnyis sogs yod lugs skor ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa'i dbyad khungs 'di tsam las gzhan ni ches dkon pa zhig 'dug stag lung ni lo rgyus thog yar 'brog khri dpon ag len gyis brtsigs pa'i mkhar rdzong zhig yin pa dang de rjes stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor dang stag lung grwa tshang zhol bcas dus phyis kyi bskrun dngos zhig yin/ stag lung ni sna dkar rtse rdzong yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i 'gram rgyud kyi stag lung shang gi sa yul du yod pa yin/ri bo braga'abrug pa kun legs kyi dgon pa yin lugs skor ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su lnga pa chen po'i rnam thar khongs su 'khel 'dug cing yar 'brog sde srid ri bo brag ni lho kha sa khul sna dkar rtse rdzong stag lung shang nas rtsis pa'i shar rgyud nye 'gram du yod pa yin/yar 'brog glang lung dgon/'phreng po lha lung pa 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bzang pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu go lnga skor yod/ 'phreng po lha lung pa 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' ni lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan (1226da 140〈)gyi slob ma yin/ de ni lho kha sa khul sna dkar rtse rdzong khongs su yod/85

zha sde mdo sngags chos gling /zha sde mdo sngags chos gling ni rnying ma'i bla ma 'khrul zhig rin po che'i gdan sa dang 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis dang chos lung sprul gsum gyi sku 'dra bcas yod lugs kyi dpyad khungs ka thog si tu'i gnas yig 'di las de min gyi khungs sne ci yang med do/ / mdo sngags chos gling ni sna dkar rtse rdzong lhun po zhol shang khongs dang sna dkar rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs spyi le lnga bcu nga bdun tsam gyi zha sde grong tshor yod/ bod ljongs sa bkra'i khongs su lhun po zhol gyi byang 'gram du zha gzhis zhes 'khod pa'i sa yul der mdo sngags chos gling gi dgon pa'i sa yul 'khel ba yin/

bzhad mthong smon rdzong khul gyi dgon khag yo rgyan chos rdzong /sa skya'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga gsum skor yod/ o rgyan chos rdzong ni zhal mthong smon rdzong rta nag mdar yod pa'i rta nag chu dang yar lung gtsang po gnyis kyi 'dres mtshams la 'khel ba yin/ sa skya'i bla ma dam pa ni (1212—1275)bar du bzhugs shing 'di nyid kyis snye thang chos rdzong yang phyag btab pa yin/nyug chos 'khor gling /sa bya spyi lo 1659lor gsar tu btsugs pa'i nyug chos 'khor gling la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/nyug chos 'khor gling ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong rta nag nyang chu'i glog khang gi nye 'khor du yod pa yin/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nyug rgyal khang zhes pa'i mkhar rdzong zhig byung lugs rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa'i dga' 'byed khongs su 'khod yod/bzhad steng kha dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma stod shes rab bzang pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skokā sbyad/

stod shes rab bzang po ni rgyal dbang dge 'dun grub pa'i bla ma gtso bo yin zhing shing glang spyi lo 1445lor dga' ldan dgon du sku gshegs khar dpe cha 'di rnams dge 'dun grub kyi sar skyol/ rgyud kyi 'chad nyan yin pa sbyin pa dpal gyis gsungs pa yin no/ / bzhan steng khang dgon ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs su yod/bzhad 'brong bu dgon/rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa'i slob ma snar thang pa sang gha ri pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe dgu skor yod/ de ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs su yod pa yin/bzhad bkra shis dge 'phel/blo gros mgon pos dge lugs su bsgyur pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing de nas sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya sum cu skor byi/ /pa ṭ+wāṃ / bzhad mthong smon rdzong gi rta nag phu dang mda'i phyogs tsam la bzhad dga' ldan chos ldings/paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me byi spyi lo 1626lor phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bco brgyad skor yod/ paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i khongs lhan shang gi swāhā drug brgya zhes par spyi lo 1570lor sku 'khrungs lcags glang spyi lo

stod shes rab bzang po ni rgyal dbang dge 'dun grub pa'i bla ma gtso bo yin zhing shing glang spyi lo 1445lor dga' ldan dgon du sku gshegs khar dpe cha 'di rnams dge 'dun grub kyi sar skyol/ rgyud kyi 'chad nyan yin pa sbyin pa dpal gyis gsungs pa yin no/ / bzhan steng khang dgon ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs su yod/bzhad 'brong bu dgon/rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa'i slob ma snar thang pa sang gha ri pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe dgu skor yod/ de ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs su yod pa yin/bzhad bkra shis dge 'phel/blo gros mgon pos dge lugs su bsgyur pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing de nas sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya sum cu skor byi/ /pa ṭ+wāṃ / bzhad mthong smon rdzong gi rta nag phu dang mda'i phyogs tsam la bzhad dga' ldan chos ldings/paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me byi spyi lo 1626lor phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bco brgyad skor yod/ paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni grong khyer gzhis ka rtse'i khongs lhan shang gi swāhā drug brgya zhes par spyi lo 1570lor sku 'khrungs lcags glang spyi lo

1609lor bkra shis lhun po'i khrir phebs pa nas paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i bar du paṇa chen sku phreng bdun gyi ring la gdan sa bkra shis lhun por gnang ༵ // /yi/zhad dga' ldan chos sdings ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong khongs su bzhad grwa tshang chen mo/rje tsong kha pa chen mo'i slob ma kun mkhyen grags pa bzang pos phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang drug cu skor yod/ (de ni gzhis ka rtse rdzong bzhad mthong smon khongs)rta nag kha la dgon/ byang chub dpal bas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so gsum skor yod/ (bzhad mthong smon rdzong rta nag chu rgyud du yod pa yin)ri khud dgon/rgyal ba sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub pas rta nag khul du byams pa'i sku bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus 'khod pa'i dgon pa 'di la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga gcig skor yod/ ri khud dgon ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong rta nag mda' shang khongs ri khud grong tshor yod pa yin/bkra shis chos sdings/ngam ring dbon pos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin dus rdiswā sa

stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis skor yod/ bkra hā/ chos sdings ni bzhan mthong smon rdzong rta nag shang gi bkra shes grong tshor rta nag sa n+de chen/shes rab bzang pos phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga skor yod/ de ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong rta nag phu dang yang na rta nag mda'i sa khongs su yod pa yin/rta nag ti mkhar dgon/shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang drug cu re brgyad skor yod/ de ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong rta nag phu shang dang yang na rta nag mda'i shang gi sa khongs tsam la yod pa yin/gling kha dgon/mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung bdun pa'i me 'brug spyi lo 1426lor phyag btab pa'i sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/de sngon gyi lo rgyus dpe cha 'ga' zhig la mus stag lo gling kha dgon zhes gsal ba de rang yin/ de ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong stag mo shar shang khongs stag mo shar shang nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs spyi le bdun tsam yod/ mus chen ni (12rdord 1469)bar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis bzhugs/90

dzin grub rtse chos sde/lhun grub rtse pa blo gros rnam rgyal gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis skor yod/ de ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong rin chen rtse shang khongs lhun grub rtse grong tshor yod/rin chen rtse ni de sngon lo rgyus thog rta nag rin chen rtse zhes pa'i sa yul de yin/bzhad dngul chu chosardzong /rgyal sras 'jigs med bzang po rgyun ring du bzhugs pa'i bzhad dngul chu chos rdzong ni bzhad mthong smon rdzong gi sa yul zhig tu yod cing rgyal sras 'jigs med bzang po ni tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi bla ma yin pa dang bu ston rin chen grub dang dus mnyam byung ba dang dngul chu chos rdzong du dus phyis dngul chu dha rma bha dra sogs mkhas dbang 'ga' zhig byung ba yin/91

rin spungs rdzong khul gyi dgon khagarong byams chen chos sde/rin spungs sde pa nor bu bzang po dang rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob gzhon nu rgyal mchog gnyis mchod yon du 'brel skabs rab byung bdun pa'i me lug spyi lo 1427lor phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad skor yod/ lo dus thad rab byung drug pa'i me lug ces 'khod pa de ni yong stangs bral ba zhig yin stabs rab byung bdun pa'i me lug lor byams chen chos sde phyag btab pa dang sa glang spyi lo 1469lor byams chen gyi chos sku chen mo bzhengs lugs rin spungs pa'i gdung rabs phyi ma'i khongs su 'khod pa des kyang gong gi me lug yin pa bden dpang bston med zhig byung ba yin/ rong ni gtsang rong gi rong chen dang rong chung gnyis las rong chen gyi khongs yin pa dang byams chen gyi byams pa'i gser sku mtho tshad khru bdun cu don lnga pa ste rgyab mtho bcas khru brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam yod pas na byams chen zhes su grags pa yin zhing tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis spyi lo 1254lor gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i rdzong brtsigs ba'i lo de rang la rin spungs rdzong yang gsar tu brtsigs pa'i lo de nas lo bdun cu don gsum tsam song rjes rong byams chen chos sde phyag btab ༵ /na/ rong byams chen ni da lta'i rin spungs rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod pa 92

rin spungs rdzong khul gyi dgon khagarong byams chen chos sde/rin spungs sde pa nor bu bzang po dang rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob gzhon nu rgyal mchog gnyis mchod yon du 'brel skabs rab byung bdun pa'i me lug spyi lo 1427lor phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad skor yod/ lo dus thad rab byung drug pa'i me lug ces 'khod pa de ni yong stangs bral ba zhig yin stabs rab byung bdun pa'i me lug lor byams chen chos sde phyag btab pa dang sa glang spyi lo 1469lor byams chen gyi chos sku chen mo bzhengs lugs rin spungs pa'i gdung rabs phyi ma'i khongs su 'khod pa des kyang gong gi me lug yin pa bden dpang bston med zhig byung ba yin/ rong ni gtsang rong gi rong chen dang rong chung gnyis las rong chen gyi khongs yin pa dang byams chen gyi byams pa'i gser sku mtho tshad khru bdun cu don lnga pa ste rgyab mtho bcas khru brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam yod pas na byams chen zhes su grags pa yin zhing tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis spyi lo 1254lor gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i rdzong brtsigs ba'i lo de rang la rin spungs rdzong yang gsar tu brtsigs pa'i lo de nas lo bdun cu don gsum tsam song rjes rong byams chen chos sde phyag btab ༵ /na/ rong byams chen ni da lta'i rin spungs rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod pa 92

'bras srungs skyed tshal dgon/sa skya'i bla ma byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel rgyas dgung lo so dgu bzhes pa'i rab byung brgyad pa'i sa sbrul spyi lo 1449lor phyag btab pa'i sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin zhing rin spungs rdzong gi rong chen dang rong chung gnyis las sa khongs da lta'i rin spungs rdzong gi brag pa shang dang yang na ram pa shang gnyis kyi sa khongs 'di tsam la 'khel gyin yod pa 'dra/gong ra nges gsang gling /rnying ma'i bla ma rong gter 'jam dpal rdo rjes phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ gong ra nges gsang gling ni rin spungs rdzong bde skyid gling shang khongasagong ra zhes pa'i grong tshor yod pa yin/ (de ni sde dge mkhyen brtse'i gnas yig nas drangs pa yin)g.yag sde dga' ldan lhun po/rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i bka' ltar 'brong rtse lha sras kyi dbon po blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga skor yod/ g.yag sde ni rin spungs rdzong g.yag sde shang zhes pa'i sa yul du yod pa yin/jo lug nyal dgon/g.yung rdza lud sogs rnying ma'i gter gnas dang 'brel ba'i da// pa

zhig yin/ rdza lug nyal ni rin spungs rdzong g.yung chu'i nye rgyud du yod/ /ngur smrig sgrol ma lha khang /ngur smrig ces pa'i sa yul 'di ni tun hong gi yig cha'i khongs su lcags byas lo 1719lor byung zin pa'i sa yul zhig yin pa dang de nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi gras/ dper na ras ngur smrig bzung zhes pa ni rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pas kyang ngur smrig gi gnas gzhi bskyangs pa'i don yin/ ngur smrig sgrol ma lha khang ni da lta'i rin spungs rdzong brag pa shang khongs ngur smrig /nga tshor yod cing smig ni chu mig gi sgra zur nyam pa zhig yin par sems g.yungajo lud mcho/g.yung rdza lud mtsho'i gnas 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sgrub phug yod lugs ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yin/rdza lud mtsho ni rin spungs rdzong bde skyid gling shang gi lho rgyud nye bar yod cing gzhung zhes pa 'di ni gzhung chu'i 'bab rgyud 'di la g.yung dar rgyas gling sogs dgon rnying 'ga' zhig yod pa yin/chos lung chogs pa/chos lung tshogs pa ni rab byung bzhi pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1255lor phyag btab par bshad pa'i tshogs pa sde bzhi'i gras cung phyi ba zhig byung 'dug cing chos lung tshogs pa ni rin spungs rdzong snubs dang gnubs zhes sa ming dkā ༵ cung mi 'dra bas gnubs zhes pa'i sa yul 'di ni lo rgyus thog gzhis

ka rtse nas lha sa bar du 'grul lam dngos gzhi 'khel ba dang / chos lung tshogs pa'i nang rten gras kha che paṇa chen gyi rdza sku gnyis dang jo bo rje'i rgya dpe /gas 'ga' zhig yod lugs lnga pa chen po'i rang rnam khongs su 'khod yod

gting skyes rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagating skyes bkra shis chos 'phel/'bri mtshams pa sangs rgyas kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad cu skor yod/ de ni gting skyes rdzong khongs su yod cing / 'bri mtshams ni 'bri mtshams gangs dkar po zhes rgyal rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud kyi gangs ri'i ri rgyud zhig gi ming yin zhing 'bri mtshams gangs ri dkar po tshun chad rgyal rtse chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi mnga' khongs su brtsi ba yin/zar chos 'khor bde chen/gtingaskyes pa ye shes rgya mtshos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe dgu skor yod/ de ni gting skyes rdzong zar shang khongs su yod cing zar ni lo rgyus thog 6 zar stag sna rtsod kyi sgo zhes bal yul mtha' mtshams dang 'brel ba'i 'gag sgo'i tshong las zhig byung ba yin/ gcen lung mkha' spyod chos n+de/lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan (spyi lo 1226da 1401)gyi slob ma dpal rdo rjes phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dgā ༵dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ gcen lung zhes pa ni

dga' rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagro shod dga' ldan chos 'khor/'jam dbyangs shan ti pas phyag btab cing dus phyis spyi lo 169〈gong gi dus rabs zhig la glo bo smon thang pas gtor bzhig byas lugs 'khod pa dang / gro shod ni sa dga' rdzong rta mchog mkha' 'bab kyi chu bo'i stod phyogs su 'khel ba'i de sngon lha sa nas stod mnga' ris su 'gro ba'i gzhung lam 'khel ༵ /na/ glo bo smon thang pa ni da lta bal yul khongs su yod pa'i yul sde zhig

lha rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khagalha rtse dga' ldan 'og min gling rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1649lor phyag btab pa'i gling bcu gsum gras yin pa'i sa stag lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya nyi shu rtsa drug skor yod/ lha rtse dga' ldan 'og min gling ni lha rtse rdzong rnying pa'i nye 'gram yar lung gtsang po'i byang khar yod cing da lta'i lha rtse rdzong gi grong brdal lha rtse'i sa khongs dang lha rtse lcags zam gyi nye 'gram du yod pa yin/mang mkhar mu gu lung /bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis chu yos spyi lo 1002lor phyag btab pa'i gnas gzhi zhig yin zhing chu byi spyi lo 1012lor sku 'khrungs pa'i mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros yang dgung lo bcu gsum tsam bzhes pa'i spyi lo 1025tsam la 'brog mi'i drung du bcar te 'phral skad la sbyang pa nges can gnang rjes bal yul brgyud rgya gar du thon pa bcas gong gi chu yos de ni lo khams thad rgyu mtshan kha gsal ba zhig byung ba yin/ mang mkhar myu gu lung ni gzhis ka rtse sa khul lha rtse rdzong gi mang mkhar phu dang mda' gnyis las da lta'i mang mkhar phu'i shang gi sa khongs su yod/gnas yig cung zhib phra 'khod pa zhig ka thog si tu'i gnas yig sogs yod/99

g.ya' lung 'jag gshongs/sa skya'i bla ma gong ma lnga'i sngon du byung pa'i sa skya'i chos lugs dgon pa snga shos su brtsi 'os pa'i g.ya' lung 'jag gshongs ni shākya blo gros kyis phyag btab lugs bod kyi deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs khongs su 'khod cing g.ya' lung ni da lta'i lha rtse rdzong bkra shis sgang khongs g.ya' lung grong tsho dang gshong grong tsho zhes sa yul so sor 'dren pa zhig 'dug pa 'di yin/bzang ldan chos sde/g.yas ru byang pa'i mi ngo kun spang chos grags bzang pos phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis rje tsong kha pa chen pos grwa skor gyi dam bca' mdzad myong ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ mkhas grub chos rjes brtsams pa'i rje tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar khongs su 'dar bzang ldan/ ngam ring dga' rong chos sde/ jo mo nang bcas la phebs tshul 'khod pa ltar na 'dar ni lha rtse'i sa khongs yin stabs lha rtse rdzong gi nye rgyud zhig la yod pa yin/ g.yas ru byang pa ni ngam ring gi sa yul du byung ba'i gtsang chu'i byang ngos su 'khel ba yin/ /snying ri dgon/snying ri dgon ni rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi lo rgyus cung ring ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ (lha rtse rdzong bkra shes sgang shang khongs snying ri grong tshor yod )sa paṇa dang dus mnyam byung ba'i grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyi gdung brgyud bla ma snying ri ba'i dgon pa 'di la dus da lta'i bar du gdung brgyud bar ma chad pa zhizhi hā/ 'dug cing se ra dgon pa'i se ra phur mjal chen mo'i dus chen gyi

phur pa 'di ni grub chen 'dar 'phyar ba'i mgur phur byin rlabs can zhig yin par grags/sngon mo rdzong rdo rje gdan/'jam dbyangs 'khon ston gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu go gnyis skor yod/ sngon mo rdzong dang skabs 'gar sngon mo lung yang zer ba'i sa yul 'di ni lha rtse rdzong sle phu shang khongs sngon mo rdzong grong tshor yod/ dus rabs thad rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa'i dus skabs su dge 'dun grub pas rdzong du dpal ldan lha mo'i mgon khang bzhengs lugs 'khod 'dugaganas chos sde/rje shes rab seng ge'i slob ma mgon po dpal bas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ de ni lha rtse rdzong mang mkhar shang khongs gnas zhes pa'i grong tshor yod pa dang skabs 'di'i rje shes rab seng ge ni rje tsong kha pa chen mo'i slob ma stod shes rab seng ge zhes pa de yin/lcags zam mo bragadang thog shangs pa bka' brgyud dang de nas dge lugs su bsgyur ba'i dgon pa zhig yin sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so gnyis skor yod/ de ni lha rtse rdzong mang mkhar phu shang khongs lcags zam mo brag grong tshor yod/ /101

mang mkhar chos sdings/byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor btsun ma bzhi bcu zhe dgu skor yod/ mang mkhar ni lha rtse rdzong mang mkhar phu mda'i sa yul tsam 'khel ba yin/ dga' ldan dar sa gling /mgon po rgya mtshos phyag btab cing rgyal ba sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtshos dgon ming dar rgyas gling zhes pa gnang / sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis skor yod/ de ni lha rtse rdzong gi lho rgyud dar rgyas gling grong tshor yod pa yin/gangs bu le/pad+ma 'byung gnas dang rje btsun red mda' ba chen po'i sgrub phug sogs mjal rgyu yod cing gangs bu le'i gangs ri 'di rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi le 6404tsam yod pa dang lha rtse rdzong gi nub dang ngam ring rdzong gi lho rgyud du yod pa'i gangs ri 'di ni da lta phyi phyogs su sgo dbye zin pa'i gras yin/ rje btsun red mda' ba chen po ni (1241—1412)bar du bzhugs shing rje tsongakha pa chen po'i bla ma yin/ (ka thog si tu'i gnas yig nas btus pa yin)/ /na la rtse/10)skya'i bla ma bsod nams rtse mos me phag spyi lo 1167lor na la rtse'i

gnas po che'i gtsug lag khang du chos la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad pa'i sa yul de yin no/ / na la rtse ni lha rtse rdzong mang phu shang khong na la rtse grong tshor byung ba yin/ mang phu ni mang mkhar phu dang mda' gnyis kā/ phu'i phyogs 'brog mi'i gdan sa mang mkhar myu gu lung yang 'di phyogs su dga' ldan phun tshogs gling /sa khyi spyi lo 1658lor gsar tu btsugs pa'i dga' ldan phun tshogs gling sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi brgya drug cu re gnyis skor yod/ de ni lha rtse rdzong phun tshogs gling shang khongs su yod pa dang /jo nang ring lugs kyi rtag bstan phun tshogs gling dang dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gnyis ku'i nang rten cung zhib phra 'khod pa zhig ni sde dge ka thog si tu'i gnas yig las shes par bya'o/ /bo dong dang bkra shis sgang /bo dong ring lugs kyi dgon pa che shos bo dong e dgon pa ni lha rtse rdzong bkra shis sgang shang bkra shes sgang shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud spyi le lnga tsam yod pa'i g.yu thog ces pa'i grong tsho 'dir byung ba yin zhing da lta'i skabs su bo /// sa ming de bzhin rgyud mnga' cung nyung ba'i dus skabs zhig la slebs 'dar zang mo che dgon pa/rgyalab sku phreng gsum pa'i bla ma tshar chen blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gnas sa 103

yin/ (chos lugs sa skya )'dar ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi gras 'dar shākya yon tan gyis gzung po bzung de las mched pa la 'dar tsho zer ba dang dus phyis kyi 'dar ba lo tsā ba ngag dbang phun tshogs yang 'di phyogs nas byung ba yin/ 'dar brang mo che ni lha rtse rdzong chu shar grong tsho byung ba yin zhing chu shar grong tsho ni da lta'i lha rtse rdzong gi rdzong las khungs bca' sdod byed yul du gyur 'dug /bo dong e dgon pa/bod kyi lo rgyus cung snga bar byung ba'i bo dong e dgon pa ni rab byung dngapo'i sa glang spyi lo 1049lor dge bshes mu tra ba chen pos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di ni dus phyis su dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa (1276da 1242)sogs kyi 'chad nyan mdzad myong ba dang rje tsong kha pa chen pos kyang bo dong e dgon par lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po la 〈snyan ngag me long 〉gi bshad pa yang gsan myong ba yin/ bo dong e dgon pa ni lha rtse rdzong bkra shes sgang shang g.yu thog ces pazhi sa yul 'di rang yin pa ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig tu gsal bshad gang legs gnang 'dug /jocanang dngajonang dgon pa/jo mo nang ni nags rgyal zhes pa'i bod kyi srid pa'i lha chen brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gnas ri de'i nye 'dabs su 'khel bas na jo mo nang zhes zer ba dang jo nang dgon pa ni kun spang thugs rje brtson 'grus (124rad )kyis phyag btab cing de rjes dol bu ba shes rab rgyal mtshan jo nang gi gnas sar bzhi/sna shing rab byung drug pa'i lcags rta spyi lo 1220lor jo nang gi mchod
