rten chen mo thog sa bcu gsum tsam yod pa zhig bzhengs pa yin/ jo nang dgon pa'i bla ma tā ra na bas shing yos spyi lo 1615lor jo nang ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rtag brtan phun tshogs gling gi dgon pa phyag btab pa dang 〈rgya gar chos 'byung 〉yang bka' brtsams mdzad/ tā ra na tha ni (1575da 1624)bar bzhugs/ jo nang dgon pa ni lha rtse rdzong phun tshogs gling shang khongs dang phun tshogs gling nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye 'gram spyi le gsum tsam gyi sar yod pa yin/byargod gshongs dgon pa/sa skya'i bla ma paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa byams pa chos grags kyis rab byung brgyad pa'i sa bya sbyi lo 1489lor gnyan yod bya rgod gshongs kyi dgon pa phyag btab pa nas sa skya'i chos lugs kyi grub mtha' cung che gras zhig yin/ dgon pa de ni lha rtse rdzong bkra shes sgang shang khongs bya gshongs grong tshor yod/ gzhi rtsa'i dpyad khungs ni sbyi lo 1809lor bcoms pa'i 〈thu'u bkan grub mtha' shel gyi me long 〉las gsal/srong btsan sgam pos bzheXsdu zlo'i rgya zlo ba/zhi'i gtsug lag khang gras grom pa rgyang ni lha rtse rdzong gi khongs su yod pa yin/105

pu rang rdzong khul gyi dgon khagakhrus sgo dgon/a mdo zhabs dkar bla ma'i rnam thar khongs su ma pham g.yu mtsho'i khrus sgo lho zhes mtsho'i lho 'gram du 'khel ba yin/ khrus sgo dgon ni mnga' ris sa khul pu rangs rdzong ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du yod cing skabs de'i a mdo zhabs dkar bla ma ni (spyi lo 1781da 1851)bar bzhugs shing dus phyis dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi 'khrungs yul gcig pa yin pa'i reb gong zho 'ong la khab yin no/ / pu rungs zhes pa'i ming 'di la pu rangs/ spu rangs/ spu hrang / spu hreng bcas 'bri srol bzhi tsam byung 'dug cing pu ni phu zhes lung pa'i phu dang hrang ni brang zhes pa'i sgra zur cung gsal ba dang rtsa hrang ni rtswa kha'i brang khang zhes pa'i go don 'dra ba zhig 'dugargyang grags dgon pa/'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i slob ma 'ga' zhig gis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni mnga' ris sa khul spu rang rdzong gangs sa shang //sa kyi stod gangs rin po che'i lho rgyud nye 'gram du spyi le bdun tsam yod pa 106

bon ri dgon/mnga' ris sa khul spu rangs rdzong ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'gram rgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin/'bri ra phug dgon pa/mnga' ris sa khul spu rangs rdzong stod gangs rin po che'i byang ngos spyi le bzhi tsam yod/dar chen dgon pa/dar chen dgon pa ni spu rang rdzong gi gangs sa shang nas rtsis pa'i nub sdu/ ngos spyi le brgyad tsam yod cing stod gangs rin po che dang nye bar yod pa kho chag jo bo lha khang /bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras su pu rangs kho chag lha khang ni pu rangs rdzong kho chag shang dang kho chag chu rgyud du 'khel zhing btsan po'i dus skabs kyi rdo ring 'ga' zhig gsar du brnyed pa'ang byung 'dug107

rtsa mda' rdzong khul gyi dgon khagamatho ldings dgon pa/mnga' ris gu ge'i rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rab byung dang po'i gong gi drug cu skor de'i me sprel spyi lo 996lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me yos spyi lo 1697lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang dgu bcu skor yod/ mtho lding dgon pa ni mnga' ris sa khul rtsa mda' rdzong mtho lding shang khongs mtho lding grong tshor yod cing da lta mtho lding la sgra 'chol nas tho ling zhes grags pa yin/ spyi lo 998lor mtho lding dgon pa phyag btab nas spyi lo 1996bar du lo 'khor chig stong tham pa 'khor ba yin pa dang mtho lding dgon pa'i lo rgyus dang ldebs ris sogs 'khod pa'i dpe deb dpe bskrun gnang ba zhig yod pa yin/dung dkar bkra shis chos gling /khri rnam rgyal sdes gsar du btsugs pa'i dung dkar chos gling la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so lnga skor dang mtho lding dgon pa'i dgon lag gras yin/ dung dkar zhes pa'i sa yul de ni /r+shadī /sdu sna khul rtsa mda' rdzong dung dkar shang khongs dung dkar grong tshor 108

shangs rtse langaka chos sde/rgyal sras mi tri pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don ga nyis skor yod/ shangs rtse zhes pa'i yul de ni mnga' ris sa khul rtsa mda' rdzong shangs rtse shang khongs shangs rtse grong tshor 'khel ba yin/do shang mukar chosastsong /mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi slob ma grub chen dkon mchog dpal mgon gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga skor yod/ de ni mnga' ris sa khul rtsa mda' rdzong gi khongs su yod/bye dkar chos sde rnam rgyal rtse/grub chen dbang phyug dpal ldan pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod/ bye dkar zhes pa'i sa yul de ni rtsa mda' rdzong gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/mda' pa bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa/bkra shis lhun po'i gdan rabs bdun pa paṇa chen shan ti pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang drug cu re gcig skor yod/ mda' pa zhes pa'i sa yul de ni mnga' ris sa khul gyi mda' pa mkhar dpon zhes pa'i lo rgyus thog gi rdzong 'go'i gasdu byin

༵ /nga da lta'i rtsa mda' rdzong mda' pa shang khongs mda' pa grong tshor 'khel ba ma nang byang chub gling /mnga' ris kyi rgyal po lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis phyag btab cing spyi lo 1042tsam la lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis jo bo rje a ti sha yang gdan 'dren zhus te dgon pa 'dir rgyun ring tsam bzhugs/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ ma nang zhes pa'i sa yul de ni mnga' ris sa khul rtsa mda' rdzong mtho lding shang khongs ma nang grong tshor 'khel ba yin/ 110

ru thog rdzong khul gyi dgon khagaru thog lhan grub chos sdings/la dwags rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal gyi bla ma stag tshang ras chen ngag dbang rgya mtshos phyag btab pa'i 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa dang de nas spyi lo 1684yas mas zhig la sog po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis dge lugs su bsgyur ba yin/ de ni mnga' ris sa khul ru thog rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod cing mnga' ris ru thog rgyal po dang / rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po thugs 'grig che zhing chab shog thog nas 'brel ba gnang ba sogs rnam thar khongs su thar thor 'khod pa re zung zhig yod pa yin/111

gong dkar rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagong dkar bshad sgrub gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing rta spyi lo 1654lor gsar tu tshugs pa gong dkar bshad sgrub gling la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 169/lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang drug cu skor yod/ gong dkar bshad sgrub gling ni lho kha sa khul gong dkar rdzong dgon stod shang khongs thod pa ri grong tshor yod/gong dkar rdo rje gdan dgon pa/thu mi'i rigs las son pa'i thu ston kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis rab byung brgyad pa'i shing sprel spyi lo 1464lor phyag btab pa'i sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ da lta gong dkar chos sde zhes 'bod pa'i lho kha gong dkar rdzong dgon stod shang gi srid gzhung rim pa'i las khungs bca' sdod yul dgon stod ces pa'i grong tshor yod cing nang rten ji yod skor ka thog si tu'i gnas yig 'di rgyas shos su byung snang ngo / / sa skya'i chos lugs kyi nang gses sa ngor gong gsum zhes pa'i sa skya dang gcig gzhis ka rtse sa khul chu mig shang dang nye ba'i ngor dgon pa dang gnyis/ lho kha gong dkar rdzong gong dkar rdo rje gdan bcas gsum yin no/ / 112

bde chen chos 'khor dgon/gong dkar rdo rje gdan phyag 'debs pa po thub bstan kun dga' rna ma rgyal gyis phyag btab pa'i dben gnas bde chen chos 'khor ni 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni da lta'i lho kha gong dkar rdzong dgon stod shang khongs gong dkar rdzong gi las khungs bca' sdod byed yul skyid gshongs shang nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le bcu drug tsam yod pa yin/gnas yig mdor bsdus shig ka thog si tu'i gnas yig 'di tsam las dpyad khungs ni ches dkon pa zhig 'dug /gzhung spre zhing gi gnas gzhi'i skor/rngog kun dga' rdo rje ni me glang (1157 1225) shing rta bar bzhugs shing rngog kun dga' rdo rjes gzhung spre zhing gi gnas gzhi phyag btab pa nas rngog pa'i gdung rgyud rim byung gyi gdan sar gyur pa yin zhing dus phyis rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma spre zhing rin po che byang chub dpal sogs byung ba yin/ gzhung gi spre zhing ni da lta'i gong dkar rdzong rgya ri shang khongs gzhung spre zhing grong tshor gnas yod/ gzhung ni (gra dol gzhung gsum 〉zhes pa'i gra nang dang gcig gong dkar rdzong gi skyid gshongs shang gi dol gsung rab gling byung ba'i sa yul dang gnyis/ gong dkar rdzong rgya ri shang gi gzhung spre zhing dang gsum bcas rin gshongs sogs tshud yod/113

grin po ri'i lha khang /rab byung bzhi pa'i me stag spyi lo 1206lor kha che paṇa chen gyis me stag lo'i dbyar gnas srin po rir mdzad cing byams chos dang rigs tshogs sogasakyi chos gsungs pa'i gnas yin zhing srin po ri bde mchog srin po ri/drang srong srin po sogs ming gi rnam grangs gsum tsam 'dug cing srin po ri ni lho kha gong dkar rdzong rgya drug gling shang nas rtsis pa'i nub byang nye 'gram dang chu shur 'gram dang chu shur rdzong 'jun zer pa'i grong tsho'i byang khar 'khel gyin 'dug srin po ri'i nang rten ni bal po lha bzo zhig gis bzhengs pa'i bde mchog gi sku sogs nang rten ji yod ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/ srin po lha khang gi nye rgyud tsam nas 'go tshugs te kong po nying khri rdzong gi rtse la sgang bar du nub nas shar du bskyangs pa'i ri rgyud ma chad pa la kong po bar ri zhes 'bod par grags so/ /bdun phud chos 'khor/rab byung dang po'i lcags bya spyi lo 1089lor grwa pa mngon shes can gyis grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing de dang dus mtshungs par rin chen brgya dang bdun gyi phud las bzhengs pa'i bdun phud chos 'khor du grags pa 'di ni dus phyis sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon lag gras yin/ bdun phud chos 'khor ni lho kha gong dkar rdzong lci bde zhol shang khongs su yod pa yin/ (yig cha'i 'byung khungs du ku la'i kha skong nas drangs pa yin)114
'da'u da lho kha gong dkar rdzong dang nye bar ba zhig yin/ (yig cha'i 'byung khungs chems dang rgyal ba bcu gsum pa'i rnam

rgya tsha rdzong khul gyi dgon khagachos 'khorargyal dgon pa/(dwags po rgya tsha rdzong tshal khyu shang khongs chos 'khor rgyal grong tshor yod )rgyal ba sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos rab byung dgu pa'i sa sbrul spyi lo 1509lor phyag btab/1 chos 'khor rgyal la nang gses kyi dbang du byas na dwags po grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya bdun cu skor/2 chos 'khor rgyal grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi brgya bdun cu skor/2 mnga' ris grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya bzhi bcu skor/4 sgar pa grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu re bzhi skor/5 rnam rgyal grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad cu skor bcas sa stag spyi lo 1698lo'i bsdoms rtsis ltar na dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong nyis brgya brgyad cu skor yod/ gong gsal grwa tshang lnga'i byung stangs dus rabs snga rting gi skor dwags po grwa tshang ni dga' ldan khri rabs bdun pa blo gros brtan pas spyi lo 1472tsam gyi gong du dwags po grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs gnang de nas dus phyis chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon lag gras su yod pa yin/ chos 'khor rgyal ni spyi lo 1509lor rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos phyag btab/ mnga' ris grwa tshang ni lcags glang spyi lo 1541lor rgyal ba dge 'ardi/ sdu mtshos gsar 'dzugs gnang / rnam rgyal grwa tshang ni rgyal ba bsod

nams rgya mtshos me glang spyi lo 1577lor gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dang de nas rgyal ba sku phreng bzhi pa dang lnga pa chen po'i sku dus 'bras spungs dgon du spos rjes de nas rtse pho brang gi nub rgyud du spos pa nas bzung rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang zhes su grags/ chos 'khor rgyal ni dwags po rgya tsha rdzong nas rtsis pa'i byang shar thad spyi le bzhi bcu zhe drug tsam dang mal gro gung dkar rdzong gi ru thog chu tshan nas rkang thang du phyin na nyin lam gnyis la slebs pa yin/chos 'khor la gyi lha mo'i bla mcho'i skor/rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mchos sa sbrul spyi lo 1509lor dwags po rgya tsha'i sa khongs kyi chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon pa phyag btab cing de nas lcags lug spyi lo 1511lor chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon pa'i nye 'khor zhig nas lha mo'i bla mtsho gsar du rnyed pa de la dpal ldan lha mo'i bla mtsho yin pa ngos 'dzin gnang lugs skor rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar khongs su lo khams lcags lug yin pa gsal 'khod byung 'dug chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon pa ni shā/sa po rgya tsha rdzong nas rtsis pa'i byang shar phyogs spyi le nyi shu rtsa bdun yod pa dwags po bshad sgrub gling /dga' ldan khri rabs bdun pa rje blo gros brtan pas spyi lo 1522gong gi lo bcu grangs shig la phyag btab pa'i dwags po sa khul gyi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa che gras zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ dwags po bshad sgrub gling ni dwags po rgya tsha rdzong gi nye 'gram grum pa grong tshor yod cing grum pa grong tsho zhes pa 'di ni dus phyis paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma yang spyi lo 1〈〈2lor dwags po grum sdu/ sku

'khrungs pa yin no/ /rgyal lha thog steng /1 dwags po lha rje zla 'od gzhon nus gnas sgo phyes/ 2 rje tsong kha pa chen po sogs bod kyi mkhas sgrub du ma bzhugs myong ba dang / 2 sgrub sde dngos su byung ba'i dus rabs ni spyi lo 15〈〈tsam la lha sa nyang bran na kha ba thar pa rgyal mtshan gyis sgrub sde phyag btab pa bcas so/ / sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bcu skor yod/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang tshe smon gling ngag dbang tshul khrims gnyis kyis rnam thar khongs su rgyal lha thog steng ni brag gzar g.yang gzar can bgrod lam mi bde ba zhig 'khod 'dug rgyal lha thog steng ni dwags po rgya tsha rdzong chos 'khor rgyal dgon pa dang nye bar yod pa yin/bra steng dgon/'bri gung gi bla ma rin chen mgon pos bra'i 'debs shul du dgon phyag btab pas dgon ming de ltar chags/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug skor yod/ bra steng dgon ni dwags po rgya tsha rdzong ngar rab shang khongs tsam la 'khel ba yin/118

gra nang rdzong khul gyi dgon khagabasam yas gtsug lag khang /chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bzhengs pa'i bod kyi dgon pa snga shos ang dang po yin pa'i gtsug lag khang 'dir me lug spyi lo 767sad mi bdun sogs rab tu byung zhing dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa yin/ bsam yas ni gra nang rdzong bsam yas shang gi sa khongs su yod cing dkar chag shin tu rgyas pa zhig bka' blon bshad sgra ba dbang phyug rgyal pos shing stag spyi lo 1854lor gsar bsgrigs gnang ba de bzhin 'brel yod las khungs nas ring min par bskrun gnang rgyu'i 'char gzhi'i khongs su tshud pa zhig yod pa yin/(gra nang rdzong gi gra thang sdi lharno bye spyan pa pa ma/ngon shes kyis rab byung dang po'i lcags bya spyi lo 10〈1lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin pa dang gra thang dgon du yod pa'i ldebs ris ni dbus gtsang khul du mthong dkon pa'i ldebs ris gras su brtsi ba yin/sde bya dkar dgon/gra nang rdzong bsam yas shang khongs (dpyad khungs bsam yas dkar chag)119

mchims phu/(bsam yas nye rgyud kyi mchims phu )gsung gi dben gnas brag dmar ge'i tshang gi 'og tu 'du khang ka ba drug gi rgya khyon sogs nyams gso gang legs gnang lugs bsam yas dkar chag khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/mchims phu ni gra nang rdzong bsam yas shang khongs gra nang rdzong nas rtsis pa'i byang shar ngos spyi le nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam gyi sar gnas/brag dmar mgrin bzang /(gra nang rdzong bsam yas byang ngos nye bar yod/)chos rgyal khri srong 'khrungs pa'i sa yul pho brang brag dmar mgrin bzang ni khyon ka ba bcu gnyis kyi rgya khyon la nyams gso gang legs byung lugs skor bsam yas dkar chag khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/(bsam yas has po ri'i k+ta ṭā/rdo kāhā /la 'khel ba yin )ka chu lha khang 'di ni btsan po yab khri lde gtsug btsan ring la brag dmar ka chu gtsug lag khang brtsigs te sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad tshul phan chad gdung rabs lnga lon no zhes pa'i gsal bshad byung ba zhig mkhas pa'i dga' ston stod cha shog grangs 272par 'khod pa dang / dus phyis spyi lo 1854gong tsam la ka chu lha khang gi rgya khyon ji yod dang nyams gso ji ltar gnang tshul skor bsam yas dkar chag shog grangs 178par 'khod yod/120

gra nang dar rgyas chos sdengs/smin grol gling gi gdan sa ma byung gong gi rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin zhing gra nang rdzong khongs su yod/zur mkhar mdo sngags gling /me rta spyi lo 1426lor phyag btab pa'i dge lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ zur mkhar ni gra nang rdzong bsam yas dgon pa'i nub rgyud nye 'gram zur mkhar shang gi sa yul du yod cing khri srong lde btsan gyis bzhengs pa'i zur mkhar mchod rten sogs gna' shul 'ga' zhig mjal rgyu yod pa yin/ar dge dgon/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes bya 'dul 'dzin chen mo'i slob ma byang chub brtson 'grus kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu skor yod/ ar dge dgon ni gra nang rdzong gi khongs su yod/ bya 'dul 'dzin chen po ni rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags lug spyi lo 1191lor sku 'khrungs pa dang rgya 'dul 'dzin chen po ni rin spungs rdzong gi g.yung chu'i nye rgyud g.yung zhes par sku 'khrungs pa yin/gra byams pa gling /thu mi sam bho ṭa'i gdung rabs bcu gnyis pa drung chen tshul khrims bkra shis kyi sras bgres pa lhun grub bkra shis kyis phyag btab/ sras gnyis pa paṇa chenakhyams pa gling pas byams pa gling gi mchod rten chen mo dbus ga~X na

'gran zla bral ba zhig bzhengs pa yin zhing paṇa chen byams pa gling pa ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob gras kyi mtshan tho'i khongs su yod/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod/ gra byams pa gling dgon pa ni gra nang rdzong nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i nye 'gram spyi le sum brgya tsam gyi sar yod cing byams pa gling ni spyi lo 1472lor phyag btab pa yin/ dus phyis kun bde gling rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon pos 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang la sbyor 'jags gnang ba nas 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi dgon lag che gras zhig yin/rdo rje brag dgon pa/rnying ma'i bla ma rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang pos rdo rje brag rtsa'i sa yul du phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ ngag gi dbang po ni ( 1580da 1629)bar bzhugs rdo rje brag ni lho kha gong dkar rdzong 'phreng 'go shang khongs dang gong dkar rdzong nas rtsis pa'i byang shar phyogs spyi le bcu gsum tsam yod pa'i yar lung gtsang po'i byang 'gram dang rdo rje brag gru kha dang nye bar yod/ rdo rje brag dgon pa dang gra nang rdzong gi smin grol gling dgon pa gnyis ni bod ljongs dbus khul gyi rnying ma'i dgon pa che gras zhig yin/rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal/spyi lo 1621lor phyag 'debs zin pa'i rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal ni rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gzhi dgon yin lugs skor lnga pa chen po'i rang rnam pod dang po'i khongs su 'khod pa'i sde zhes pa 'di ni gra nang rdzong bsam yas shar rgyud rdo pho brang sogs sa ming re zung zhig yod pa yin/122

snye mdo dgon/rnying ma'i bla ma snye mdo ba kun dga' bzang pos (125ra 1 216)phyag btab par mngon zhing snye mdo dgon ni gra nang rdzong rgyal gling shang khongs snye mdo grong tshor yod cing gra nang rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le bcu gnyis tsam yod pa yin/ bod ljongs sa ming tho deb khongs su snye mdo dgon la 4snying sde zhes bris pa'i sa yul de rang yin zhing dag cha nor bcos dgos pa zhig 'dugamon mkhar dga' ldan lha ldings/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi skor yod/mon mkhar ni gra nang rdzong rnam sras gling shang gi nye skor du yod/mon mkhar phyug dgon/phag gru'i spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi skor yod/gra nang rdzong rnam sras gling shang khongs da lta mon dga' rong zhes pa'i sa yul du yod cing spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sa khyi spyi lo 1418lor bcoms pa'i spyan snga chos 'byung bris ma dpe rgyun dkon pa zhig yod pa dang de nasaspyan snga 'di nyid kyi slob ma lho rong rdzong pa rta tshag tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 6 lho rong chos 'byung mi ni bka' brgyud chos 'byung rgyas shos de byung ba yin/ /123

snye mdo dgon/rnying ma'i bla ma snye mdo ba kun dga' bzang pos (125ra 1 216)phyag btab par mngon zhing snye mdo dgon ni gra nang rdzong rgyal gling shang khongs snye mdo grong tshor yod cing gra nang rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le bcu gnyis tsam yod pa yin/ bod ljongs sa ming tho deb khongs su snye mdo dgon la 4snying sde zhes bris pa'i sa yul de rang yin zhing dag cha nor bcos dgos pa zhig 'dugamon mkhar dga' ldan lha ldings/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi skor yod/mon mkhar ni gra nang rdzong rnam sras gling shang gi nye skor du yod/mon mkhar phyug dgon/phag gru'i spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi skor yod/gra nang rdzong rnam sras gling shang khongs da lta mon dga' rong zhes pa'i sa yul du yod cing spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sa khyi spyi lo 1418lor bcoms pa'i spyan snga chos 'byung bris ma dpe rgyun dkon pa zhig yod pa dang de nasaspyan snga 'di nyid kyi slob ma lho rong rdzong pa rta tshag tshe dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 6 lho rong chos 'byung mi ni bka' brgyud chos 'byung rgyas shos de byung ba yin/ /123

mon mkhar bkra shis gdong /rje tsong kha pa chen pos zla 'khor gsum tsam bzhugs shing chos gsungs pa'iganas gzhi'i gras yin/ mon mkhar ni gra nang rdzong rnam sras gling shang khongs su yod cing bsam yas dgon pa'i lho rgyud bad gar 'khel gyin 'dugabasam yas has po ri/bsam yas gtsug lag khang nas rtsis pa'i shar rgyud nye 'dabs su yod cing has po ri'i rtser has po ri'i lha khang du khri srong lde btsan dang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku brnyan sogs bzhugs yod/ has po ri ni ri chen bzhi'i gras su bgrangs srol 'dugasmin grol gling dgon pa/rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi bla ma gter bdag gling pa 'gyur med rdo rjes me 'brug spyi lo 1676lor gra nang rdzong gi gra phyi'i sa yul 'dir smin grol gling gi dgon pa phyag btab pa nas dus phyis me bya spyi lo 1717bar dar rgyas che bar byung zhing de nas me bya lo jun gar bas rtsa gtor btang pas yul ring nyams rgyad can du gyur rjes slar yang zhig gsos rgya che ba rim par byung ba yin/nang rten ji yod sde dge ka thog si tu'i gnas yig 'di cung kha gsal ba zhig byung 'dug124

chu gsum rdzong khul gyi dgon khag ri sgo chos sde/gtsang pa ngag dbang grags pas phyag btab pa'i e ri sgo chos sde ni dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gsum skor yod/ ri sgo chos sde ni e che ba'i khongs dang da lta'i chu gsum rdzong gi nye 'gram 'di rang la 'khel ba dang e chung ba ni zangs ri rdzong gi brag dkar shangagi shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi e chung ba zhes yul mi'i grong tsho chung ngu zhig yod pa yin/te'u dgon pa/rje tsong kha pa chen po rgyun ring tsam bzhugs myong ba'i dgon pa zhig yin pa dang shar rgyal mo rong pa tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas rgyal mo rong du dge lugs kyi dgon sde 'ga' zhig phyag 'debs zin lugs kyi zhu yig rten sbrags ma zhig rje'i phyag tu son skabs yul dbus kyi cha te'u ra nas chab shog 'phrin yig bskur gnang ba yin/ de ni lho kha chu gsum rdzong khongs dang de sngon lo rgyus thog e lha rgyal ri'i khongs su yod/e se po dgon/bya pa khri dpon gyi mi thog gong ma a mi bya nag chen pos spyi lo 1204yas mas zhig la phyag btab cing de nas hor dmag gdi ñtsha lo

1260tsam la gtor bzhigs btang skabs dgon pa 'thor zhig tu gyur/'di phyogs kyi kha rgyun la dpon po grogs po skam po la bcol na dga' zhes mkhar btsan po mang du brtsigs pa'i lo rgyus zhig 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi rnam thar khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dug ye se bo dgon ni da lta'i chu gsum rdzong se bo shang gi sa yul 'di tsam la 'khel ba yin/se mdo dga' ldan rnam la/e lha rgyal ri zhabs drung blo bzang mthu stobs kyis chos sde gsar tu brtsigs rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa'i spyi lo 1621loraye se mdor phebs te rab gnas gnang ba yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang drug cu skor yod/ se mdo ni da lta'i chu gsum rdzong se bo shang gi lung pa'i mdo tsam la 'khel ba yin/ se bo ni de sngon e stod chu tshan kha zhes e stod kyi sa'i char gtogs pa yin/klog chos sde/bya pa khri dpon gyi mi thog gong ma'i gras yon tan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ de ni chu gsum rdzong se bo shang khongs klog ces pa'i grong tshor yod/bla 'bring chos sde/dga' ldan khri thog bcu gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab dar rgyas legs pa'i blo gros ni lcags rta lor e phyogs su 'khrungs/ rab byung dgu pa'i lca/sdu sdug spyi lo 1511lor dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs 'di nyid gzhon nu'i
dus skabs su bla 'bring chos sder chos sgoskabs chos sde zhig ni byung ba yin zhing tshopa zhig yin/ bla 'bring chos sde ni chu ga lha rgya ri nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams

sne gdong rdzong khul gyi dgon khagartsed thang dgon pa/phag gru'i srid rabs dang po tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung drug pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1251lor phyag btab pa'i dwags po bka' brgyud kyi bshad grwa thengs dang po de yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya dang bcu skor yod/ de ni lho kha sa khul sne gdong rdzong khongs rtsed thang grong brdal du yod/khra 'khrug gtsug lag khang /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang gas khra 'brug bkra shis byams snyoms kyi gtsug lag khang ni lho kha sa khul sne gdong rdzong khra 'brug shang gi sa yul du yod/rtsed thang lnga mchod grwa tshang /sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya dang bcu skor bcas rtsed thang dgon pa gnyis la khyon bsdoms dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi brgya nyi shu skor yod pa yin/ de ni sne gdong rdzong khongs rtsed thang grong brdal du yod/128

yar lung rnam rgyal lha khang /rje tsong kha pa chen pos yar lung rnam rgyal lha khang du bsnyen rdzogs dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes pa'i yar lung rnam rgyal ni thog ma'i skabs su tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bskrun pa'i mkhar rdzong 'dra ba zhig bskrun yod pa dang de nas dus phyis lha khang gi rnam pa can du gyur ba zhig yin/ yar lung rnam rgyal lha khang dang sne gdong rnam rgyal lha khang yang zer ba 'di bzhin rgyal ba bdun pa'i dus skabs dang spyi lo 1854tsam la nyams gso snga ting gnyis tsam byas 'dugabasam 'grub bde ba chen po'i lha khang /〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉stod cha lcags par shog grangs 145par gu ru chos dbang gis dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga'i tshun la lha khang grub par mdzad tshul 'khod pa'i bsam 'grub bde chen la dus phyis bsdus ming kho na bris rgyun 'jags te bsam bde zhes bris pa dang bsam bde ni phag gru'i sde srid dang bsam bde dpon blon gyi sde gzar byung lugs bshad pa'i bsam bde ni sne gdong rdzong yum bu bla sgang gi lho rgyud nye 'dabs su yod pa'i dus phyis rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gzhis ga'i gras yin/bya sa lha khang /bya sa'i lha btsan chen pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang 'di la de sngon rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku chen po sogs bzhugs pa yin zhing bya sa lha khang ni lho kha sne gdong rdzong gi nye 'gram bya sa grong mi lhan tshogs kyi gnas yul 'di yin/yig cha'i dpyad khungs kun bde gling rta tshag sku phreng bcu pa ngag dbang /sdu kyi

yar lung rnam rgyal lha khang /rje tsong kha pa chen pos yar lung rnam rgyal lha khang du bsnyen rdzogs dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes pa'i yar lung rnam rgyal ni thog ma'i skabs su tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bskrun pa'i mkhar rdzong 'dra ba zhig bskrun yod pa dang de nas dus phyis lha khang gi rnam pa can du gyur ba zhig yin/ yar lung rnam rgyal lha khang dang sne gdong rnam rgyal lha khang yang zer ba 'di bzhin rgyal ba bdun pa'i dus skabs dang spyi lo 1854tsam la nyams gso snga ting gnyis tsam byas 'dugabasam 'grub bde ba chen po'i lha khang /〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉stod cha lcags par shog grangs 145par gu ru chos dbang gis dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga'i tshun la lha khang grub par mdzad tshul 'khod pa'i bsam 'grub bde chen la dus phyis bsdus ming kho na bris rgyun 'jags te bsam bde zhes bris pa dang bsam bde ni phag gru'i sde srid dang bsam bde dpon blon gyi sde gzar byung lugs bshad pa'i bsam bde ni sne gdong rdzong yum bu bla sgang gi lho rgyud nye 'dabs su yod pa'i dus phyis rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gzhis ga'i gras yin/bya sa lha khang /bya sa'i lha btsan chen pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang 'di la de sngon rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku chen po sogs bzhugs pa yin zhing bya sa lha khang ni lho kha sne gdong rdzong gi nye 'gram bya sa grong mi lhan tshogs kyi gnas yul 'di yin/yig cha'i dpyad khungs kun bde gling rta tshag sku phreng bcu pa ngag dbang /sdu kyi

rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar nas btus pa yin/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsung khrod du bya sa lha khang ni mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyis bzhengs lugs 'khod pa gnyis 'brel ba nges can zhig yod par nges/mkhar thog dgon gsar/bod kyi lo rgyus thog phag gru'i srid rabs drug pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mkhar thog dgon gsar bzung ba dang de nas shing rta spyi lo 1414lor dbang grags pa 'byung gnas yang dgon gsar du sku 'khrungs lugs bshad pa'i dgon pa de yin/ de ni lho kha sne gdong rdzong mkhar thog shang gi sa yul 'dir mkhar thog dang mkhar thog dgon gsar gnyis ka byung ba yin/bkra shis rdo kha/sne gdong rdzong skyer ba shang gi sa khongs yin pa'i 'on gyi bkra shes rdo kha ni rab byung bdun pa'i shing rta spyi lo 1414lor rje tsong kha pa chen po rgyun ring tsam bzhugs/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dbu sku bzhar thengs re nang rten du bzhugs pa'i sku 'dra bkra shes rdo kha ma zhes pa de yang de skabs bzhengs par grags/ lo 'di la rgyal dbang dge 'dun grub pa yang dgung lo nyer lnga'i dus su bkra shis rdo khar rje'i sku mdun du bcar nas rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob mar gyur ba yin/ke ru lha khang /sne gdong rdzong gi skyer pa shang gi sa khongs ke ru grong tshor yod pa'i 'on ke sta ṭ+wāṃ khang ni bod kyi btsan po khri lde gtsug brtan gyis bzhengs par grags

pa'i lha khang 'di la btsan po dang rgya bza' rjes ma'i sku 'dra sogs yod cing dus phyis jo bo rje yang ke ru lha khang du zla 'khor gcig tsam bzhugs lugs 'khod pa'ang yod/ de ni rtsed thang nas rtsis pa'i ke ru lha khang bar du spyi le sdu/ brgyad tsam dang rtsed thang nas rtsis pa'i byang shar mtshams su 'khel ba nas chung phugami la ras pa'i slob ma ras chung ba'i sgrub phug ras chung phug ni lho kha rtsed thang nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le dgu tsam gyi sar yod cing de sngon lo rgyus nang yar lung stod smad gnyis kyi bar mtshams su 'khel lugs bshad pa zhig yod pa yin/bkra shis chos sde/sne gdong gi blon po sde pa bkra shis rtse pa dang / sa skya'i bla ma mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros mchod yon du 'brel skabs rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags yosasbyi lo 1591lor phyag btab pa'i sa skya'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ bod kyi dmangs khrod du dar ba'i yar klung bkra shes zhol pa'i lha mo tshogs pa yang bkra shis chos sde'i nye 'dabs 'di nas byung ba yin/ bkra shis zlo/ sde ni sne gdong rdzong mkhar thog shang khongs bkra shis chos sde'i grong tshor rtsed thang dge ldan bkra shis chos 'khor/mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis rab byung bcu gnyis pasnyi 31 bya

spyi lo 1729tsam la gsar tu bskrun pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ de nas bar lam zhig bstan rgyas gling bla brang nas spyi lo 1899lo bar du rgyun ring tsam zhor 'dzin gnang 'dug de ni sne gdong rdzong rtsed thang grong brdal du yod pa yin/ yig cha'i 'byung khungs 〈mi dbang rtogs brjod 〉lcags par shog grangs 704nas btus pa yin zhing dus phyis kyi yig lam 'gar rtsed thang dga' chos dang / dga' chos las 'dzin zhes dgon pa'i 'tsho 'dzin zhig bsko bzhag byed srol byung ba yin/ /bying bsam gtan rtse/bying pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu skor yod/ lnga pa chen po'i sku dus su dus kyi bying rnam gnyis zhes bsdus ming du bris pa'i bying ni bying pa ba dang rnam ni rnam sras gling gi don yin/ bying bsam gtan rtse ni sne gdong rdzong bying klu shang gi sa khongs su yod/ bying mda' o dkar brag ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i sgrub gnas gras zhig yin/ri bo chos gling /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma chos rje don grub dpal bas phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya /dri ༵ ༵༵ /ra yod/ ri bo chos gling dgon ni sne gdong rdzong kha 'brug shang 132

spyi lo 1729tsam la gsar tu bskrun pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ de nas bar lam zhig bstan rgyas gling bla brang nas spyi lo 1899lo bar du rgyun ring tsam zhor 'dzin gnang 'dug de ni sne gdong rdzong rtsed thang grong brdal du yod pa yin/ yig cha'i 'byung khungs 〈mi dbang rtogs brjod 〉lcags par shog grangs 704nas btus pa yin zhing dus phyis kyi yig lam 'gar rtsed thang dga' chos dang / dga' chos las 'dzin zhes dgon pa'i 'tsho 'dzin zhig bsko bzhag byed srol byung ba yin/ /bying bsam gtan rtse/bying pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu skor yod/ lnga pa chen po'i sku dus su dus kyi bying rnam gnyis zhes bsdus ming du bris pa'i bying ni bying pa ba dang rnam ni rnam sras gling gi don yin/ bying bsam gtan rtse ni sne gdong rdzong bying klu shang gi sa khongs su yod/ bying mda' o dkar brag ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i sgrub gnas gras zhig yin/ri bo chos gling /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma chos rje don grub dpal bas phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya /dri ༵ ༵༵ /ra yod/ ri bo chos gling dgon ni sne gdong rdzong kha 'brug shang 132

pho zang rgyal sar sgang /bka' gdams kyi dgon rnying zhig la phyis su zhig gsos zhus pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ pho brang zhes pa'i go don ni chos rgyal mes ag tshom sku 'khrungs pa'i sa yul pho brang tshal zhes pa de rang yin pa ngos 'dzin byed kyin yod cing rgyu mtshan ni yar lha sham po'i yul lha khros te yar lung gi chus pho brang la 'jigs pa byung lugs kyi ngag sgrung zhig yod pa dang pho brang ni da lta'i sne gdong rdzong gi pho brang shang gi sa yul 'di ni yar lung gi cha 'gram la 'khel gyin 'dugartse chogs pa/ kha che paṇa chen gyi slob ma rdo rje dpal bas rab byung bzhi pa'i shing bya spyi lo 1225lor phyag btab pa'i tshogs pa sde bzhi'i nang nas snga shos su byung ba 'diyin/ rtse tshogs pa ni sne gdong rtser yod pa la brten nas rtse tshogs pa zhes su grags shing / gtsang chos lung tshogs pa ni spyi lo 1255shing yos lor phyag btab pa yin zhing chos lung tshogs pa ni rin spungs rdzong snubs chos lung tshogs pa zhes sgrubs zhes pa'i sa yul du byung ba dang de nas rgyal rtser spos pa nas gtsang spos khang tshogs pa zhes zer gyin 'dugayum bu bla mkhar/bod kyi btsan po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i pho brang yum bu bla mkhar ni lo rgyus thog nyams gso thengs gsum bzhi byung ba yin zhing thog ma'i ༵ sbyang

girnam pa de la 'gyur ba nges can zhig byung 'dug yum bu bla mkhar ni sne gdong rdzong khra 'brug shang dang nye bar yod pa yin/btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang /khri srong lde btsan gyi yum ngang tshul byang chub rgyal mos bzhengs lugs skor mkhyen brtse'i gnas yig ltar bris pa yin zhing / g.yu yi lha khang ni sne gdong rdzong mkhar thog shang khongs btsan thang grong tshor byung ba yin/'on dga' ldan chos 'khor sdings/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 169〈lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/ de ni sne gdong rdzong 'on zhes pa'i skyer pa shang khongs dang rtsed thang nas rtsis pa'i yar lung gtsang po'i byang 'gram du yod pa yin/ dgon pa 'di'i bla sprul ni 'on rgyal sras sprul sku rim byung gi gdan sa yin/'on mda' mnga' ris grwa tshang /sne gdong rdzong 'on zhes pa'i lung pa'i mdar 'khel ba'i dgon pa zhig gi ming yin/g.ya' bzang dgon pa/g.ya' bzang chos rje chos smon gyis phyag btab pa'i g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa 'di ni me stag spyi lo 1206phyag btab pa yin/ de ni sne gardodī /nga yar lha sham po'i gangs ri'i nye 'dabs chos sde gong shang khongs

g.ya' bzang grong tshor yod/yar stod thos bsam dar rgyas gling /lcags yos spyi lo 1651lor gsar tu btsugs pa'i thos bsam dar rgyas gling la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya brgyad cu gya lnga skor yod/ de ni sne gdong rdzong chos sde gong shang dang chos sde 'og shang gnyis las chos sde gong gi sa yul 'di ni yar stod thos bsam dar rgyas gling gi dgon gnas 'dir 'khel gyin yod 'dug pas da dung zhib 'jug gnang ba'i re 'dun zhu rgyu yin/135

'phyongs rgyas rdzong khul gyi dgon khagari bo bde chen/'phyongs rgyas sde pa rdo rje tshe brtan nas sbyin bdag zhus te phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga brgyar nye ba zhig yod/ 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen dgon pa phyag btab pa'i dus rabs thad sa rta spyi lo 149〈lor 'phyongs rgyas sde pa rdo rje tshe brtan sku 'das lugs skor mkhas pa'i dga' ston smad cha shogs grangs 1129par 'khod pa dang sde pa 'di nyid kyi phying dbar lhag rtse rdzong gi bsgrun dngos khag cig rgyas bskrun mdzad pa yin/ ri bo bde chen ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi rgyab ri 'phyongs rgyas rtser byung ba yin/ /spyan g.yas dgon/gra pa mngon shes kyis spyi lo 10〈1lcags glang lor gra nang rdzong gi grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing dus skabs de 'dra zhig la spyan g.yas dgon pa yang phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga gsum skor yod/ de ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong rgyal sman shang khongs spyan g.yas grong tshor yod/dpal3 dgon/13spyang ma'i bla ma 'phreng 'go gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyis phyag

btab pa'i 'phyongs rgyas dpal ri dgon ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong 'phyongs rgyas shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud 'gram spyi le lnga tsam yod pa dang sngon lo rgyus thog sde dge rdzogs chen sku phreng dang po pad+ma rig 'dzin (1625 1697)bar bzhugs pa'i sku phreng dang po yang dpal ri dgon du rgyun ring tsam bzhugs shing de nas dus phyis su sde dge'i phyogs nas grwa rgyun mi nyung ba yang dpal rir slob gnyer byed pa yin/ 'phreng 'go gter ston shes rab 'od zer ni rab byung dgu pa'i me glang spyi lo 1517lor sku 'khrungs shing 'di nyid kyis 'bri gung zhwa lha khang yang glang lor nyams gso rgya che zhig gnang lugs skor zhwa lhakhang gi dkar chag khongs su 'khod pa dang sa glang 'di spyi lo 1529lor 'khel bas sku na ches gzhon pa'i dus skabs shig yin/ lo dus thad da dung zhib 'jug gnang bar zhu rgyu yin/che ring ljongs/(rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig )lho kha 'phyongs rgyas rdzong don mkhar lung pa'i phur yod pa'i tshe ring ljongs ni kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i gdan sa yin/ 'jigs med gling pa ni (1729da 1798)bar bzhugs shing (sa bya chas rta bar )don mkhar mda' ni bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rabs sum cu pa stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs par bshad pa'i 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi nye 'gram du 'khel ba yin/thang po che/klu sa chen po'i slob ma gru mer sogs mched brgyad kyis me sbrul spyi lo 957lor phyag btab cing khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis dar rgyas su mdzad pa dang de nas spyi lo 1047tsam la jo bo rje a ti sha yang rgyun thushā shām

zhig thang po cher bzhugs/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya nyi shu skor yod/ khu ston ni khu'i nus ming can 'dus sdod byed pa'i khu mi zhes pa'i grong tsho zhig thang po che'i shang khongs su yod pa yin zhing de dang 'brel ba nges can zhig yod pa yin/ dus phyis rab byung bzhi pa'i me yos spyi lo 1204lor kha che paṇa chen shākya shis thang po cher bstan rtsis mdzad par/smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la/ /zla ba ri bo la nub tshe/ /thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /de rjes lo ni stong phrag gcig /bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang / /zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed/ /de bzhin nye ma lnga rabs 'das/ /zhes deb sngon du gsal ba ltar kha snon zhus yod cing spyi lo 1956lor sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo 'khor nyis stong lnga brgya tham pa 'khor ba'i chos lugs kyi dus dran rgya che ba zhig rgya gar sdi lir tshogs pa yin/bkra shis bde chen/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob chos rje don grub dpal bas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu skor yod/ bkra shis bde chen ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong chang khyim shang gi nye 'khor tsam la 'khel ba yin/ chang khyim ni dus phyis kyi bka' blon dang srid blon gras bshad zhol chang gsum zhes bshad sgra ba dang / zhol khang / chang khyim ba/lha /sum yod pa'i zhol khang dang chang khyim gnyis 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi sa

khongs nas byung ba yin/chos 'khor steng / mkhar chen chos 'phags pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ chos 'khor steng ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi nye 'khor zhig la 'khel ba yin/'phyongs rgyas lam rim theg chen gling /rje tsong kha pa chen mo'i slob ma gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyis lam rim gyi bka' chos gsungs pa'i gnas yin stabs dgon ming de ltar chags phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad skor yod/ de ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong 'phyongs rgyas zer pa'i grong tshor yod/rol khang /gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gtsug lag khang gsar tu bzhengs lugs ltar na bstan pa'i phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras yin/ rol khang ni 'phyongs rgyas rdzong rgyal smad shang khongs rol khang grong tshor yod cing rgyal sman ni 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal ba'i 'khrungs yul rgyal sman gyi nye skor zhig la yod pa yin/ gzus ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gras 'dar shākya yon tan gyis gzus po bzung de nas mched pa la 'dar tsho zhes grags pa'i da lta'i lha rtse rdzong gi brang mo che'i nye phyogs tsam la 'khel ba yin/139

mcho sna rdzong khul gyi dgon khagamado mkhar lhun grub pho brang /rnying ma'i bla ma gter chen rat+na gling pa'i gdan sa yin cing mdo mkhar rdzong ni mdo mkhar zhabs drung ngag dbang tshangs pa'i sku dus nas mdo mkhar pa'i khyim tshang byung ba'i 'go tshugs pa dang ngag dbang tshangs pa'i sras ni mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈mi dbang rtogs brjod 〉sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig yod pa yin/ mdo mkhar ni da lta'i lho kha sa khul mtsho sna rdzong mdo mkhar shang gi sa yul du byung ba dang zhib phra'i skor 'ol dga' rje drung gi rnam thar sogs dpyad khungs 'ga' zhig yod/ mdo /kār+sha zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal ni (1697rtse1762)bar bzhugs yo rgyan gling /rgyal ba sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i yab rig 'dzin bkra shis tshe ring nas yar rtsis pa'i mi rabs drug pa o rgyan gling pas phyag btab pa'i rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ o rgyan gling ni lho kha mtsho sna rdzong gi las khungs nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le brgyad tsam gyi skyid pa zer pa'i grong tsho'i ri ldebs su yod pa yin/ (yig cha'i dpyad khungs be+e ser lcags par shog grangs 492nas btus te drangs pa yin/ )140

mcho sna dgon pa rtse/da lta'i mtsho sna rdzong nas rtsis pa'i shar phyogs spyi le gnyis tsam yodapa'i dgon pa ni spyi lo 1846bar du mi lo sum brgya dang bdun cu skor phyin 'dug pas mi lo lnga brgya dang lnga bcu skor gyi lo rgyus yod pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/spyor ra dgon/rnying ma'i bla ma sbyor ra sprul sku rim byung gi gdan sa yin/ sbyor ra /spya/ ni mtsho sna rdzong sbyor ra shang gi sa khongs sbyor ra zhes pa'i sa yul du yod 141

mcho smad rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagadang dgon gsar/ cirab byung bcu pa'i me yos spyi lo 1467lor rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho gdang pas gdang mkhar smon grub khyung rtser gdan 'dren zhus te gdang dgon gsar du phebs lugs rnam thar khongs su 'khod cing gdang zhes pa'i sa yul de ni da lta'i mtsho smad rdzong gdang pa shang gdang pa zhes pa de la 'greng bu re sbyar te gdeng zhes bris pa'i sa yul de rang yin/ mtsho smad ni lcags rtse gri gu'i mtsho chen gyi smad phyogs su 'khel pa'i gsar du btsugs pa'i rdzong 'go'i gras shig yin/yug nam steng dgon/shud bu zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon rnying gras zhig yin zhing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so brgyad skor yod/ yug nam steng ni lho kha sa khul mtsho sdu/ rdzong gtam shul shang khongs da lta nam steng zhes 'bod pa'i dgon pa 'di gtam shul bkra shis chos gling /lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang rje tsong kha pa chen po gnyi1swā sna'i slob ma yin pa'i mgon po byang chub pas phyag btab lugs dang

chos rje don grub dpal bas phyag btab lugs bcas bshad khungs mi 'dra ba gnyis 'dug bkra shis chos gling la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu skor yod/ de ni da lta'i lho kha sa khul mtsho smad rdzong gtam shul shang gi sa yul du yod pa yin/smra bo lcog dgon pa/rnying ma'i bla ma nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gdan sa yin nyang nyi ma 'od zer ni (1124da 1195)bar bzhugs shing mkhas pa'i dga' ston khongs su nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis bsam 'grub bde chen gyi lha khang (yum bu bla sgang gi lho zhol nye 'dabs su yod )zhwa lu dgon pa'i nye skor gyi tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i lha khang bzhengs lugs tsam las smra bo lcog gi skor tshig zur tsam 'khod pa byung mi 'dug cing smra bo lcog ni nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gdan sa yin lugs skor 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gnas yig las btus te bris pa yin/ smra bo lcog ni lho kha sa khul mtsho smad rdzong gtam shul shang khongs mtsho smad rdzong nas rtsis pa'i byang shar ngos spyi le gnyis tsam gyi sar yod pa yin/143

zangs ri rdzong khul gyi dgon khagardzing phyi dgon pa/bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gas gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis phyag btab/ dus phyis rab byung bdun pa'i me byi spyi lo 1296tsam la rje tsong kha pa chen pos rdzong phyi'i gtsug lag khang gi ldebs ris sogs nyams gso gnang ba yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya lnga bcu skor yod/ de ni zangs ri rdzong rdzing phyi shang khongs dang shang gi nye 'gram du yod/ rdzing phyi dgon pa dang 'brel yod kyi dgon pa 'ga' zhig1 rab byung dgu pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1520lor 'ol dga' sde pa nang so don yod rnam rgyal gyis rdzing phyi'i dgon bdag rgyal dbang sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor sbyor 'bul zhus/2 chu rta spyi lo 1642lor kong dmag gis rdzing phyi dgon pa dang dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam mer bsregs/2 shing sprel spyi lo 1644lor rdzing phyi dgon pa slar yang zhig gsos legs par grub/4 dus phyis chu sprel spyi lo 1922tsam la rdzing phyi dgon par me skyon shorwa/rmā

zangs ri rdzong khul gyi dgon khagardzing phyi dgon pa/bstan pa phyi dar gyi gnas gzhi'i gas gar mi yon tan g.yung drung gis phyag btab/ dus phyis rab byung bdun pa'i me byi spyi lo 1296tsam la rje tsong kha pa chen pos rdzong phyi'i gtsug lag khang gi ldebs ris sogs nyams gso gnang ba yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya lnga bcu skor yod/ de ni zangs ri rdzong rdzing phyi shang khongs dang shang gi nye 'gram du yod/ rdzing phyi dgon pa dang 'brel yod kyi dgon pa 'ga' zhig1 rab byung dgu pa'i lcags stag spyi lo 1520lor 'ol dga' sde pa nang so don yod rnam rgyal gyis rdzing phyi'i dgon bdag rgyal dbang sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor sbyor 'bul zhus/2 chu rta spyi lo 1642lor kong dmag gis rdzing phyi dgon pa dang dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam mer bsregs/2 shing sprel spyi lo 1644lor rdzing phyi dgon pa slar yang zhig gsos legs par grub/4 dus phyis chu sprel spyi lo 1922tsam la rdzing phyi dgon par me skyon shorwa/rmā

5 'on rgyal sras ngag dbang ye shes 'jigs med kyis rdzing phyi'i byams par gser zangs kyi rgya phebs gsar du bzhengs lugs ltar na dus phyis rdzing phyi'i dgon bdag 'on chos sdings bla brang gis gnang ba yin/ rdzing phyi dgon par sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya lnga bcu skor yod/ gong du gsal pa'i 'on rgyal sras ngag dbang ye shes 'jigs med ni rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs sa bya spyi lo 1729lo nas lha sa smon lam chen mo'i gral dbur phebs myong ba de yin/rin chen sganganamakhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho dgung lo so bdun bzhes pa'i lo nas dgung lo dgu bcu go gcig par 'ol dga' rin chen sgang du bzhugs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho yang gnas 'dir byon te nor bzang rgya mtsho dang thugs 'dris che ba zhig yin/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho ni (1422da 1512)bar bzhugs shing 'di nyid kyis bcoms pa'i rtsis gzhung zhig yod pa la brten phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/ (rgya mtsho rnam gsum gyi gras bgrangs ba yin/) rin chen sgang ni zangs ri rdzong dgon stod shang khongs rin chen sgang grong tshor yod/ri bo gser gling /rje tsong kha pa chen pos rab gnas mdzad myong ba'i sgrub sde zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug skor yod/ de ni zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' shang khongs/145

sleb ri dgon/sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma bsam gtan bkra shis pas phyag btab pa'i 'ol dga' sa phyogs kyi dgon pa cung che gras zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod/de ni zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' shang khongs su yod/ sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob gras yin/ (1292—1420)chu sprel nas lcags stag bar dgung lo bdun cu don dgu bzhugs/rgya sog gi lha sdings/rje tsong kha pa chen po rgyun ring tsam bzhugs myong ba'i gnas khyad par can zhig dang de nas dus phyis rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos sgrub sde gsar du btsugs shing dge slong bcu skor re tsam bzhugs/ don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos spyi lo 1604shing 'brug lor mtsho sngon zi ling gi byang shar cung nye bar dgon lung byams pa gling phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong lnga brgya skor yod/ rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sprul sku rim byon la 'on rgyal sras dang 'on chos sdings bla brang ni sne gdong rdzong skyer pa shang gi sa yul 'dir yod pa yin/ rgya sog gi sgrub sde ni zangs ri rdzong rdzing phyi shang gi nye skor du yod pa yin/gdan sa mthil dgon pa/sde dge 'bri chu shar rgyud me shod du sku 'khrungs pa'i phag gru rdo rje rgyal pos rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1158lor phyag btab pa'i phag gru bzhi zlorgyud kyi gdan sa dang po yin/ gdan sa mthil ni zangs ri rdzong nas

sleb ri dgon/sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma bsam gtan bkra shis pas phyag btab pa'i 'ol dga' sa phyogs kyi dgon pa cung che gras zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod/de ni zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' shang khongs su yod/ sems dpa' chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob gras yin/ (1292—1420)chu sprel nas lcags stag bar dgung lo bdun cu don dgu bzhugs/rgya sog gi lha sdings/rje tsong kha pa chen po rgyun ring tsam bzhugs myong ba'i gnas khyad par can zhig dang de nas dus phyis rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos sgrub sde gsar du btsugs shing dge slong bcu skor re tsam bzhugs/ don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos spyi lo 1604shing 'brug lor mtsho sngon zi ling gi byang shar cung nye bar dgon lung byams pa gling phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong lnga brgya skor yod/ rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sprul sku rim byon la 'on rgyal sras dang 'on chos sdings bla brang ni sne gdong rdzong skyer pa shang gi sa yul 'dir yod pa yin/ rgya sog gi sgrub sde ni zangs ri rdzong rdzing phyi shang gi nye skor du yod pa yin/gdan sa mthil dgon pa/sde dge 'bri chu shar rgyud me shod du sku 'khrungs pa'i phag gru rdo rje rgyal pos rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1158lor phyag btab pa'i phag gru bzhi zlorgyud kyi gdan sa dang po yin/ gdan sa mthil ni zangs ri rdzong nas

/sdu pa'i byang gi sa phyogs spyi le brgyad tsam yod pa'i ljang shang khongs su yod cha dkar chos sde/yongs grags la rong cha dkar chos sde ni e lha rgya ri ba byams pa rab brtan gyis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad skor yod/ cha dkar chos sde ni zangs ri rdzong rong shang dkyil grong tshor 'khel gyin 'dug cing e lha rgya ri'i sa khongs cha shas rong cha dkar zangs ri rdzong khongs su yod cing gsum rdzing gi khongs su 'gril snang ngo / /skyid smad snye thang nas rong cha dkar chos sde bar gtsang chu'i chu shugs la brten gzhung ko shar bgrod thub kyin yod/ chu phag lo spyi lo 1622lor don rkyen zhig byung yod skor du ku la'i glegs bam pod dang po lcags par ma'i shog /)sdu shārdo/par gsal 'khod byung ba 'di ni chu thog 'grim 'grul gyi dpyad e rong dga' ldan chos gling /saskyong lha rgya ri ba'i mi thog gras phyag rdor bas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe brgyad skor yod/ de sngon lo rgyus thog e lha rgya ri'i khongs yin pa'i da lta'i zangs ri rdzong rong shang gi sa khongs 'khel ba yin/147

'ol dga' bsam gling /dwags po lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu'i sgrub khang gi shul mal yod pa dang de nas dus gyis rje tsong kha pa chen po yang bsam gling du bzhugs nas chos gnang myong ba'i gnas gzhi khyad par can zhig yin/ dwags po lha rje 'od gzhon nu ni (1097 1152)bar bzhugs shing 'khrungs yul ni lhun rtse rdzong gnyal smad kyi sa khongs 'di 'dra zhig la 'khel ba yin/ de ni zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' shang sdongs su yod/'ol dga' chu bzang dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen pos zhabs kyi bcags pa'i gnas mal der rje'i slob ma drung chos bsod nams blo gros pas phyag btab pa yin sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu gya bzhi skor yod cing drung chos dang rje drung drung pa sogs gtsang phyogs kyi zhe sa'i 'bod stangs zhig dang de nas dus phyis dbus khul du dpon rigs khyim tshang che gras kyi zhol khang rje drung / zur khang rje drung / stag rtse rje drung / la mo rje drung dang sku che khagakun bde gling rje drung / 'ol dga' rje drung rje 'brong rtse lha btsun rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis bcas la sbyar ba zhig 'dug de ni zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' shang gi khongs su yod/nyi ma gling /phagagru'i sde srid grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus su byung ba'i drung chen bzhi 13 rgyal mtshan gyis sbyin bdag zhus te rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma

chos rje bzang skyong bas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu re drug skor yod/ drung chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan ni rgyal tshab chos rje'i mdun du dge slong gi sdom pa zhus rjes 'ol dga' dge sbyong chen po zhes mtshan nas 'bod pa de yin/ nyi ma gling ni zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' shang khongs su yod/gar phugamakha' 'gro ma dag gis gar byed pa'i gtam rgyud zhig gi khungs sne tsam yod pa'i ri khrod zhig yin/ de ni zangs ri rdzong rdzing phyi dgon pa'i byang rgyab phyogs su nye bar yod/ /zangs ri mkhar dmar/ma gcig lab sgron gyi gdan sa 'di ni zangs ri rdzong khongs dang yar lung gtsang po'i chu dkyil gling phran chung ngu 'dra pa zhig gi steng du dgon pa gnas/ / 149

lhan rtse rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagra gor dgon/smyos ston chos 'bar gyis rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1111lor phyag btab/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig skor yod/ lhun rtse rdzong zhing pa shang khongs zhing pa shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye 'gram du yod pa yin/ smyos ston ni kha rag gnyos lo tsā ba'i gdung rgyud dus phyis gnyon zhes 'bri ba dang kha rag gnyon lo tsā ba ni mar pa lo tsā ba dang mnyam du rgya gar du slob gnyer la byon pa yin/gser phye kha/bka' gdams kyi dge bshes sne'u zur pa'i slob ma byang sems thugs rje rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing 'di nyid kyi gser phye 'bum pa'i mchod rten phal cher grub la khad la sku gshegs de nas dus phyis rje tsong kha pa chen pos gser phye 'bum par mchod 'bul dang smon lam rgya cher gnang ba'i dus skabs de 'dra zhig la chos lugs dge lugs su 'gyur ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe dgu skor yod/ gser phye kha ni lhun rtse rdzong gnyal smad shang khongs su yod pa yin/dre'u lhas dgon pa/15/la ba sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang dus mnyam byung ba'i

'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi grub thob 'brug pa kun legs kyi gdan sa yin lugs dang nang rten gyi gnas bshad bcas cung rgyas pa zhig 'khod pa'i dpyad khungs ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/ dre'u lhas dgon pa ni lhun rtse rdzong khongs gsum pa shang lhun rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs su spyi le drug tsam yod pa yin/gnyal gyi lung ra chen mo/rab byung bdun pa'i me byi spyi lo 1298lor gnyal smad kyi sa khongs su lung ra zhes par rje tsong kha pa chen pos chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba'i mdzad pa'i sa yul de la gnyal gyi lung ra chen mo zhes rje'i mdzad chen bzhi'i gras su drangs srol yod pa yin/ de ni da lta'i lho kha sa khul lhun rtse rdzong gnyal smad shang khongs lung ra zhes pa'i grong tsho zhig tu yod pa yin/te'u ra dgon pa/'di'i gdan sa dang po chag dgra bcom pa dang / gdan sa gnyis pa chag lo tsā ba chag chos rje dpal sogs byung zhing chag chos rje dpal ni sa paṇa gyi slob ma yin zhing rgya gar gyi gnas yig zhig bka' rtsom gnang / de la dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gdeng 'jog gang legs gnang ba'i lam yig de yin/te'u ra dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don lnga skor yod/ de ni lhun rtse rdzong zhing pa shang khongs lhun rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs spyi le gnyis tsam yod pa dang ta la ra mgo med pa'i dag cha 'di rang 'jags bzhag pa yin/151

'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi grub thob 'brug pa kun legs kyi gdan sa yin lugs dang nang rten gyi gnas bshad bcas cung rgyas pa zhig 'khod pa'i dpyad khungs ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/ dre'u lhas dgon pa ni lhun rtse rdzong khongs gsum pa shang lhun rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs su spyi le drug tsam yod pa yin/gnyal gyi lung ra chen mo/rab byung bdun pa'i me byi spyi lo 1298lor gnyal smad kyi sa khongs su lung ra zhes par rje tsong kha pa chen pos chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba'i mdzad pa'i sa yul de la gnyal gyi lung ra chen mo zhes rje'i mdzad chen bzhi'i gras su drangs srol yod pa yin/ de ni da lta'i lho kha sa khul lhun rtse rdzong gnyal smad shang khongs lung ra zhes pa'i grong tsho zhig tu yod pa yin/te'u ra dgon pa/'di'i gdan sa dang po chag dgra bcom pa dang / gdan sa gnyis pa chag lo tsā ba chag chos rje dpal sogs byung zhing chag chos rje dpal ni sa paṇa gyi slob ma yin zhing rgya gar gyi gnas yig zhig bka' rtsom gnang / de la dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gdeng 'jog gang legs gnang ba'i lam yig de yin/te'u ra dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don lnga skor yod/ de ni lhun rtse rdzong zhing pa shang khongs lhun rtse rdzong nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs spyi le gnyis tsam yod pa dang ta la ra mgo med pa'i dag cha 'di rang 'jags bzhag pa yin/151

ri stod dgon/rin chen tshul khrims kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi skor yod/ ri stod dgon ni lhun rtse rdzong gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/zangs po che dgon pa/rab byung gnyis pa'i nang tsam la dge bshes bsod nams 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab cing gdan rabs drug tsam song rjes dge lugs su bsgyur pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang drug cu skor yod/ zangs po chen ni dgon pa 'di la yul mi tshos zangs chen po zhig tshogs khyer phul bas zangs po cher grags/ dgon pa 'di ni lhun rtse rdzong gnyal smad shang khongs de sngon gyi lhun rtse rdzong rnying pa'i nye 'gram du yod pa yin/ /byar phu stag rtse grwa tshang /lha khang gsum la rten gsum 'ga' zhig bzhugs pa'i 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni lho kha sa khul lhun rtse rdzong byar gsang sngags chos gling gi nye phyogs tsam la 'khel ba'i gsang sngags chos gling shang gi sna/ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ sna )phyogs su yod/ (yig cha'i 'byung khungs sde dge ka thog si tu'i 152

gsal rje gangs kyi yar 'dren dgon pa/rje tsong kha pa chen po dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa'i me byi spyi lo 1298lor dbyar thog gcig dgon 'dir bzhugs pa dang ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'di nas mar gser phye pa'am gsal rje gangs lar pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub phug zhig mjal rgyu yod lugs 'khod pa'ang yod pa yin/de ni lho kha sa khul lhun rtse rdzong gnyal smad shang gser phye 'bum pa'i nye phyogs kyi gangs ri zhig la gsal rje gangs zhes bris pa mngon/ (yig cha'i 'byung khungs rje tsong kha pa chen mo'i rnam thar chen mo)bya yul pad+ma bkod/bya pa khri dpon bkra shes dar rgyas kyis btab sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe gsum skor yod/ bya yul ni lhun rtse rdzong bya yul shang gi sa yul 'dir 'khel ba dang / bya pa bkra shis dar rgyas ni deb therasngon po par shing bsko rgyu'i sbyin bdag mdzad myong bas lcags glang spyi lo 1489lor zhugs bzhin pa'i skabs yin/mkhar steng dgon/rong po rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor yod/ de ni lhun rtse rdzong gnyal smad shang gi nye phyogs tsam la 'khel ba yin/153

tsā' mcho dkar/lhunartse rdzong tsā ri chus kyi sa khongs mtsho dkar sogs kyi gnas 'di la phebs myong ba'i 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i slob ma gnyos mgar chos gsum gyis gnas sgo phye par grags pa'i dus rabs tshun tshod du kurma sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje/ bdun pa mthong ba don ldan/ brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang dge lugs phyogs kyi bla ma rje tsong kha pa chen po/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs zhabs kyis bcags myong pa'i gnas khyad par can zhig yin/ tsā ri gsar ma sku'i gnas/ tsā ri rnying ma gsungs gi gnas/ mtsho dkar thugs kyi gnas zhes bde mchog gi pho brang ngam gnas ri grags pa can zhig brtsi ba yin/byar gsang sngags chos gling /'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po dang mtshan dngos ni bya pa sprul sku ngag dbang nor bu'i gdan sa yin/ de ni lhun rtse rdzong gsang sngags chos gling shang khongs su yod pa yin/ ngag dbang nor bu ni me phag spyi lo 1527lor sku 'khrungs pa yin/154

phyo brag rdzong khul gyi dgon khagalho brag gsang sngags bde chen dgon/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu re bzhi skor yod de ni lho brag rdzong sras khang khongs su yod/lho brag dga' ldan gsang sngags bde chen/lcags sprel spyi lo 1680lor sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i dga' ldan gsang sngags bde chen la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ de ni lho brag rdzong sras shang gi sa yul du yod cing sras zhes pa de ni lho brag mar pa lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i sras mkhar dgu thog ces pa'i dwags po bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dang po brtsi 'os pa zhig yin/nyi ldi dgon/lho brag rdzong las khungs nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud thad ka spyi le nyi shu rtsa drug tsam yod pa'i nyi ldi grong tshor yod cing lo rgyus thog gi nyi ldi dgon ni tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus su byung zin pa'i dgon pa yin/155

btsan gro 'bur thog dgon/chos rje don grub dpal bas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ btsan gro 'bur thog dgon ni lho brag rdzong ban pa shang ban pa thig phyi'i nye skor zhig la btsan gro stod smad phyogs su rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos zhabs kyi bcags myong ba'i sa yul zhig yin/ chos rje don grub dpal ba ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma yin/la rgyab sgrub sde kun gsal chos gling /la rgyab ni de sngon lo rgyus thog bod ljongs dang lho 'brug dbar gyi mtha' mtshams dang nye ba zhig yin zhing rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'di phyogs kyi sa yul zhig tu phebs skabs bkag po zhes pa'i 'gag sgo'i las don sgrub mkhan dud tshang bcu skor zhig byung ba de ni la rgyab kyi skor 'khod pa cung snga shos gras zhig yin pa dang kun gsal chos gling ni dus phyis kyi sgrub sde zhig yin/ de ni ༵ /ga rdzong gi la rgyab shang zhes gzhi rim gyi srid 'dzin sgrig gzhi'i khongs su seng ge ri'i sgrub n+de/'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rgyal ba lo ras bas sku tshe'i mjug tu lho brag phyogs su byon/ rab byung bzhi pa'i sa bya spyi lo 1249lor seng ge rir bzhugs te chos gsungs de nas spyi lo 1250lor seng ge rir sku 'das pa yin/56seng ge ri ni lho brag lha khang shang khongs seng ge gzhung zhes pa'i sa yul

'di rang yin zhing hong ni lung pa'i gzhung gi sgra don 'dra ba ji yin ma shes/rgyal ba lo ras pa ni lho kha gong dkar rdzong gzhung gi grags chen nam sde ra zhes par sku 'khrungs shing (1187 1250)bar bzhugs/ /lho brag kho mthing /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang gras lho brag kho mthing ni de sngon lo rgyus thog lho brag lha khang gzhis dang / skabs 'gar lha khang rdzong zhes 'bri ba'i lha ni lha rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku zhig bzhugs par grags shing mthing ni lha khang gi nye 'gram zhig la mthing zhes grong tsho chung ngu zhig yod cing 'di nas tshos rgya mthing zhes nam mkha' mdog ltar sngo ba'i thon khungs zhig ni med dam snyam pa zhig byung / kho mthing lha khang ni lho brag rdzong lha khang shang gi sa yul du yod pa yin/ kho mthing ni bu ston chos 'byung gi dag cha'i 'bri srol la gzhi byas pa yin/phug ri/khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus su byung pa'i dge slong nam mkha'i snying po rgyun ring bzhugs myong ba'i lho brag rdzong gi phug ri ni brag ri g.yang gzar can gyi mtho tshad ni thog sa brgya lhag tsam yod lugs 'ol dga' rje drung gi rang rnam khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dug cing da lta'i lho brag rdzong shang gang gi sa khongs su yod med ma shes/chag byang chub gling /dus phyis gra phyi smin grol gling gi dgon lag gras lho brag rdzong lho bra/ /ra

chu'i nye rgyud du yod pa yin/lcags phur can/lho brag rdzong gi sa khongs su yod pa'i lcags phur can ni pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub phug yin par grags/ de ni 'ol dga' rje drung gi rnam thar nas btus/bgro ba dgon/khri srong lde btsan gyi chos blon shud bu dpal seng ge gdung brgyud shud bu mkhan chen zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab de nas gdan rabs bcu tsam song rjes lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan (1226da 1409)bgro ba dgon du bzhugs skabs lho brag mkhan chen dgung lo bdun cu dang rje tsong kha pa chen po dgung lo sum cu so drug bzhes pa'i spyi lo 1294tsam la rje tsong kha pa chen po bgro ba dgon du byon/ mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i mdun nas bka' gdams kyi chos skor 'ga' zhig gsan pa dang / de nas dga' ldan dgon pa'i sa yul 'tshol rgyu sogs mkhan chen pa'i bka' ltar dga' ldan dgon pa phyag btab pa dang mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i sku gdung bzhugs par grags pa'i lho brag 'bum pa zhes stag rtse rdzong gtsang thog shang ra sha khug ces pa'i grong tsho 'dir mchod rten ngo mtshar can zhig mjal rgyu yod pa yin/bgro ba dgon ni lho brag rdzong ban pa shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/khyung tshang dgon/15spyod bu mkhan chen zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo

1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don bzhi skor yod/ khyung tshang dgon ni lho brag rdzong ban pa shang gi ban pa thig phyi dgon pa'i nye 'gram tsam la 'khel ba yin/chag tu glo bo dgon/shud bu seng ge bzang pos phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so gsum skor yod/ glo bo dgon ni lho brag rdzong gi khongs su yod/dga' ldan bdud 'joms gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi spyi lo 1682lor gsar tu btsugs pa'i dga' ldan bdud 'joms gling la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ 'dud 'joms gling ni lho brag rdzong dge bcu shang gi mkhar chu dang nye ba zhig la yod pa yin/lho brag dga' ldan don gnyis gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1649lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya dang bcu gcig skor yod/ don gnyis gling ni da lta'i lho brag rdzong gi byang rgyab ri rtser gyang ro shul mal rgya che ba zhig mthong rgyu 'dug cing de sngon lo rgyus thog gi lho brag do bo rdzong yang yul 'dir byung ba yin/159

khra nor bu chos gling /me phag spyi lo 1647lor lho brag gsar du btsugs pa'i khra nor bu chos gling / khra ni khra pa nang so sogs pa'i khra ni lho brag seng ge rdzong gi rgyab ri'i ngos su mkhar rdzong rgya che pa'i shul mal mthong rgyu yod cing da lta lho brag rdzong sku shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/ (yig cha'i dpyad khungs lnga pa chen po'i rang rnam pod dang po)ban pa thig phyi'i gtsug lag khang /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i bla ma lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa dang sku gdung ril po sogs 'dir bzhugs pa yin/lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor ba ni (1226da 1401)bar du bzhugs (me stag nas lcags 'brug bar )ban pa thig phyi ni lho brag rdzong ban pa shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/160

gong po rgya mda' rdzong khul gyi dgon khag sang sing dgon/kong po rgya mda' rdzong gi nyang po sang sing dgon ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags pas phyag btab pa'i sang sing sgang ngam theg chen chos 'khor gling la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod pa dang de sngon chab mdo nas lha sa bar gyi lam tshugs che gras zhig 'khol ba yin/ri kha dgon/kong po rgya mda' rdzong spyi mda' shang khongs su yod pa'i ri kha dgon ni rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho yang gnas 'dir zhabs kyi bcags myong tshul rnam thar khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/ ri kha dgon pa'i sprul sku'i gras dung dkar tshangs dbyangs 'brug grags nas rtsis pa'i sku phreng brgyad pa bod kyi mkhas dbang chen po dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gzhis dgon yang yin/bkra shis chos lung /'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod/de ni kong po rgya mda' rdzong shar rlung shang khongs kong po nga phod gzhis ka dang cung nye bar yod pa yin zhing rgya mda' nas rtsis pa'i spyi le dgu tsam sdu /na

bod gzhung lam 'gram du 'khel gyin 'dugabrag dkar lha chu dgon/bod kyi lha btsan po chos rgyal ral pa can gyi sku dus su byung ba'i nyang ting 'dzin bzang pos phyag btab/ dus phyis do bong dgon pa'i dgon lag gras dga' ldan chos 'khor lha chu dgon la spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so drug skor yod/ brag dkar lha chu dgon ni kong po rgya mda' rdzong nyang po shang khongs gzhi rim sgrig gzhi'i las khungs bca' sdod byed yul gla ru nas rtsis pa'i nub byang ngos spyi le nyi shu rtsa dgu tsam gyi sar yod/ brag dkar lha chu'i dgon gong 'og sogs kyi gnas bshad sde dge ka thog si tu'i gnas yig la gzigs na mkhyen/phan bde dgon dang jo mojong gi sgar pa grwa tshang dbar gyi 'brel ba byung stangs/kong po rgya mda' rdzong rgya shing shang khongs su yod pa'i phan bde dgon ni kurma bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs yin zhing skabs 'gar srid phyogs nas dga' ldan pho brang la tshur rgol byas te dgon pa rtsa 'thor du song ba'i tshab mar jo mo rdzong gi sgar pa grwa tshang me rta spyi lo 1666lor gsar du bzhengs pa ṭā/ / sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad skor 162

'bras stod dge 'dun sgang /sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga gnyis skor yod/ de ni kong po rgya mda' rdzong gi rgya shing shang nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs spyi le bcu dgu tsam yod pa dang nyang chu'i stod rgyud la 'khel ba yin/'khru la dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po dang rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa gnyis ku'i slob ma zla ba bzang pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya brgyad cu gya bdun skor yod/ 'bru la dgon ni kong po rgya mda' rdzong 'bru la shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/dpung dkar dgon/kong po rgya mda'i rgya nang pa drung rgyal mchog pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu zhe drug skor yod/ da lta spungs dkar zhes 'bri ba'i spungs dkar dgon ni kong po rgya mda' rdzong 'bru la shang khongs 'bru la shang nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs spyi le sum cu so gcig tsam yod/gla ru dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma sems dpa' chen po 'phags pas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 1༷/na

zhal grangs dgu bcu go brgyad skor yod/ de sngon lo rgyus thog kham bod gzhung lam rgyud kyi nyang po gla ru zhes gzhung lam 'khel yang da lta khron bod gzhung lam dang rgyang thag nges can zhig yod pa yin zhing gla ru dgon ni kong po rgya mda' rdzong gla ru grong tshor yod pa yin/wa ru ṇa tshal/grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i slob ma zhig gis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ wa ru ṇa tshal la da lta sgra 'chol nas ba ri gla tshal zhes 'bod pa'i kong po rgya mda' rdzong spyi mda' shang khongs gla tshal grong tshor yod/164

nying khri rdzong khul gyi dgon khag bu chu lha khang /srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khung bzhi'i gras kong po bu chu lha khang ni nying khri rdzong bu chu shang gi sa yul du yod pa yin/ bu chu lha khang gi 'khor yug ni nags tshal 'khrigs pa'i mdzes ljongs byi/ ༵༵༵ 'phrog nus pa'i bsil ljongs kyi khyad chos yongs su tshang ba zhig 'khrug chos sde/kong po 'brug rgyal dbang sprul sku'i gdan sa 'brug chos sde ni nying khri rdzong bu chu shang khongs su yod cing dus phyis 'brug rgyal dbang sprul sku blo bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis shing sbrul spyi lo 1845lor gsar bsgrigs gnang pa'i 〈'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar 〉rgyas shos lcags par shog grags 64/nang yod pa'i mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang nas par bskrun gnang zin pa zhig yod pa dang rgyal dbang sprul sku 'di nyid ni 〈lcags stag zhib gzhung 〉gsar 'god gnang skabs su bka' blon bshad sgra ba don grub rdo rje'i las rogs gras su yod pa'i rgyal dbang sprul sku zhu ba de nyid yin pa dang nye dus rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i mtshan zhabs gras 'brug rgyal dbang sprul sku bcas dgon pa 'di nas byung ba yin/ bod ljongs sa ming dpe deb 'ga' zhig la 'brug chos sde la 'brug mchod rten zhes bris sdus sa

yul de rang yin zhing bu chu shang khongs 'brug chos sde grong tshor yod pa yin/mchod khang rtse dgon pa/'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi yab sangs rgyas bkra shis kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bco lnga skor yod/ de ni kong ༵ /nga khri rdzong grong brdal brgyad gcig khongs jo mo grong tsho'i nye 'dabs su grog khang steng /dga' chag chos mdzad kyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i dgon pa zhig dang sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ de ni kong po nying khri rdzong dga' chag grong tsho'i nye phyogs su yod/shu dag stag rtse dgon/dga' ldan byang rtse'i bla ma brtson 'grus bzang pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/de ni kong po nying khri rdzong stag rtse shang khongs su yod/bon ri dgon/deni kong po nying khri rdzong gi lho rgyud nye 'gram du yod pa'i kong po bon ri'i gnas chen gyi nye 'dabs su yod pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/166

jo mo rdzong sgar pa grwa tshang /me rta spyi lo 1666lor phan bde dgon pa rtsa 'thor du gyur pa'i tshab tu me rta lor jo mo rdzong sgar pa grwa tshang gsar tu bskrun zhing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad skor yod/ jo mo rdzong ni de sngon lo rgyus thog gong po sa khul gyi rdzong 'go'i gras yin pa'i da lta'i kong po nying khri rdzong grong brdal brgyad gcig khongs jo mo grong tshor yod/stag rtse rnam rgyal sgang dgon pa/zhwa dmar mkha' spyod pas rab byung drug pa'i sa stag spyi lo 1278lor phyag btab pa'i kurma bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa dang / me yos spyi lo 1287lor kurma sku phreng lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa stag rtser gdan 'dren zhus lugs mkhas pa'i dga' ston smad cha shog grangs 985par gsal/shā/ rtse ni kong po nying khri rdzong gi lho rgyud nye 'gram stag rtse shang khongs su yod pa 167

snang rdzong khul gyi dgon khag dgas lha sgam po'i dgon pa sogs bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa che gras 'ga' zhig gi sa phyogs gnas stangs skor/1 dwags po bka' brgyud (snang rdzong gi dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa)/2 tshal pa bka' brgyud (lha sa shar brgyud tshal gung thang dgon pa)/2 phag gru bka' brgyud (zangs ri rdzong gi gdan sa mthil dgon pa)/4 'bri gung bka' brgyud (mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs)/lung da/nasta 3) lung bka' brgyud (lhun grub rdzong stag lung shang khongs stag pa)/ 6 khro phu bka' brgyud (sa skya rdzong dge sdings shang khongs khro phu dgon 7 'brug pa bka' brgyud (chu shur rdzong gi gnam shang khongs kyi 'brug ra lung dgon pa bcas dgon khag gnyis yod)// smar pa bka' brgyud (go 'jo rdzong smar chu'i 'bab rgyud)/9 yel pa bka' brgyud (ri bo che'i lho rgyud tsam la 'khel)/10 g.ya' bza' bka' brgyud (sne gdong rdzong yar lha sham po'i chu'i 'bab rgyud g.ya' bzang shang khongs g.ya' bzang dgon pa)/11 shug gseb bka' brgyud (chu shur rdzong tshal ka nang shang khongs)/16rdo2 'bab rom bka' brgyud (lhun grub rdzong byang ra sgrong dgon pa'i

nye 'khor 'ba' rom mtsho dang nye bar 'khel ba yin) dwags lha sgam po/ mi'i ras pa'i slob ma dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen gyis rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags glang spyi lo 1121lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin pa dang / spyi lo 1129lo'i sa lug lor garma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa yang dwags lha sgam por phebs te dwags po lha rje'i drung du nas gdams pa 'ga' zhig gsan pa bcas lo khams snga ting gnyis tsam gsal ba yin/ dwags lha sgam po ni dgas pa snang rdzong rdzi lung shang khongs bang rim chos sde dang cung nye bar yod/ dwags lha sgam po'i gdan rabs bcu bdun tsam gyi ring la dbon rgyud kho nas bskyangs shing de nas kun mkhyen bkra shes rnam rgyal gyi sprul sku'i dus tsam nas chos rgyud rnying lugs su 'gyur tshul skor gyi dpyad khungs zhig 'dugasgrom mda' dga' ldan chos gling /sgrom mda' mkhan po mthu stobs dpal 'byor gyis phyag btab cing sa stagaspya lo 1698lor btsun ma drug cu skor yod/ sgom mda' ni dwags po snang rdzong sgrol mda' shang khongs su yod pa yin/dung dkar bragazhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa chos kyi grags pas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dwags po snang rdzong gi dung dkar shang gi sa yul du yod cing de nas lcags yos spyi lo 1651lor gsar du btsugs pa'i dung dkastu zlog
