dga' ldan rtse zhes dge lugs pa'i dgon pa 'di la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu don gcig skor yod/ zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa ni (spyi lo 1452da 1524)bar bzhugs zhwa dmar bzhi pas 'dam gzhungagi sa yul 'dir spyi lo 1502chu phag lor yangs pa can gyi dgon pa de'ang phyag btab pa yin no/ /mkhan thog dgon/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/mkhar thog dgon ni dwags po snang rdzong lha sdings zhol grong tsho dang nye bar yod/dga' ldan rab brtan dgon/(dwags po snang rtse rdzong sgrom mda' shang khongs ) sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/zur mchan/ thog ma'i dus skabs su bya pa khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas kyis sgrom mda' dgon pa zhes pa phyag btab cing de nas dge lugs su bsgyur ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dwags po'i sa'i char sku rab rnam rgyal zhes pa'i sa yul du yod pa la brten nas sku rab dga' ldan rab brtan zhes su grags/(dwags po snang rdzong sgrohā sa/zlo /go sna/sa dang sgrom mda' shang nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams su spyi le bco lnga yas mas la zhig yod pa yin/ )rje tsong kha pa rgyun ring tsam bzhugs myong ba'i gnas gzhi 'di ni srid pa'i lha chen 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs ri ni dung seng gnam du 'phyo ba 'dra ba'i nye 'ad1/sdu su yod pa yin stabs srid pa'i lha chen 'o de gung rgyal gyi ming zur

nas dras pa zhig yin/ de ni da lta'i snang rdzong sgom mda' shang khongs lha sdings zhol grong tsho dang ha cang nye bar yod pa yin/ dus phyis spyi lo 1698lor lha sdings dgon la dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/(yig cha'i dpyad khungs be+e ser dga' ldan chos 'byung dang dga' bzhi ba'i khyim tshang gi 'byung brjod gnyis las btus/)bang rim chos sde/dus phyis 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shes dpal ldan gyi sku dus su dge lugs su bsgyur pa'i dgon pa zhig dang sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod/ bang rim chos sde ni snang rdzong rdzi lung shang rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i 'khrungs gzhis lha gling grong tsho dang cung nye bar yod/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gyis me sprel spyi lo 1416lor chos sde chen po 'bras spungs dgon pa phyag btab pa yin/171

spo bo rdzong khul gyi dgon khagachu mdo dgon/yongs grags la spo bo chu mda' dgon pa zhes pa 'di ni 'phags pa lha sku phrengadang pos chu lug spyi lo 1462lor spo stod phu lung dgon nas chu mdor mar spos pa de yin zhing phu lung dgon ni 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i slob ma mgar dam pa chos sdings kyis lcags byi spyi lo 1240lor phyag btab pa'i 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun brgya skor yod/ de ni da lta'i spo bo rdzong chu mdo shang gi sa yul du yod/ ka gnam dgon rnying /'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di ni spo bo rdzong spra rmog nas rtsis pa'i nub byang mtshams spyi le bco lnga yas mas zhig yod cing ka gnam ni spo bo ka gnam sde pa'i srid dbang ni lo rgyus ches ring ba zhig byung ba'i sa gnas de gar rang yin/ ka gnam sde pa'i srid dbang rtsa med du song ba'i lo dus ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos spyi lo 1927lo'i dbyar // tsam la 'khel ba ni rdzong khag 'ga'i me stag dmag gzhung nas ra 'phrod pa 172

me gong byams pa gling /'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig da lta'i spo bo rdzong gi sa khongs spo bo rdzong spra rmog nas rtsis pa'i nub byang ngos spyi le brgya dang bcu med lnga tsam yod/ ye gong gi skor 'khod pa snga shos ni spyi lo 1240lor mgar dam pa chos sdings spo bo phu lung dgon pa'i sa yul 'dir phebs skabs ye gong gi sa phyogs zhig nas phebs lam 'khel ba dang nye dus la las sngar med gsar spros byas te ye gong yid 'ong zhes bris pa 'di ni rgyun srol dang mthun thabs med pa zhig yin ye gong gi skor 'khod pa mang shos ni mkhas pa'i dga' ston smad cha de yin/g.yu ri dgon bkra shis rab brtan gling /zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pas rab byung brgyad pa'i chu bya spyi lo 1452lor g.yu ri dgon bkra shis rab brtan gling phyag btab pa yin/g.yu ri dgon ni spo bo rdzong g.yu ri shang khongs g.yu ri pa'i sa yul du yod/'di ni 〈spo bo'i lo rgyus 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb las btus pa yin/shul mo dgon/kurma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rjes rab byung dgu pa'i me 'brug spyi lo 1556lor phyag btab pa'i kurma bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni spo bo rdzong shul mo shang khongs su yod pa'i spo stod kyi sa'i char gtogs pa yin/ (spo bo'i lo rgyus 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb las btus pa yin/173

mda' zhing dgon/spo bo rdzong spra rmog nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su yod pa'i mda' zhing dgon ni dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin pa dang lcags 'brug spyi lo 1760lor kun bde gling rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon po yang mda' zhing dgon pa'i nye 'dabs mal jo zhes pa'i grong tshor sku 'khrungs pa yin/ (yig cha'i 'byung khungs rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon po'i rnam thar)rma ku lung gi gnas ri/lo rgyus thog kurma pa sku phreng bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje dang rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob drung mkha' spyod pa snam mkha' rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis kyi rnam thar khongs su rma ku lung gi gnas sgo thog mar phye tshul 'khod pa'i rma ku lung ni spo bo rdzong gi byang ngos dpal 'bar rdzong gi lho rgyud thad kur 'khel pa'i bod ljongs sa bkra'i khongs su rma ku lung gi 'khyags rom zhes 'khod pa'i sa yul 'di yin zhing gnas bshad mdor bsdus zhig 〈gangs can rig mdzod 〉deb brgyad pa 'bri gung gi gdan rabs nyer gsum pa rig 'dzin chos grags nas bris pa zhig rig mdzod deb brgyad pa'i khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod pa yin/drung mkha' spyod pa snam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni chab mdo'i ngom chu'i rgyud du sa sgang rnam gling phyag 'debs pa po de yin/ / gsum 'dzoms dgon/kong po rgya mda'i khongs su byung ba'i 'bru la ba byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi t+ta~X sum cu skor yod/ gsum 'dzoms ni da lta'i spo bo rdzong gi gsum

'dzoms shang gi sa yul 'dir yod pa dang da lta khron bod gzhung lam gyi byang kha'i 'gram du yod pa yin/spo bo chos rdzong dgon/se ra dgon pa'i gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i slob ma chos grags pas phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ spo bo chos rdzong ni da lta'i spo bo rdzong rdo rje shang gi sa khongs su yod cing lo rgyus thog shing rta spyi lo 1824lor bod sa gnas nas gzhung skyong dang sbrag rdzong 'go gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i gras snga /kā rno sang ba yin no/ / (bka' shag gi yig tshags zhig la gzhi byas te bris 175

sman gling rdzong khul gyi dgon khagachab nag ri bo dga' ldan dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma kong po jo stan pa bstan pa dar rgyas kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya dang bdun cu skor yod/ chab nag dgon ni kong po smin gling rdzong chab nag shang khongs su yod/ cibakra shis rab brtan dgon/rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i slob ma rin chen rnam rgyal gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya bdun cu skor yod/ bkra shes rab brtan ni da lta'i kong po smin gling rdzong bkra shis rab brtan shang khongs bkra shis rab brtan sa yul du yod pa yin/de mo la kha dgon/'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab cing 'di'i gdan rabs dang po de mo sprul sku sku phreng dang po dkon mchog 'byung gnas nas nye dus kyi bod kyi srid skyong de mo sprul sku 'phrin las rab rgyas bar du dgon bdag bstan rgyas gling nas gnang ba yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya dang bdun cu skor yod/ de mo la kha dgon ni kong po nying khri rdong gi stag rtse shang nas rtsis pa'i lho rgyud nye skor de mo grong tshor yod pa ba//76/

rdza yul rdzong khul gyi dgon khaga'agu yul mthil pa dgon/gtsang pa sangs rgyas dpal 'byor gyis rdza yul lung pa'i stod phyogs kyi dgon rnying khag bzhi gcig tu bsgril te mthil pa dgon pa zhes pa phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ mthil pa dgon ni spyi lo 1620tsam la de mo lha dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sku dus nas spyi lo 1899bar de mo sprul sku na rim dang bstan rgyas gling bla brang nas zhor skyong gnang ba'i dgon lag cung che ba gras sheg yin/mthil pa dgon ni rdza yul 'gug chen shang khongs dang de sngon lo rgyus thog gi gsang sngags chos rdzong yang 'gu smad ces pa'i sa yul du yod pa yin/ gsang sngags chos rdzong la rdzong zhes rdzong gi ming tshab 'dra ba zhig chags 'dug cing de ni 'gu yul smad ces pa'i don yin/ —'gro ba dgon/rdza yul rdzong 'gro ba dgon shang khongs kyi 'gro ba dgon ni lo rgyus kyi khungs sne ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug cing sa yul thad rdza yul nas rgya gar dang 'bar ma'i phyogs 'gro lam 'khel ba'i lam tshugs gal che ba zhig 'khel gyin 'dug177

rdza yul rdzong khul gyi dgon khaga'agu yul mthil pa dgon/gtsang pa sangs rgyas dpal 'byor gyis rdza yul lung pa'i stod phyogs kyi dgon rnying khag bzhi gcig tu bsgril te mthil pa dgon pa zhes pa phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ mthil pa dgon ni spyi lo 1620tsam la de mo lha dbang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sku dus nas spyi lo 1899bar de mo sprul sku na rim dang bstan rgyas gling bla brang nas zhor skyong gnang ba'i dgon lag cung che ba gras sheg yin/mthil pa dgon ni rdza yul 'gug chen shang khongs dang de sngon lo rgyus thog gi gsang sngags chos rdzong yang 'gu smad ces pa'i sa yul du yod pa yin/ gsang sngags chos rdzong la rdzong zhes rdzong gi ming tshab 'dra ba zhig chags 'dug cing de ni 'gu yul smad ces pa'i don yin/ —'gro ba dgon/rdza yul rdzong 'gro ba dgon shang khongs kyi 'gro ba dgon ni lo rgyus kyi khungs sne ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug cing sa yul thad rdza yul nas rgya gar dang 'bar ma'i phyogs 'gro lam 'khel ba'i lam tshugs gal che ba zhig 'khel gyin 'dug177

kha ba dkar po'i gnas ri/kurma pa sku phreng dang po kurma dus gsum mkhyen pas gnas sgo thog mar phyes par grags pa'i kha ba dkar po ni bod ljongs rdza yul rdzong tsha ba rong shang gi shar rgyud dang yun nan zhing chen bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi bde chen rdzong gi nub rgyud du 'khel ba'i gangs ri'i rgyud 'di la rgyal yongs sa bkra'i khongs su mes li gangs ri zhes 'khod pa'i mel li ni tsha ba rong shang gi sman khungs pa'i sa yul der 'khel ba yin/178

nag chu rdzong khul gyi dgon khaganag chu zhabs brtan dgon/sgrub khang dge legs brgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi mas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1814lor phyag btab cing dus phyis spyi lo 1912lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya tham pa'i tshad gzhi yod lugs skor gyi yig lam mthong rgyu 'dug nag chu zhabs brtan dgon ni da lta'i nag chu rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod/ sgrub khang dge legs rgya mtsho ni (spyi lo 1641da 1712)tsam la sku 'das shing se ra dgon pa'i rgyab ri sgrub khang rtser rgyun ring bzhugs shing me khyi spyi lo 1706lor phur bu lcog gi ri khrod phyag btab gnang ba yin/ yo thog bar gling dgon/nag chu rdzong gi sa khongs nag chu rdzong nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams spyi le bcu gsum tsam yod cing spyi lo 1825gong tsam la phyag btab pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa yin/ lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig phur lcog yongs 'dzin byams pa tshul khrims kyi rnam thar khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/179

nag chu rdzong khul gyi dgon khaganag chu zhabs brtan dgon/sgrub khang dge legs brgya mtsho sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi mas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1814lor phyag btab cing dus phyis spyi lo 1912lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya tham pa'i tshad gzhi yod lugs skor gyi yig lam mthong rgyu 'dug nag chu zhabs brtan dgon ni da lta'i nag chu rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod/ sgrub khang dge legs rgya mtsho ni (spyi lo 1641da 1712)tsam la sku 'das shing se ra dgon pa'i rgyab ri sgrub khang rtser rgyun ring bzhugs shing me khyi spyi lo 1706lor phur bu lcog gi ri khrod phyag btab gnang ba yin/ yo thog bar gling dgon/nag chu rdzong gi sa khongs nag chu rdzong nas rtsis pa'i shar lho'i mtshams spyi le bcu gsum tsam yod cing spyi lo 1825gong tsam la phyag btab pa'i dge lugs pa'i dgon pa yin/ lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig phur lcog yongs 'dzin byams pa tshul khrims kyi rnam thar khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/179

'bri ru rdzong khul gyi dgon khagargya shod ban sgar dgon/gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i slob ma blo bzang nyi mas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/rgya shod ni de sngon lo rgyus thog 'bri ru rdzong gi sa yul lte gnas tsam la 'khel pa'i da lta'i nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong ban sgar shang gi sa yul 'dir ban sgar dgon yod pa de yin/ spus mda' dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs gnyis pa zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas phyag btab pa'i spus mda' dgon la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun skor yod/ dgon ming cha tshang ba ni nags shod spusasada' rnam rgyal dpal 'bar zhes pa'i dgon pa 'di ni nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong gi khongs su yod pa yin/shag rong dgon/ lcags sprul spyi lo 1641lor bla ma blo bzang 'phrin las kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ shag ni nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong shag chu shangagi sa khongs rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu bu'i stod rgyud shag chu zhes pa'i 'gram rgyud du 'khel ba yin/180

'bri ru rdzong khul gyi dgon khagargya shod ban sgar dgon/gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i slob ma blo bzang nyi mas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/rgya shod ni de sngon lo rgyus thog 'bri ru rdzong gi sa yul lte gnas tsam la 'khel pa'i da lta'i nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong ban sgar shang gi sa yul 'dir ban sgar dgon yod pa de yin/ spus mda' dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs gnyis pa zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas phyag btab pa'i spus mda' dgon la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun skor yod/ dgon ming cha tshang ba ni nags shod spusasada' rnam rgyal dpal 'bar zhes pa'i dgon pa 'di ni nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong gi khongs su yod pa yin/shag rong dgon/ lcags sprul spyi lo 1641lor bla ma blo bzang 'phrin las kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ shag ni nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong shag chu shangagi sa khongs rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu bu'i stod rgyud shag chu zhes pa'i 'gram rgyud du 'khel ba yin/180

rta smon chos 'khor dgon/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu skor yod cing / rta smon dang rta mang dgon pa yang grags pa'i dgon pa 'di ni nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong zla thang shang khongs su yod pa dang de sngon kun bde gling gi dgon lag gras che ba zhig yin/ gsa' mda' bon dgon/'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sku dus su dgon pa 'di la dge lugs dang bon po'i chos lugs pa gnyis khag bgos te tshogs 'tshogs rgyun zhig byung ba dang dus phyis gsa' mda' bon dgon la bon po'i chos lugs pa bzhi bcu zhe lnga dang dgon pa'i mi ser them dud drug cu skor yod lugs rgya'i don gcod pa lhong mu su gi nyin tho'i khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dug gsa' mda' bon dgon ni 'bri ru rdzong ban sgar shang gi lho nub nye phyogs la 'khel ba'i de sngon lo rgyus thog chab mdo nas lha sa bar gyi byang lam gyi lam tshugs 'khel ba yin/181

lha ri 'go rdzong khul gyi dgon khagabyang lha ri 'go bde chen gling /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma stag phu gu shri dpal ldan don grub kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bcu skor yod/ stag phu gu shri dpal ldan don grub ni (spyi lo 1282—1466)bar du bzhugs shing dus phyis 'di'i sku skye rnams nag chu sa khul 'bri ru rdzong rgya shod ban sgar du byung ba yin zhing stag phu ma dgon ni lha sa shar rgyud mal gro gung dkar rdzong gi khongs su yod pa yin/ byang lha ri ni da lta'i rgya'i yig lam 'ga' zhig la tsā li zhes bris pa 'di ni lha ri'i sgra zur 'jags pa zhig yin pa dang lha ri 'go dgon ni nag chu sa khul lha ri rdzong rnying pa'i nye 'gram ri 'bur zhig gi steng du yod cing sngon chab mdo nas lha sa bar gyi lam tshugs gal che ba zhig 'khel ba yin/a tsa dgon/(lha ri 'go rdzong khongs )dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang chags zin pa'i a tsa dgon ni lnga pa chen po'i rnam thar khongs su gsal ba dang dus phyis spyi lo 1924lor rgya'i don gcod mi sna hong mu sung gi nyin tho'i khongs su a tsa dgon pa la dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor dang a tsa dgon pa nas ko leb zhes pa'i babs tshugs bar spyi le sum cu'i rgyang thag yod lugs 'khod pa zhig 'dug182

sog rdzong khul gyi dgon khag sog dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sprel spyi lo 165〈lor phyag btab pa'i dge lugs kyi dgon pa la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ sog dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling ni de sngon gyi sog tsan dan dgon pa'i shul mal sog rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod pa yin/gung ru tsan dan ri khrod/'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab pa'i ri khrod zhig yin/ gung ru ni lho rong rdzong sho pa mdo sog rdzong bcas yul spyi'i ming yin/ dper na sog rdzong gi tsan dan chu rgyud kyi tsan dan dgon pa dang tsan dan ri khrod sho pa mdo shang gi sa khongs dang nye ba'i gung ru chos sde pu ste dgon lho rong rdzong gi rdzi ṭ+wāṃ /nga nye ba'i gung ru dmag sgar bcas gung ru'i sa ming 'ga' zhig yod pa khri rdo dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs gnyis pa zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ khri rdo dgon ni sog rdzong khri rdo shang khongs khri rdo zhes pa'i sa yul du yod cing de sngon 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi 1hā/na

sog rdzong khul gyi dgon khag sog dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sprel spyi lo 165〈lor phyag btab pa'i dge lugs kyi dgon pa la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ sog dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling ni de sngon gyi sog tsan dan dgon pa'i shul mal sog rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod pa yin/gung ru tsan dan ri khrod/'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab pa'i ri khrod zhig yin/ gung ru ni lho rong rdzong sho pa mdo sog rdzong bcas yul spyi'i ming yin/ dper na sog rdzong gi tsan dan chu rgyud kyi tsan dan dgon pa dang tsan dan ri khrod sho pa mdo shang gi sa khongs dang nye ba'i gung ru chos sde pu ste dgon lho rong rdzong gi rdzi ṭ+wāṃ /nga nye ba'i gung ru dmag sgar bcas gung ru'i sa ming 'ga' zhig yod pa khri rdo dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs gnyis pa zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ khri rdo dgon ni sog rdzong khri rdo shang khongs khri rdo zhes pa'i sa yul du yod cing de sngon 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi 1hā/na

lag gras su yod pa yin/lcam mda' dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma mkhan chen bkra shes rgya mtshos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya nyi shu skor yod/ de sngon lo rgyus thog rgyal ston rdzong gi sa khongs tsam ༵ /khel zhing da lta nag chu sa khul sog rdzong lcam mda' shang khongs su yod pa sog tsan dan dgon/rab byung brgyad pa'i chu rta spyi lo 1462lor kurma sku phreng bdun pa chos grags rgya mtshos khams phyogs su rgyun ring bzhugs skabs phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di ni spyi lo (1462da 1642lor )dge lugs kyi dgon pa sog dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling yang tsan dan dgon pa'i shul mas du phyag btab pa yin/ sog tsan dan dgon ni nag chu sa khul sog rdzong gi tsan dan zhol zhes pa'i da lta'i sog rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod pa yin/(yig cha'i dpyad khungs ni mkhas pa'i dga' ston smad cha shog grangs 1152nas btus pa yin)re shod dga' ldan rab brtan dgon/sa sprel spyi lo 1658lor gsar du btsugs pa'i dga' ldan rab brtan dgon la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/re shod ni sog rdzong gi re chu'i 'bab rgyud kyi shod du 'khel ba yin/184

dkar shod dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sprel spyi lo 1658lor gsar du tshugs pa'i dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor yod/ dgon pa de ni nag chu sa khul sog rdzong gcung chos 'khor dgon zhes pa de yin/ gong du gsal ba'i dkar shod ni de sngon lo rgyus thog re dkar sog gsum re shod dang gcig dkar shod dang gnyis/sog chu'i rgyud kyi sog gsum gyi bsdus ming yin zhing dmangs khrod du ra dkar sog gsum zhes ra la 'greng bu med pa zhig klog kyin 'dug de gsum ka da lta sog rdzong gi sa khongs su yod/rong po rab brtan dgon/sog rdzong gi dga' ldan rnam gsum gras rong po rab brtan dgon ni dge lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 〉sdon zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ de ni sog rdzong rong po shang khongs su 185

chab mdo rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagarma dgon/kurma sku phreng dang po kurma dus gsum mkhyen pas rab byung gsum pa'i shing sbrul spyi lo 1185lor phyag btab pa nas kurma bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung ba'i 'go tshugs pa yin/ de nas lo lnga song rjes stod lung mtshur phu dgon pa ni sa bya spyi lo 1189lor phyag btab pa nas mtshur phu kurma pa zhes bka' lugs kyi gnas gzhi'i sa gnas gcig la brtan chags byung ba yin/ kurma dgon ni de sngon lo rgyus thog ri bo che dgon pa nas zhor skyong rgyun ring mdzad cing da lta chab mdo rdzong nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos spyi le brgyad cu tsam yod pa'i chab mdo rdzong gi kurma shang gi sa yul 'dir yod cing nang rten ji yod kyi gnas yig kha gsal shos dang rgyas shos byung ba ka thog si tu'i gnas yig 'di yin/ kurma sku phreng dang po ni (spyi lo 110da 1192)rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags rta gerab byung gsum pa'i chu glang bar dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi bzhugs/ /chab mdo byams pa gling /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob smad shes rab bzang pos rab byung bdun pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1444lor phyag btab pa'i chab mdo'i rdza chu dang ngom chu gnyis kyi 'dres mtshams su 'khel ba dang nang rten byams pa'i sku zhig rten1 spyazlor bzhugs pa bcas kyi rgyu mtshan la brten chab mdo byams pa gling

chab mdo rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagarma dgon/kurma sku phreng dang po kurma dus gsum mkhyen pas rab byung gsum pa'i shing sbrul spyi lo 1185lor phyag btab pa nas kurma bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs byung ba'i 'go tshugs pa yin/ de nas lo lnga song rjes stod lung mtshur phu dgon pa ni sa bya spyi lo 1189lor phyag btab pa nas mtshur phu kurma pa zhes bka' lugs kyi gnas gzhi'i sa gnas gcig la brtan chags byung ba yin/ kurma dgon ni de sngon lo rgyus thog ri bo che dgon pa nas zhor skyong rgyun ring mdzad cing da lta chab mdo rdzong nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos spyi le brgyad cu tsam yod pa'i chab mdo rdzong gi kurma shang gi sa yul 'dir yod cing nang rten ji yod kyi gnas yig kha gsal shos dang rgyas shos byung ba ka thog si tu'i gnas yig 'di yin/ kurma sku phreng dang po ni (spyi lo 110da 1192)rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags rta gerab byung gsum pa'i chu glang bar dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi bzhugs/ /chab mdo byams pa gling /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob smad shes rab bzang pos rab byung bdun pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1444lor phyag btab pa'i chab mdo'i rdza chu dang ngom chu gnyis kyi 'dres mtshams su 'khel ba dang nang rten byams pa'i sku zhig rten1 spyazlor bzhugs pa bcas kyi rgyu mtshan la brten chab mdo byams pa gling

zhes grags/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs chig stong nyis brgya skor yod/ smad shes rab bzang po ni (spyi lo 1295 1457)shing phag nas me glang bar bzhugs shing 'khrungs yul ri bo che'i garma dgon dang nye bar bon po'i khyim rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer gsum bzhes pa'i me bya spyi lo 1417lor dbus gtsang gi ljongs su byon te rje tsong kha pa chen po dang / rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ mkhas grub chos rje bcas rje yab sras gsum ma'i mdun nas chos mang du gsan pas slob mar gyur/dgung lo so gnyis bzhes pa'i me rta spyi lo 1426lor slar yang khams phyogs su phyir phebs te chab mdo sa khul gyi yul gru mang por zhabs kyi bcags shing dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1444lor chab mdo byams pa gling gi 'dus sde dang bcas pa phyag btab cing shing byi nas me sprul bar gdan sa'i 'chad nyan gyi 'khur bzhes te dge 'dun stong phrag tsam 'dus te bka' pod bzhi'i 'chad nyan byed pa'i grwa tshang gras/ 1 yar gling pa/ 2 mar gling pa/ 2 nub gling pa/ 4 lcags ra kha pa/ 5 khu byug pa bcas mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang lnga dang de nas rim bzhin gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor/ kyai rdor/ kun rig sogs gsang sngags kyi sgrub mchod tshugs pa'i sgrub khag brgyad du grags pa byung ba yin zhing dus phyis lcags rta spyi lo 1920lor chab mdo byams pa gling du mtshan nyid grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs yang gnang ba yin/ chab mdo dgon pa'i gdan rabs bcu gsum pa 'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa mthong ba don ldan ni rab byung bcu pa'i shing rta spyi lo 1594lor chab mdo dgon pa'i khrir phebs pa nas bzung sku phreng bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ dgu pa/bcu pa/ sku phreng bcu gcig pa 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal bar du chab mdo'i dgon bdag 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim byon nas gnang ༵ byin/

dus phyis spyi lo 1940tsam la mjug 'gril nyer byung ba'i chab mdo'i par gzhi'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig ni 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa'i yab gzhis shādri ṭ+wāṃ // sbyar te par du bsgrub pa de ni rig gsar skabs 'thor gyar du mdzo rdzi dgon/sde dge si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub phur dang bka' 'gyur cha gnyis sogs nang rten 'ga' zhig yod lugs skor ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa de las de min gyi dpyad khungs ci yang ma rnyed/ si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis sde dge dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor spyi lo 1729me lug lor phyag btab pa dang spo bo rdzong gi sa khongs su si tu paṇa chen nas zhor skyong gnang ba'i shul mo dgon dang phu lung dgon sogs yod pa bcas pa sde dge sa khongs/ chab mdo sa khul/ spo bo sa khul bcas khyab khungs nges can zhig yod pa mtshon pa yin/ mdzo rdzing dgon ni chab mdo rdzong khongs tho pa shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud nye 'gram du yod/gla rong mtshan nyid grwa tshang /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma dkon mchog seng gis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang sngags pa grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor yod/ de ni chab mdo rdzong lcags kha shang nye skor la yod cing dus phyis kyi 'byung rabs 'khod pa ci yang mi 'dug188

dus phyis spyi lo 1940tsam la mjug 'gril nyer byung ba'i chab mdo'i par gzhi'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig ni 'phags pa lha sku phreng bcu pa'i yab gzhis shādri ṭ+wāṃ // sbyar te par du bsgrub pa de ni rig gsar skabs 'thor gyar du mdzo rdzi dgon/sde dge si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub phur dang bka' 'gyur cha gnyis sogs nang rten 'ga' zhig yod lugs skor ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa de las de min gyi dpyad khungs ci yang ma rnyed/ si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis sde dge dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor spyi lo 1729me lug lor phyag btab pa dang spo bo rdzong gi sa khongs su si tu paṇa chen nas zhor skyong gnang ba'i shul mo dgon dang phu lung dgon sogs yod pa bcas pa sde dge sa khongs/ chab mdo sa khul/ spo bo sa khul bcas khyab khungs nges can zhig yod pa mtshon pa yin/ mdzo rdzing dgon ni chab mdo rdzong khongs tho pa shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud nye 'gram du yod/gla rong mtshan nyid grwa tshang /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma dkon mchog seng gis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang sngags pa grwa tshang la dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor yod/ de ni chab mdo rdzong lcags kha shang nye skor la yod cing dus phyis kyi 'byung rabs 'khod pa ci yang mi 'dug188

gnas mdo dgon/rnying ma'i bla ma chags med sku phreng lnga pas phyag btab pa'i rnying lugasakyi dgon pa zhig yin/ rten gsum ji yod ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yin/ ka thog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho ni (spyi lo 1〈rdoXd 1925)bar bzhugs shing spyi lo 191〈da 1921bar dbus gtsang khul gyi yul gru phal mo cher phebs shing gnas yig shin tu rgyas pa zhig gsar bsgrigs gnang ba yod/ gnas mdo dgon ni chab mdo rdzong ngom chu'i rgyud kyi sa sgang shang dang nye bar yod pa yin/la sgang dgon/yun nan sa khul gyi ljang sa tham rgyal pos sbyin bdag zhus te 'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ la sgang ni ri bo che rdzong brngas mda' shang khongs la gong brngas mda' dang / la smad sogs de sngon khams bod gzhung lam dngos gzhi 'khel ba'i sa yul zhig yin/ro khro phu dgon/chab mdo byams gling gi gdan rabs bcu pa rje drung shes rab dbang po'i slob ma rgya ra shes rab phun tshogs kyis phyag btab cing chab mdo rdzong rdza chu'i nye rgyud rob ces pa'i sa yul du yod/189

rdzong glo dgon/spyi lo 1619da 1627bar pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi sbyin bdag mtsho skyes kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod dang de ni chab mdo dang ri bo che'i bar mtshams kyi gnam mtsho la nye rgyud du yod pa yin/rje drung shes rab dbang pos :bkā / r+sha/ po steng chen sa khongs lha shod du 'khrungs pa'i rgya ra shes rab phun tshogs kyis dgung lo lnga bcu nga bdun bzhes pa'i chu khyi spyi lo 1622tsam la phyag btab cing de nas chab mdo rgya ra sprul sku rim byon gyis bskyangs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ yig cha'i 'byung khungs klong rdol bla ma'i gsung 'bum nas bton pa yin/ gru gu dgon ni chab mdo rdzong gi 'gu ru shang gi rgya gling nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs nyin lam phyed tsam yod/khams pa dgon/khams pa sprul sku sku phreng bzhi pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i gdan sa khams pa dgon zhes pa de la dus phyis dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor dang khams sprul sku phreng bzhi pas gsar bsgrigs mdzad pa'i khams sprul gyi snyan ngag 'grel chen shin tu rgyas pa zhig par bskrun gnang zin 'dugakhams pa dgon gyi nang rten ji yod ka thog si tu'i gnas yig la gzigs rgyu/༵/sa pa dgon ni chab mdo rdzong tho pa shang nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos nye bar 190

rdzong glo dgon/spyi lo 1619da 1627bar pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi sbyin bdag mtsho skyes kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod dang de ni chab mdo dang ri bo che'i bar mtshams kyi gnam mtsho la nye rgyud du yod pa yin/rje drung shes rab dbang pos :bkā / r+sha/ po steng chen sa khongs lha shod du 'khrungs pa'i rgya ra shes rab phun tshogs kyis dgung lo lnga bcu nga bdun bzhes pa'i chu khyi spyi lo 1622tsam la phyag btab cing de nas chab mdo rgya ra sprul sku rim byon gyis bskyangs pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ yig cha'i 'byung khungs klong rdol bla ma'i gsung 'bum nas bton pa yin/ gru gu dgon ni chab mdo rdzong gi 'gu ru shang gi rgya gling nas rtsis pa'i lho nub phyogs nyin lam phyed tsam yod/khams pa dgon/khams pa sprul sku sku phreng bzhi pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i gdan sa khams pa dgon zhes pa de la dus phyis dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor dang khams sprul sku phreng bzhi pas gsar bsgrigs mdzad pa'i khams sprul gyi snyan ngag 'grel chen shin tu rgyas pa zhig par bskrun gnang zin 'dugakhams pa dgon gyi nang rten ji yod ka thog si tu'i gnas yig la gzigs rgyu/༵/sa pa dgon ni chab mdo rdzong tho pa shang nas rtsis pa'i byang ngos nye bar 190

gying thang dgon/khams pa dgon gyi dgon lag gras gying thang dgon ni chab mdo rdzong tho pa shang khongs dang nang rten bka' 'gyur dang zhal thang lnga bcu skor yod lugs ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod/sa sgang dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma drung mkha' spyod nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung bdun pa'i shing sprel spyi lo 1404lor phyag btab cing 'di phyogs su nam rgyun yongs grags la ngom sa sgang dgon zhes ngom chu'i rgyud du 'khel ba yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod/ mkha' spyod nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni (spyi lo 1270da 1422)lcags khyi nas sa glang bar bzhugs shing 'di nyid sa sgang rnam rgyal gling zhes pa'i dgon pa phyag btab pa dang zi khron zhing chen glang chen 'gyings ri'i dgon (o mi hran )du rgyun ring tsam bzhugs pa dang de nas spo bo ye gong nye rgyud kyi rma ku lung gi gnas sgo yang gsar du phyes lugs rnam thar bris ma dpe rgyun dkon pa zhig yod pa yin/ sa sgang dgon ni chab mdo rdzong sa sgang shang khongs chab mdo byams pa gling nas rtsis pa'i nub byang gi phyogs mtshams spyi le sum cu so brgyad tsam yod/rmo mda' dgon/me glang spyi lo 1627tsam la be ri don yod kyis gtor bshig btang rjes dbon drung zhi ba bzang pos rmo mdar spos pa'i dgon pa de yin zhing /dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi ༵ spyar

yod/ zhi ba bzang po ni chab mdo byams pa gling gi sprul sku che gras zhi ba lha/zhi ba bzang po/ zhi bzang sprul sku bcas mtshan zur cung mi 'dra ba gsum tsam yod pa dang / rmo mda' dgon ni chab mdo rdzong rmo mda' shang khongs su yod pa dang rmo mda' ni chab mdo rdzong nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs spyi le lnga bcu tsam yod pa yin/ tho gru gu bragarnying ma'i gter gnas gras su rtsis pa'i tho gru gu lha brag ni lo rgyus thog khams bod gzhung lam thog 'khel ba'i gru gu dgon pa'i nye rgyud du yod cing da lta'i chab mdo rdzong tho pa shang khongs su yod pa yin/ (ka thog si tu'i gnas yig nas btus pa yin)pad+ma khyung rdzong /yul ljongs kyi gnas stangs ni rong spang ljongs dang nags tshal du mas khor yug mdzes pa zhig dang pad+ma khyung rdzong ni rnying ma'i gter gnas gras su brtsi ba yin lugs skor ka thog si cu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod gter gnas 'di ni chab mdo rdzong tho pa shang khongs su yod pa yin/192

yod/ zhi ba bzang po ni chab mdo byams pa gling gi sprul sku che gras zhi ba lha/zhi ba bzang po/ zhi bzang sprul sku bcas mtshan zur cung mi 'dra ba gsum tsam yod pa dang / rmo mda' dgon ni chab mdo rdzong rmo mda' shang khongs su yod pa dang rmo mda' ni chab mdo rdzong nas rtsis pa'i nub byang phyogs spyi le lnga bcu tsam yod pa yin/ tho gru gu bragarnying ma'i gter gnas gras su rtsis pa'i tho gru gu lha brag ni lo rgyus thog khams bod gzhung lam thog 'khel ba'i gru gu dgon pa'i nye rgyud du yod cing da lta'i chab mdo rdzong tho pa shang khongs su yod pa yin/ (ka thog si tu'i gnas yig nas btus pa yin)pad+ma khyung rdzong /yul ljongs kyi gnas stangs ni rong spang ljongs dang nags tshal du mas khor yug mdzes pa zhig dang pad+ma khyung rdzong ni rnying ma'i gter gnas gras su brtsi ba yin lugs skor ka thog si cu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod gter gnas 'di ni chab mdo rdzong tho pa shang khongs su yod pa yin/192

go 'jo rdzong khul gyi dgon khagago 'jo 'gro 'dren dgon/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me byi spyi lo 1696lor gsar du btsugs pa'i dge lugs kyi dgon pa dga' ldan gsang sngags 'gro 'dren gling ni chab mdo sa khul go 'jo rdzong lha rgya shang khongs su yod/kun mkhyen dgon/go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge'i 'khrungs yul go 'jo rdzong gi dgon pa zhig yin/ go ram pa bsod nams seng ge ni (spyi lo 1429da 1489)bar bzhugs shing 'di nyid kyis gzhis rtse sa khul rta nag thub brtan rnam rgyal gyi dgon pa yang 1472lor phyag btab pa yin zhing kun mkhyen dgon pa'i skor dpyad khungs nyung bsdus zhig ni dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom phyogs sgrigs zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas bton pa'i shog grangs 19pa nas btus pa yin /193

'jo mda' rdzong khul gyi dgon khagaldan chos 'khor dgon/dga' ldan khri thog bzhi pa zhwa lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma nyag re rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab pa'i ldan chos 'khor dgon la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga brgya skor yod/ ldan chos 'khor dgon ni chab mdo sa khul 'jo mda' rdzong da lta'i chos 'khor shang zhes pa'i yul du yod cing 'bri chu'i nub 'gram du chos 'khor dgon dang / 'bri chu'i shar 'gram du ldan klong thang sgrol ma lha khang yod pa yin zhing 'di phyogs kyi yul skad ltar na 'dan ma dang se ra dgon pa'i 'dan ma khams tshan sogs 'dan zhes 'bod pa las ldan ma khams tshan zhes klog stangs cung mi 'dra ba 'dug dgon pa 'di ni chu rta spyi lo 1582lor rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos chos 'khor dgon rgyud yul shul sa khongs nya mtsho dgon sogs phebs lam 'khel ba dang / dus phyis chab mdo dgon nas mkhan po 'dan ma bla gnyer zhes pa zhig bsko bzhag byed kyin 'dugakhro ru dgon/khro bu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gis rab byung bzhi pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1212lor khro bo byams chen gyi gser sku bzhengs grub rjes tsam la khams phyogs ri bo che sogs su phebs te chos gsungs pas slob ma du ma 'dus/ de skadisdu sna da lta'i 'jo mda' rdzong gi gter ston shang ni sa khongs su yod pa'i

'jo mda' rdzong khul gyi dgon khagaldan chos 'khor dgon/dga' ldan khri thog bzhi pa zhwa lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma nyag re rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab pa'i ldan chos 'khor dgon la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga brgya skor yod/ ldan chos 'khor dgon ni chab mdo sa khul 'jo mda' rdzong da lta'i chos 'khor shang zhes pa'i yul du yod cing 'bri chu'i nub 'gram du chos 'khor dgon dang / 'bri chu'i shar 'gram du ldan klong thang sgrol ma lha khang yod pa yin zhing 'di phyogs kyi yul skad ltar na 'dan ma dang se ra dgon pa'i 'dan ma khams tshan sogs 'dan zhes 'bod pa las ldan ma khams tshan zhes klog stangs cung mi 'dra ba 'dug dgon pa 'di ni chu rta spyi lo 1582lor rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos chos 'khor dgon rgyud yul shul sa khongs nya mtsho dgon sogs phebs lam 'khel ba dang / dus phyis chab mdo dgon nas mkhan po 'dan ma bla gnyer zhes pa zhig bsko bzhag byed kyin 'dugakhro ru dgon/khro bu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gis rab byung bzhi pa'i chu sprel spyi lo 1212lor khro bo byams chen gyi gser sku bzhengs grub rjes tsam la khams phyogs ri bo che sogs su phebs te chos gsungs pas slob ma du ma 'dus/ de skadisdu sna da lta'i 'jo mda' rdzong gi gter ston shang ni sa khongs su yod pa'i

khro ru dgon theg chen dar rgyas gling yang phyag 'debs rgyu'i dgongs gzhi byung ba ltar zhal bkod gnang ste phyag btab pa yin/ (yig cha'i dpyad khungs 〈gangs ljongs lo rgyus thog gi grags can mi sna 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb shog grangs 275nas cung zad btus te bris pa yin)srib dgon gsang chen bkra shis gling /rab byung bzhi pa'i shing glang spyi lo 1265lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa 'di phyogs su phebs skabs nyams gso gnang ba'i dgon pa zhig yin/ de ni chab mdo sa khul 'jo mda' rdzong srib mda' shang gi sa yul du yod cing 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa ni ldan khog nye rgyud zhig nas bod du phebs lam 'khel ba mtshon nus ba yin/ (yig cha'i 'byung khungs 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug 〉sbyi lo 1989lo'i dus deb gnyis par 'khod pa ltar nyung bsdus zhig bris pa yin)gter ston dgon/rnying ma'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa dang da lta dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/ de ni chab mdo sa khul khra bo thang shang khongs su yod/spom brag dgon/'jo mda' rdzong gi dbon stod shang nas rtsis pa'i nub byang ngos spyi le bcu tsam spom brag ni kurma sku phreng gnyis pa kurma pak+ṣi 'bri chu'i nye 'gram zhig la sku 'khrungs shing de nas ka thog byams pa bas mkhan po dang / spom brag pas slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes lugasdu /ra

'khod pa'i spom brag gi sa ming de la dpyad khungs gang legs zhig byung ba yin/wa ra dgon/bod ljongs shar mthar 'khel ba'i 'bri chu'i nub 'gram gyi wa ra dgon ni khor yug thams cad shing nags dang dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ dgon pa rgya khyon che ba zhig yod pa yin/ de sngon lo rgyus thog der 'grul lam 'khel ba dang da lta'i khron bod gzhung lam 'gram du yod pa'i wa ra dgon ni 'jo mda' rdzong gdong phu shang khongs dang hong mu sung gi nyin tho'i nang dgon pa rgya che ba 'dug ces bris 'dug /sa dkar dgon/ldan khog sa khul du yod pa'i sa skya'i dgon lag che gras zhig yin/ sa dkar dgon ni chab mdo sa khul 'jo mda' rdzong sa dkar shang gi sa yul du yod pa dang ldan khog nub rgyud la 'khel ba yin/ 〈sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen bang mdzod 〉kyi kha skong nas drangs pa yin/gser ljongs dgon/chab mdo sa khul 'jo mda' rdzong srib mda' shang gi lho rgyud du yod pa'i ku si gser ljongs dgon ni spyi lo 1854lor dgon ming tsam gyi dpyad khungs zhig ni 〈bsam yas dkar chag 〉gi khongs su 'khod pa dang dus phyis kyi ka thog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho yang ka thog dgon nas bod du phebs skabs gser ljongs dgon du phebs lam 'khel ba'i dgon pa de yin/196

mkhar mdo dgon/sde dge 'jo mda' rdzong mkhar mdo shang gi sa yul du byung ba'i dgon pa 'di ni shing rta spyi lo 1854lor byung zin pas 〈bsam yas dkar chag 〉gi khongs su dgon ming tsam gyi dpyad khungs zhig ni yod pa yin/zal dkar dgon/zal dkar dgon gyi ma lag gsum la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor yod/ zal dkar dgon ni sde dge 'jo mda' rdzong gi zal dkar shang gi sa yul 'di sa skya'i dgon lag che gras ldan sa dkar dgon zer ba de rang yin pa mngon gyin 'dugaskyabs rje dgon/'jo mda' rdzong gter ston shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud spyi le nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam la yod pa'i skyabs rje dgon ni spyi lo 1854lor byung zin pa'i dgon pa zhig dang bsam yas dkar chag khongs su 'khod yod/ dus phyis bka' blon nga phod dang / mda' dpon khe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus gnyis chu sprel spyi lo 1922lo'i bod zla lnga pa'i nang thug 'phrad byung ba'i dgon pa de yin/khro gling gnyis/bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa khro gling gnyis sogs bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhung bzhi dang ya brgyad du grags pa'i nang gses khro gling gnyis ni chab mdo sa khul 'jo mda' rdzong gi khro ru dgon dang / 'bri chu shar kha'i sde da~X snying

mkhar mdo dgon/sde dge 'jo mda' rdzong mkhar mdo shang gi sa yul du byung ba'i dgon pa 'di ni shing rta spyi lo 1854lor byung zin pas 〈bsam yas dkar chag 〉gi khongs su dgon ming tsam gyi dpyad khungs zhig ni yod pa yin/zal dkar dgon/zal dkar dgon gyi ma lag gsum la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor yod/ zal dkar dgon ni sde dge 'jo mda' rdzong gi zal dkar shang gi sa yul 'di sa skya'i dgon lag che gras ldan sa dkar dgon zer ba de rang yin pa mngon gyin 'dugaskyabs rje dgon/'jo mda' rdzong gter ston shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud spyi le nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam la yod pa'i skyabs rje dgon ni spyi lo 1854lor byung zin pa'i dgon pa zhig dang bsam yas dkar chag khongs su 'khod yod/ dus phyis bka' blon nga phod dang / mda' dpon khe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus gnyis chu sprel spyi lo 1922lo'i bod zla lnga pa'i nang thug 'phrad byung ba'i dgon pa de yin/khro gling gnyis/bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa khro gling gnyis sogs bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhung bzhi dang ya brgyad du grags pa'i nang gses khro gling gnyis ni chab mdo sa khul 'jo mda' rdzong gi khro ru dgon dang / 'bri chu shar kha'i sde da~X snying

tshang gnyis la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod cing de gnyis ga'i thad khyad chos ni 'bri chu'i nye rgyud la 'khel ba yin/ khro ru dgon ni 'jo mda' rdzong gter ston shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/g.ya' shug gnyis/bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa zhung bzhi dang ya brgyad du grags pa'i nang gses g.ya' shug gnyis ni lho kha sa khul sne gdong rdzong gi da lta'i g.ya' bzang shang gi sa khongs su yod pa'i g.ya' bzang dgon pa ni chos smon lam gyis rab byung gsum pa'i me stag spyi lo 1206lor phyag btab pa dang shug ni phag gru'i slob ma gyer sgom pa tshul khrims seng ges shug gseb dgon pa da lta'i bod ljongs chu shur rdzong tshal sna khongs lha sa skyid chu'i lho rgyud nye 'gram dang yar lung gtsang po'i byang khar 'khel ba yin/'bri stag gnyis/bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa 'ung bzhi dang ya brgyad du grags pa'i 'bri stag gnyis ni 'bri gung bka' brgyud bod ljongs mal gro gung dkar rdzong gi 'bri gung mthil dgon pa dang / stag ni bod ljongs lhun grub rdzong gi stag lung dgon pa (stag lung shang khongs su yod )gnyis kyi bsdus ming yin/spar yel gnyis/bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa lung bzhi dang ya brgyad du grags pa'i smar yel gnyis ni chab mdo sa khul go 'jo rdzong gi smar chu 'bab rgyud kyi go 'jo dzodi rnyi8 dkyil rgyud du 'khel ba'i sa phyogs dang / yel ni yel phug ces pa'i
bongapa 'a

steng chen rdzong khul gyi dgon khagarme ru dkyil mkhar dgon/bka' bcu ba bsam gtan seng gis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor yod/ the ru dkyil mkhar dgon ni steng chen rdzong gyang sngon shang dkyil mkhar grong tshor yod pa dang bar //sna zhig nas chab mdo byams pa gling gi dgon lag gras su brtsi ba zhig rme ru bsam 'grub dgon/bsam gtan seng gis phyag btab cing de nas dus gyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod de ni steng chen rdzong byang sngon shang khongs me ru grong tshor yod pa dang chab mdo byams pa gling gi dgon lag gras su brtsi ba ni chab mdo byams pa gling gi yig cha'i khongs su 'khod pa'ang 'dugargyang shod chab rdzong dgon/mkhan chen chos legs par grags pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ rgyang shod ces pa 'di ni steng chen rdzong gi lho rgyud da lta steng chen rdzong rgyang shod shang khongs su yod pa yin/200

rwa khrim dga' ldan darathos gling /sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod cing da lta'i chab mdo sa khul steng chen rdzong ra khyim shang gi sa khongs su yod pa dang bod ljongs sa ming khongs su ra khyim ra khram zhes bris pa'i sa yul 'di yin/ /rtse drug dgon/khyung po steng chen rdzong sa mdo shang khongs rtse drug dgon ni bon po'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa dang de ni ri bo rtse mo drug yod pa'i nye 'dabs su 'khel bas rtse drug dang zhang zhung sgo phugs bar gsum gyi sgo pa ni khyung po gyim shod ri rtse drug gis mtshon pa'i zhang zhung mdo khams su gtogs pa'i cha shas su brtsi bar grags/ (yig cha'i dpyad khungs 〈mnga' ris skor gsum gyi sngon rgyud lo rgyus 〉lcags par shog grangs 41pa nas btus pa yin)snu kho dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs bcu pa rje drung shes rab dbang pos nyams gso mdzad de ci bsam don du btags/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ snu kho ni steng chen rdzong gi lho rgyud gnu khog ces 'bod pa'i sa yul du yod pa yin/del mgo dgon/mkhan chen chos grags pas phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu skor yod/ del mgo ritāspyan

rwa khrim dga' ldan darathos gling /sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod cing da lta'i chab mdo sa khul steng chen rdzong ra khyim shang gi sa khongs su yod pa dang bod ljongs sa ming khongs su ra khyim ra khram zhes bris pa'i sa yul 'di yin/ /rtse drug dgon/khyung po steng chen rdzong sa mdo shang khongs rtse drug dgon ni bon po'i chos lugs kyi dgon pa zhig yin pa dang de ni ri bo rtse mo drug yod pa'i nye 'dabs su 'khel bas rtse drug dang zhang zhung sgo phugs bar gsum gyi sgo pa ni khyung po gyim shod ri rtse drug gis mtshon pa'i zhang zhung mdo khams su gtogs pa'i cha shas su brtsi bar grags/ (yig cha'i dpyad khungs 〈mnga' ris skor gsum gyi sngon rgyud lo rgyus 〉lcags par shog grangs 41pa nas btus pa yin)snu kho dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs bcu pa rje drung shes rab dbang pos nyams gso mdzad de ci bsam don du btags/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ snu kho ni steng chen rdzong gi lho rgyud gnu khog ces 'bod pa'i sa yul du yod pa yin/del mgo dgon/mkhan chen chos grags pas phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu skor yod/ del mgo ritāspyan

dpa' shod rdzong khul gyi dgon khag dpa' shod rdzong dga' ldan bsam 'grub gling /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma lho pa rgyal mtshan seng gis phyag btab pa'i dgon rnying zhig yod pa de bzhin dben po dpal 'byor bzang pos dgon pa gsar du spos pa ming dga' ldan bsam 'grub gling zhes su grags/ de ni dpa' shod rje drung ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma'i sku dus su rgyal ba lnga pa chen pos dpa' shod dgon pa'i rten gsum mchod rdzas dang / gzhon nu shog brgyad khra 'dan bcas mi ser them rkang brgyad brgya tsam mchod gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang ba nas bzung rje drung ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma/ rje drung blo bzang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ dpa' shod rje drung kun bde gling rgyal thog dang po rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon po/ dpa' shod rje drung blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kun bde gling rgyal thog gnyis pa rta tshag sku phreng bcu pa ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rta tshag sku phreng bcu gcig pa thub bstan bskal bzang bstan pa'i sgron me/ sku phreng bcu gnyis pa thub bstan rgyal mtshan bcas sku phreng bdun gyi gdan sa dngos gzhi dpa' shod dgon du byung ba yin/ dpa' shod dgon pa'i mi ser them rkang brgyad brgya tsam yod bzhin pa'i steng du me sbrul spyi lo 1727lor mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis dpa' shod rje drung blo bzang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan la slar yang ri bo che'i nye rgyud kyi lcags zam dgon pa sogs mi ser them rkang lnga brgya brgal ba slar yang rang 'jags gnang ba bcas mi ser them rkang chig stong susdu zlorgya

tsam yod pa dang bod kyi lo rgyus thog srid skyong snga rting gnyis byung ba sogs chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i bla brang / brag g.yab bla brang / ri bo che'i bla brang /dpa' shod bla brang bcas bla khag bzhis chab mdo sa khul yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i tshad du slebs pa ni chos srid bzung du 'brel pa'i dpang rtags gson po zhig byung ba red/ dpa' shod dgon ni chab mdo sa khul dpa' shod dgon pa dang dpa' shod bla brang byung ba'i sa yul de dang da lta dpa' shod rdzong ni ldem gshis kyi sa khongs par ma zhes par spos 'dugadapa' shod gnas thang dgon/lho pa rgyal mtshan seng gis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin zhing rgyal mtshan seng ge ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma'i gras kyi mtshan tho'i khongs su yod pa dang / sa stag spyi tsho 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor byinā/da/de ni dpa' shod dgon dang nye ba'i da lta dpa' shod rdzong gi sa khongs ldem gshis bu rta 'dzoms dgon/rin chen seng gis phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ ldem gshis ni dpa' shod rdzong gsar pa'i pad ma'i nye rgyud 'di la de sngon lo rgyus thog ldem gshis gzhung zhes zer ba dang bu rta ni gna' dus su khyim tshang rab 'bring la dbye ste dmag mi dang rta hā / ༵༵༵ sogs zhib gsher byed pa'i dmag grabs byed pa'i yul srol zhig 204

bkra shis rtse dgon pa/dpa' shod rdzong da lta khron bod gzhung lam brgyud dgon pa zhig de sdu/ lo rgyus thog dgon pa 'di la byams chen gyi sku 'dra zhig mjal rgyu yod pa shug steng dgon bshad sgrub byams pa gling /mnga' ris bstan pa bzang pos phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ shug steng dgon ni dpa' shod rdzong ra'u shang gi ra nag mtsho dang nye bar yod pa yin/(dpa' shod rdzong khongs ༵ ju/ ) t+yā spya shā/nga sam dbra dgon gnyis la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/(de ni dpa' shod bla brang gi dgon lag gras yin)205

dpal 'bar rdzong khul gyi dgon khagadapal 'bar dgon/khams stod gung ru'i sa'i char 'khel ba'i gung ru dpal 'bar dgon ni sa skya'i 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa slar yang nang sar phebs skabs mar zhor 'byon lam 'khel ba'i sa yul 'dir zhal bkod mdzad de gtsug lag khang dang kun dga' ra ba bcas pa phyag btab pa'i sa skya'i dgon pa zhig yin/ 'bras spungs dgon pa'i gdan rabs gsum pa gung ru ba rin chen byang chub kyis dge lugs su bsgyur/ dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu skor yod/ dpal 'bar dgon ni dpal 'bar rdzong rnying pa'i 'gram du yod cing da lta'i dpal 'bar rdzong dpal 'bar shang khongs/ de sngon lo rgyus thog khams bod dbar gyi lam tshugs che gras zhig 'khel ba yin/a rig bang dgon pa/rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa'i bka' lung ltar phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 169/lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu skor yod/ a rig thang dgon pa ni dpal 'bar rdzong sngon gro stod shang gi sa khongs su yod cing de sngon lo rgyus thog khams bod gzhung lam gyi nye 'gram zhig la 'khel gyin 'dug206

jod mcho gling /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags yos spyi lo 1698lor phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod/ nye dus kyi rgyal ba'i mtshan zhabs gras rgya mtsho'i gling sprul sku yang dgon 'di dang 'brel ba byung ba zhig yin/ rgya mtsho gling ni dpal 'bar rdzong sngon gro stod shā ༵ / sa khongs su yod cing de sngon lo rgyus thog khams bod gzhung lam 'khel lcags ra dgon/'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa mthong ba don ldan gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor zhig yod/ lcags ra dgon pa'i sprul sku ni phyis su rgyal ba bdun pa'i sku dus su 'di 'dra zhig la chab mdor bla brang byung rjes lcags ra dgon ni chab mdo byams pa gling gi dgon lag gras yin zhing da lta'i dpal 'bar rdzong nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud shar gangs pa'i nye 'dabs su yod pa'i lcags ra grong tshor byung ba yin/lha rtse dgon/dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/ lnga pa chen po'i rang rnam khongs su lha rtse dbon mos byed lugs byed stangs de ni spre'u dang thang chu'i (thang shing gi 'byar rtsi )dper song tshul gsungs pa'i lha rtse dbon mo'i sku skye rim par byung ba'i da lta'i bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi nye rgyud gung ru 'gro mkha' 'byung khungs yang sa shod lha ༵ /sa

byung ba yin/ lha rtse dgon ni dpal 'bar rdzong gi shar rgyud lha rtse shang gi sa 〈sna dī/ / bye sduni lo rgyus thog khams bod gzhung lam thog gi babs tshugs ba grong dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs gnyis pa mnga' ris zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ ba gyong dgon ni dpal 'bar rdzong hā /ba rgyud o rgyan rta mda'i sa yul dang / cung nye ba'i ri ldebs su yod pa rgyal ston bde chen dgon/(bde chen lhun grub dgon pa )bde chen dgon ni de sngon lo rgyus thog rgyal ston rdzong gi nye 'gram du yod cing rgyal ston rdzong ni da lta'i dpal 'bar rdzong gsal steng shang gi sa yul du byung ba yin/wig chos rdzong /chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs gnyis pa mnga' ris zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pas phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ de ni dpal 'bar rdzong gsar ba'i sa yul 'di nas rtsis pa'i byang shar ngos spyi le sum cu so drug tsam yod pa'i da lta cig ces pa'i sa yul 'di la dbar steng shang zhes bod ljongs sa ming mtho deb khongs su 'khod snang ngo /208

dgon pa 'di sus btab ༵ /rtsad/ khungs med cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu skor yod/ nam rgyun 'di phyogs kyi kha rgyun la byang bya mo snang zhes byang lam bar ma'i lam rgyud 'khel ba'i dpal 'bar rdzong gi rnam rgyal dgon dang nye bar yod cing dpal 'bar rdzong rnying pa nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud nyin lam gnyis tsam yod pa yin/ra ma thang dgon pa/dus phyis rab byung drug pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1942yas mas zhig la dpal 'bar dgon pa'i mkhan zur rgyud smad sngags rams pa dge slong ngag dbang chos 'byor gyis phyag btab cing da lta dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa grangs zhig yod/ ra ma thang dgon pa ni dpal 'bar rdzong sa shod lha rtse shang khongs su yod/deb sngon khongs su 'bri gung/ kā go ṭ+wāṃ sha/ ra gling pas rngo chu'i rgyud sa shod du zla dgon phyag btab lugs gsungs pa'i dgon pa de yin/ dus phyis 'bri gung nas bdag 'dzin gnang bzhin pa ni 'bri gung gdan rabs khongs su snga rting gnyis tsam zhig 'khod 'dug zla dgon ni dpal 'bar rdzong sa shod lha ṭ+wāṃ /nga nas cung nye bar yod pa yin/ chos lugs 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa 209

brag g.yab rdzong khul gyi dgon khagabrag g.yab chos rdzong /(brag g.yab rdzong khongs )khams phyogs kyi kha rgyun la brag g.yab ma dgon zhes yongs su grags pa'i brag g.yab chos rdzong ni rngu sbi ba grags pa rgya mtshos rab byung bcu pa'i lcags bya spyi lo 1621lor phyag btab pa'i dgon pa 'di la dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu brgya skor yod cing brag g.yab bu dgon zhes pa'i brag g.yab byams mdun ni brag g.yab sprul sku ngag dbang bsod nams kyis rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu 'brug spyi lo 1652lor phyag btab pa'i bu dgon la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug brgya skor yod/byams mdun dgon/brag g.yab sprul sku che tshang gi sku skye ngag dbang bsod nams lhun grub kyis rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu 'brug spyi lo 1652lor phyag btab pa'i brag g.yab bu dgon zhes byams mdun dgon pa la sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs drug brgya skor yod/ byams mdun dgon pa'i byams pa ni chos rgyal ral pa can gyis bzhengs par bshad la/ 'o ru byams chen la sogs sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rten btsugs skor 〈lde'u chos 'byung 〉lcags par shog grangs 125par gsal ba'i 'o ru byams chen ni da lta'i byaswārdo /dun dgon pa yin pa ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod cing da dung zhib 'jug

smar khams rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagam po gnas nang dgon/kurma sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa'i sa yos spyi lo 1159lor dbus nas khams su byon/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga bzhes pa'i shing sprel spyi lo 1164lor kum por byon te kum po gnas nang gi dgon pa phyag btab pas kurma bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dang po de yin/ kum po gnas nang ni smar khams rdzong gtsang shod shang gi nub rgyud nye 'gram 'di la kum po gnas nang gi chu rgyud 'khel ba'i kum mda' zhes pa'i grong tsho dang ha cang nye bar yod cing kum mda' ni de sngon lo rgyus thog dar rtse mdo nas chab mdo bar gyi lam tshugs kyi zhag sa 'khel ba yin/'bum rnam snang lha khang /rgya bzas bzhengs par grags pa'i 'bum rnam snang lha khang ni dus phyis lcags sprul spyi lo 1581lor rgyal ba sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho li thang nas smar khams brgyud chab mdo byams pa gling du phebs dus 'bum rnam snang lha khang du phebs lam 'khel ba dang / de nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdo sku'i mdun du mchod pa sna lnga re'i mchod rgyun gsar 'dzugs gnang ba yin/ 'bum zhes pa'i go don ni byang chub 'bum pa zhes mchod rten zhig gi ming zur 'jags pa dang / se ra'i gdan rabs snga shoX /sna kyi kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum pa yang 'khrungs yul 'di nas yin/

smar khams rdzong khul gyi dgon khagagam po gnas nang dgon/kurma sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa'i sa yos spyi lo 1159lor dbus nas khams su byon/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga bzhes pa'i shing sprel spyi lo 1164lor kum por byon te kum po gnas nang gi dgon pa phyag btab pas kurma bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa dang po de yin/ kum po gnas nang ni smar khams rdzong gtsang shod shang gi nub rgyud nye 'gram 'di la kum po gnas nang gi chu rgyud 'khel ba'i kum mda' zhes pa'i grong tsho dang ha cang nye bar yod cing kum mda' ni de sngon lo rgyus thog dar rtse mdo nas chab mdo bar gyi lam tshugs kyi zhag sa 'khel ba yin/'bum rnam snang lha khang /rgya bzas bzhengs par grags pa'i 'bum rnam snang lha khang ni dus phyis lcags sprul spyi lo 1581lor rgyal ba sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho li thang nas smar khams brgyud chab mdo byams pa gling du phebs dus 'bum rnam snang lha khang du phebs lam 'khel ba dang / de nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdo sku'i mdun du mchod pa sna lnga re'i mchod rgyun gsar 'dzugs gnang ba yin/ 'bum zhes pa'i go don ni byang chub 'bum pa zhes mchod rten zhig gi ming zur 'jags pa dang / se ra'i gdan rabs snga shoX /sna kyi kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum pa yang 'khrungs yul 'di nas yin/

'bum rnam snang lha khang gi smar khams rdzong gi 'bum stod shang dang 'bum smad shang gnyis las gcig gi khongs su 'khel ba yin/ 'phar ba rin chen sgang /rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma bka' bcu nam mkha' bzang pos phyag btab cing / de nas 'phar ba dgon tsho bco brgyad kyi ma mar gyur/ lcags sprul spyi lo 1581lor rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho li thang nas chab mdo byams pa gling du gdan 'dren zhu skabs yar zhor phebs lam 'khel bas rab gnas yang gnang ba yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu skor yod/ 'khar ba rin chen sgang sogs da lta'i smar khams rdzong sgar thog nye rgyud 'di la yod pa yin/ gtsang gshis grwa smad dgon/zhal snga bka' brgyud pa chos rje ngag dbang dpal mchog pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu skor yod/ zhal snga bka' brgyud ni kur lugs dang dge lugs kyi chos lugs gnyis cung 'dres par spyod pa'i chab mdo 'phags pa lha sku phreng 'ga' zhig la zhal snga bka' brgyud ces grags pa zhig 'dug (de ni smar khams rdzong gtsang gshes shang khongs)gtsang gshis 'bam dgon/'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyi shu sko/ sbyad/

de ni smar khams rdzong gtsang gshes shang khongs su yod/klu rwa dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma dbu rnam bzang zhes pas phyag btab cing de nas ngor dgon pa'i ngor lugs phyogs kyis gtor bshig btang rjes ljang sa tham rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyi sbyin bdag zhus te klung rwa thang du spos te dgon ming de ltar gtan 'khel byung 'dug sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod zhing skabs 'di'i ljang sa tham rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan ni sa bya spyi lo 1609lor bod kyi bla ma garma sku phreng 'ga' zhig dang 'brel ba byung ba'i yun nan lī cang sa khul gyis sa tham zhes pa de yin/ klu ra dgon ni smar khams rdzong gtsang shod shang gi nub rgyud tsam la 'khel ba yin/ ljang zhes pa 'di la dbus phyogs kyi yig lam 'gar ljang dang / ljang zhabs/ ljang rgyal po sogs 'bri ba dang khams phyogs kyi kha rgyun la 'jang dang / 'jang pa'i mi rigs/ 'jang gling g.yul 'gyed kyi sgrung bcas la 'jang zhes 'bri ba yin/nya mgo dgon/ser ba gzhon nu zhes pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag sbyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ (de ni chab mdo sa khul smar khams rdzong khongs su yod)/ /'od zer dgon/21/ra khams rdzong sgar thog shang gi sa khongs su yod pa'i 'od zer dgon

de ni smar khams rdzong gtsang gshes shang khongs su yod/klu rwa dgon/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma dbu rnam bzang zhes pas phyag btab cing de nas ngor dgon pa'i ngor lugs phyogs kyis gtor bshig btang rjes ljang sa tham rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyi sbyin bdag zhus te klung rwa thang du spos te dgon ming de ltar gtan 'khel byung 'dug sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya skor yod zhing skabs 'di'i ljang sa tham rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan ni sa bya spyi lo 1609lor bod kyi bla ma garma sku phreng 'ga' zhig dang 'brel ba byung ba'i yun nan lī cang sa khul gyis sa tham zhes pa de yin/ klu ra dgon ni smar khams rdzong gtsang shod shang gi nub rgyud tsam la 'khel ba yin/ ljang zhes pa 'di la dbus phyogs kyi yig lam 'gar ljang dang / ljang zhabs/ ljang rgyal po sogs 'bri ba dang khams phyogs kyi kha rgyun la 'jang dang / 'jang pa'i mi rigs/ 'jang gling g.yul 'gyed kyi sgrung bcas la 'jang zhes 'bri ba yin/nya mgo dgon/ser ba gzhon nu zhes pas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag sbyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor yod/ (de ni chab mdo sa khul smar khams rdzong khongs su yod)/ /'od zer dgon/21/ra khams rdzong sgar thog shang gi sa khongs su yod pa'i 'od zer dgon

ni paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan gyi slob ma smar khams 'od zer bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab par mngon/ yig cha'i dpyad khungs ni 〈klong rdol bla ma'i gsung 'bum 〉la gzhi byas te bris pa yin/ de min gyi dpyad khungs ci yang mthong rgyu mi 'dugago bo rin chen sgang /go bo dbon po rin chen pas phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya sum cu skor yod/ go bo ni smar khams rdzong gi sa khongs su yod cing dus phyis lcags sbrul spyi lo 1581lor rgyal dbang sku phrengagasum pa li thang nas chab mdo byams pa gling du gdan 'dren zhu skabs smar khams go bo dbon po nas kyang gdan zhu'i mi rta brdzangs pa sogs slob ma dang sbyin bdag gras yin/215

mdzo sgang rdzong khul gyi dgon khagamadzo sgang gsang sngags gling /'phags pa lhas bon po'i dgon pa zhig la gzhi byas te phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor yod/mdzo sgang ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog mdo khams sgang drug ya rgyal tsha ba sgang rgyud ring mo zhes pa de la nang gses su tsha ba mdzo sgang / tsha ba spom mda'/ tsha ba tho thog tsha ba bul tog tsha ba dpa' shod bcas las grub pa'i dpa' shod ni dpa' shod rdzong gi khongs su yod pa dang 'phros thams cad da lta mdzo sgang rdzong gi khongs su yod pa yin/lhun grub dgon/shes rab bzang pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod/ lhun grub dgon ni mdzo sgang bul tog shang gi nye rgyud 'di 'dra zhig la 'khel ba yin/byang dmar bkra shis bang /go bo dge 'dun bkra shis kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu skor yod/ de ni mdzo sgang rdzong bul tog shang khongs bkra shis grong tshor yod cing go bo zhes pa'i go don ni sma ༵༵sa rdzong gi go bo rong zhes pa'i dgon pa zhig la dus phyis bar du bod

nas go bo bla gnyer zhes rtse drung zhig bsko bzhag byed kyi yod srol 'dugathem thog dgon/ rgyal dbang sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i slob ma dge 'dun bstan 'phel gyis phyag btab cing de nas dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bzhi bcu skor yod/ them thog dgon ni mdzo sgang rdzong them thog shang gi sa yul 'dir yod pa yin/spom mda' gsang sngags bde chen/ 'phags pa lha sku phreng gsum pa mthong ba don ldan gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya kārdo )rgyad cu skor yod/ (tsha ba spom mda'i gnam gru thang dang nye skor la grub pa dgon/ cirje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma bul tog rgya lam pa rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad cu skor yod/ de ni mdzo sgang brag yol shang gi sa khongs su yod pa yin/217

ri be+e che rdzong khul gyi dgon khagari bo che dgon pa/(chab mdo sa khul ri bo che'i rdzong khongs )byang stag lung dgon pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dbon po grags pa dpal 'od zer dbang pos khams su byon te rab byung bzhi pa'i me byi spyi lo 1276lor ri bo che'i dgon pa phyag btab pa nas bzung stag lung ya thang dang ma thang gnyis su gyes/ stag lung gdan sa gong 'og gnyis kur dge 'dun sum stong brgyad brgya tsam re 'tshogs par grags/ spyi lo 1276bdus phyis spyi lo 191〈tsam bar du ri bo che'i gdan sa ni gdung rgyud dang bla ma rim byon gyis 'dzin skyong gnang ba dang / spyi lo 191〈tsam la ri bo che rje drung gi sku tsha gras mgar ra bla ma'i don rkyen zer ba zhig byung rjes dngos don thog dgon pa gzhung bzhes byas te ri bo che'i bla gnyer zhes rtse drung nas do dam byed pa yin/ ri bo che dgon pa'i nang rten hā/ phra 'khod pa zhig ni ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su 'khod pa zhig lcags zam thub bstan gling dgon pa/me sbrul spyi lo 1727lor mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis lcags zam dgon pa dang / mi ser them grangs lnga brgya skor rta tshag rje drung blo bzang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan la slar yang phyir 'bul zhus pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/218

lho rong rdzong khul gyi dgon khag sho mdo dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling /rab byung bcu pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1642lor gzhi rtsa sde pa rnam rgyal bkra shis kyis sbyin bdag zhus te ba so rje drung ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gis sa 'dul gyi rten 'brel gnang / paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis dgon ming dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling zhes 'dogs pa gnang / sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum brgya skor yod/gzhi rtsa sde pa rnam rgyal bkra shis ni paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa'i sbyin bdag yin zhing chu lug nas sa byi (1642—1672)bar sho pa mdor bzhugs 'di'i lo rgyus thar thor 'ga' zhig du ku la'i gos bzang dang paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa'i rnam thar khongs su gsal 'khod byung ba 'ga' zhig yod/ ba so rje drung ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug ni (1606da 1652)me rta nas chu 'brug bar bzhugs shing 'di'i rnam thar cung zad re du ku la'i gos bzang khongs su 'khod pa'ang yod pa yin/ sho mdo dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling ni da lta'i lho rong rdzong sho pa mdo shang khongs dang de sngon lo rgyus thog khams bod gzhung lam gyi lam tshugs 'khel ba yin/ngo 'du dgon/rgya ra sangs rgyas ye shes kyis phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu skor yod/ rgya ra 21zlos

rgyas ye shes ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma'i mtshan tho'i khongs su yod pa'i rgya ra sangs rgyas ye shes zhes pa de yin par mngon zhing (spo bo'i lo rgyus 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb de'i khongs su 6 dzi ngom gnyis zhes gsal pa'i rdzi tho dang /ngom ni ngo 'du'i don dang ngom 'du dgon ni dus phyis bar bstan rgyas gling gi dgon lag che gras zhig yin/ ngom 'du dgon ni lho rong rdzong ngom du shang khongs ngom zhes pa'i dgon grong 'dres ma zhig yin/ju shod dar rgyas dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs bcu pa rje drung shes rab dbang pos (1501da 1586)bar bzhugs shing rje drung 'di nyid ni khyung po steng chen rdzong rgyang shod du (rgyang shod shang )sku 'khrungs shing rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i slob mar gyur/ rab byung dgu pa'i sa sprel spyi lo 1548lor rgyal mo rngul chu bar rgyud tsam 'khel ba'i rngul shod du thub bstan dar rgyas dgon phyag btab pa yin zhing / shing stag spyi lo 1674lor rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos gnang pa'i gos chen ser po'i steng du bris pa'i bca' yig zhig dang kun bde gling rta tshag sku phreng bcu pa ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gnang ba'i bca' yig gi ma zin zhig bcas mthong rgyu 'dug dus phyis sa stag mya lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor zhig yod/ dar rgyas spya sdo lta'i lho rong rdzong rngu chu shang khongs rgyal mo rngu chu'i byang 'gram du yod pa gung ru chos sde pu ste dgon byā ñtsā hā/ sdob/ nga sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya ༵༵༵ slob ma drung rams pa bstan pa'i nyi mas phyag btab cing dus phyis sa

stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/gung ru chos sde pu ste dgon ni lho rong rdzong sho mdo shang nas rtsis pa'i nub rgyud spyi le bcu bdun tsam yod cing de sngon lo rgyus thog bod sdod am ban zhes pa'i bod sdod blon chen dang / bod kyi bka' blon sogs lam tshugs zhag sar 'khel bas dgon 'dir rta dang khal ma sogs gra sgrig byed dgos pa dang /dus phyis dgon pa'i sa 'og nas chu brdol rgyab stabs spyi lo 1927tsam la yar tsam spos pa ni pha bong kha byams pa bstan 'dzin gyi rnam thar khongs su 'khod yod/ri khrod dgon/chu lug spyi lo 1642lor sho mdo dgon pa'i khongs su 'gril rjes ri khrod dgon pa'i gyang geg rgya che ba zhig mthong rgyu 'dug cing ri khrod dgon gyi shul mal ni lho rong rdzong sho pa mdo shang khongs rgyu dkar zhes pa'i grong tsho'i rgyab ngos su shug nags dang spangs ljongs sogs yul ljongs nyams dga' ba zhig yod pa yin/'bri rnga dgon/chu lug spyi lo 1642lor sho pa mdo dgon pa'i khongs su zla bsgril btang rjes da lta 'bri rnga zhes pa'i grong tsho chung ngu zhig sho pa mdo shang gi nye skor du yod pa yin/dba' sgo dgon/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dba' sgo dang brag lung gnyis la dge 21ḍin

zhal grangs drug cu skor yod/ dba' sgo ni dus phyis dgon pa'i shul mal yang mthong dka' ba'i khyim dud re zung yod pa'i lho rong rdzong rngu shod shang dang cung nye bar yod pa yin/la kha dgon/rje drung shes rab dbang po'i slob ma bsu rong ba bkra shes rab brtan gyis phyag btab cing 'phags pa lha sku phreng gnyis pa 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyis dgon ming dga' ldan ri bo chos 'phel zhes 'dogs pa mdzad/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ la kha dgon ni lho rong rdzong shing rong shang thang nag gru kha'i ri ldebs su yod pa yin/ra tshag dgon/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs bcu pa rje drung shes rab dbang pos phyag btab cing dus phyis sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi bcu skor yod/ da lta yul phyogs 'di'i kha rgyun la ra thag ces 'bod pa'i dgon pa 'di ni lho rong rdzong rngu shod shang rgyal mo rngul chu'i 'gram du yod pa yin/khrab lcog ri khrod/chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis shing rta spyi lo 1594lor chab mdo dgon pa'i khri khur bshol rjes lho rong rdzong gi rta tshag lhun grub bde chen du shas cher bzhugs te khrab ljokā —2 gser zangs kyi byams sku thog so phyed gnyis tsam yod pa'i khrab lcog

yang dgon du rten bzhengs rgya che ba gnang lugs bya phud dgon pa'i gdan rabs khongs su 'khod pa zhig yod pa yin/ khrab lcog yang dgon ni de sngon sho pa mdo rdzong gi rngul chu'i 'gram rgyud kyi g.yam zhes pa'i grong tsho dang nye bar yod cing dus phyis sho mdo dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling gi dgon lag gras su brtsi ba yin zhing da lta lho rong rdzong rngu shod shang khongs su yod pa yin/bu phug mdo sngags dar sa gling /rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang spyi lo 1469lor rta nag mkhan chen zhu pa'i mtshan dngos mi gsal ba zhig gis phyag btab lugs bya phug bla ma gong ma 'ga'i rnam thar nyung bris ma zhig kun bde gling gi phyag dpe thar thor zhig pe cin mi rigs dpe mdzod khang du yod de la gzhi byas te bris pa yin/ be+e ser khongs su mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i 'chad nyan dar tshul dang rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i sgrub mchod sogs mdo khams kyi lta sder gtogs pa'i 'gran zla bral pa yod tshul 'khod pa dang / sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bcu skor yod/ be+e ser khongs bya phud ces bris 'dug rung lnga pa chen po'i sku dus kyi sgo mang mkhan po gung ru sangs rgyas bkra shis ni bya phug tu 'khrungs tshul 'jam bzhad chos 'byung khongs su 'khod pa'ang 'dug bya phug ni lho rong rdzong nag lcog shang khongs su yod pa yin/ /rta tshag lhun grub bde chen/〈lho rong chos 'byung 〉gi rtsom pa po rta tshag tshe dbang rgyal gyi gzhis ka rta tshagagazhis ka dang gzhis ku'i yul 'dir rta tshag lhun grub bde chen zhes ri khrod zhig yod pa de ni dus phyis chab mdo byams pa gling gi gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa lha dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan (1527 1604)ni shing ṭ+wāṃ 2sbyo lo

1594lor chab mdo dgon pa'i khri khur bshol rjes shing rta nas shing 'brug bar rta tshag lhun grub bde chen du shas cher bzhugs de nas dus phyis lha sa kun bde gling gi dgon lag chung gras su brtsi ba yin/ rta tshag ri khrod ni lho rong rdzong khang gsar shang gi sa khongs khang gsar gyi nye skor zhig la yod/lho nag dgon/'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin/skabs 'di'i lho ni bar khams lho rgyud dam lho khog gi sa'i char gtogs pas na sbyi // gyu/ zer ba yin/ de ni lho rong gong nag lcog shang gi sa khongs nag yul steng dgon/(lho rong rdzong nag lcig shang lha khang thang grong tshor yod )sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu skor yod/ rta tshag bstan pa'i mgon po'i rnam thar khongs su rta tshag sku phreng gong ma zhig gi gdan sa'i gras su brtsi lugs kyi dpyad khungs zhig dang de nas rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas gnang ba'i bca' yig gi ma zin zhig gsung 'bum pod gcig tsam yod pa de'i khongs su 'khod pa zhig 'dugs dge 'gal med kyi bla ṭī /ko bo ༵༵/ga mtshan can gyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa zhig yin pa dang spyi lo 1620nang tsam la sho pa mdo'i sa khongs kyi kha drug drung pas dgon bdag de mo sprul sku lha dbang rnam rgyal sbyor 'bul zhupa ༵ nas dus phyis spyi lo 1899lor bstan rgyas gling gi dgon sde dang

gzhis ka mi nyung ba zhig gzhung bzhes ma byas bar du bstan rgyas gling gi dgon lag che gras zhig yin/ sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu skor yod/ rdzi tho dgon ni lho rong rdzong grong brdal rdzi tho'i nye 'gram du yod cing de sngon lo rgyus thog khams bod kyi gzhung lam 'khel ba dang da lta chab mdo nas dpal 'bar bar gyi gzhung lam nye rgyud du yod/spar chu mdo dgon/sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/spar chu dgon ni spar stod dung mtsho zer ba'i mtsho zhig yod pa de ni gnas rir brtsi bas gnas bskor du 'gro mkhan yang yod pa dang lho rong rdzong nag lcog shang khongs su yod/chos khri thang /rong po chung tshang gis sbyin bdag zhus te 'phags pa lha sku phreng dang pos phyag btab cing sa stag spyi lo 1698lor dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/ ka thog si tu'i gnas yig khongs su chos khri byams pa gling zhes bris pa de yin zhing / 'jim sku byams khang thog so gsum tsam slebs tsam zhig ni da lta'i bar du yod pa dang chos khri ni lho rong rdzong grong brdal rdzi tho'i khongs su grong tsho chung ngu tsam zhig yod pa yin/gzhi bkram dgon/lho rong rdzong rnying pa'i nye 'gram du yod pa'i gzhi bkram dgon ni spyi lo 1854shing stag lor phyag 'debs zin pa'i lho rong rdzong gi sa khongs ༵ sbyad

pa'i dge lugs kyi dgon pa 'di la dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis brgya yas mas zhig yod pa yin/ gzhi bkram dgon ni lho rong rdzong khang gsar shang khongs dang khang gsar shang gi de sngon lo rgyus thog gi lho rong rdzong pa rta tshag tshe dbang rgyal gyi gzhis ka rta tshag gzhis ka dang / rta tshag lhun grub bde chen gyi ri khrod yang khang gsar gyi rgyab ngos nye bar yod pa yin/ gzhi bkram dgon pa'i dpyad khungs ni bka' blon bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal pos gsar bsgrigs gnang ba'i 〈bsam yas dkar chag sminas btus pa yin/lho rong rdzong khongs su yod pa'i dgon khag bcu bdun yod pa de'i khongs su de sngon lo rgyus thog sho mdo rdzong gi sa khongs su yod pa'i dgon khag ji yod gsham gsal ltar yin/1 sho mdo dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling (sho mdo shang khongs)2 ju shod dar rgyas dgon (ju shod shang khongs)2 gung ru chos sde pusti ma (srung yul mdo shang khongs)4 la kha dgon (shing rong shang khongs)di ra tshag dgon (jul shod shang khongs)6 khrab lcog ri khrod (rngul shod shang khongs)7 del mgo dgon (da lta steng chen rdzong sa mdo shang khongs)226
